en.question:
Read the short story and answer the question.
Sami wakes up early on Sunday. He puts on his blue school shirt and packs his red bag. At seven o'clock, he walks to the bus stop with his older sister.
When does Sami wake up early?
en.hint: Look at the first sentence for a day of the week.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Find the time clue in the opening sentence.

Step 1: Sentence 1 says Sami wakes up early on Sunday.

Step 2: No other day is mentioned.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: On Sunday.

ar.question:
اقرأ القصة القصيرة ثم أجب عن السؤال باللغة الإنجليزية.
Sami wakes up early on Sunday. He puts on his blue school shirt and packs his red bag. At seven o'clock, he walks to the bus stop with his older sister.
متى يستيقظ سامي مبكرًا؟
ar.hint: انظر إلى الجملة الأولى للبحث عن يوم الأسبوع.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نبحث عن دلالة الزمن في الجملة الأولى من القصة.

الخطوة 1: تذكر الجملة الأولى أن سامي يستيقظ مبكرًا يوم الأحد (on Sunday).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: On Sunday.

correct_answer: At her desk in her bedroom

en.question:
Read the story about Nora and answer the question.
Nora loves drawing colorful flowers. After lunch, she sits at her wooden desk in her bedroom. She uses green and yellow crayons to draw a big garden.
Where does Nora sit to draw?
options: On the floor in the kitchen
On a bench in the library
At a picnic table in the park
At her desk in her bedroom
en.hint: Check the second sentence for a place word.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Locate the prepositional phrase telling the place.

Step 1: Sentence 2 states she sits at her wooden desk in her bedroom.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: At her desk in her bedroom.

ar.question:
اقرأ قصة نورة ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Nora loves drawing colorful flowers. After lunch, she sits at her wooden desk in her bedroom. She uses green and yellow crayons to draw a big garden.
أين تجلس نورة لترسم؟
options: On the floor in the kitchen
On a bench in the library
At a picnic table in the park
At her desk in her bedroom
ar.hint: راجع الجملة الثانية للبحث عن المكان.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نحدد عبارة المكان في الجملة الثانية.

الخطوة 1: تذكر الجملة الثانية أنها تجلس على مكتبها في غرفة نومها (at her wooden desk in her bedroom).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: At her desk in her bedroom.

en.question:
Read the short story and answer the question.
Little Omar has a fluffy white rabbit named Snowy. Every afternoon, Omar feeds Snowy fresh carrots in the backyard. Snowy hops happily around the green grass.
Who feeds the rabbit fresh carrots?
en.hint: Find the person's name in the second sentence.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Match the 'Who' question to the person performing the action.

Step 1: Sentence 2 says: Omar feeds Snowy fresh carrots.

Step 2: Snowy is the rabbit, not the feeder.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Omar.

ar.question:
اقرأ القصة القصيرة ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Little Omar has a fluffy white rabbit named Snowy. Every afternoon, Omar feeds Snowy fresh carrots in the backyard. Snowy hops happily around the green grass.
من يطعم الأرنب جزرًا طازجًا؟
ar.hint: ابحث عن اسم الشخص في الجملة الثانية.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: السؤال بـ Who يطلب اسم الشخص الذي يقوم بالفعل.

الخطوة 1: الجملة الثانية تذكر أن Omar هو من يطعم الأرنب Snowy.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Omar.

en.question:
Read the story about the class trip and answer the question.
Grade 3 students visit the Riyadh Zoo on Wednesday morning. They see tall giraffes eating leaves from high trees. Before noon, the teacher takes a class photo near the bird house.
Where do the students go on Wednesday morning?
en.hint: Look in the first sentence after the word 'visit'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Look for the destination named right after 'visit'.

Step 1: Sentence 1 says: Grade 3 students visit the Riyadh Zoo.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: To the Riyadh Zoo.

ar.question:
اقرأ القصة عن رحلة الصف ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Grade 3 students visit the Riyadh Zoo on Wednesday morning. They see tall giraffes eating leaves from high trees. Before noon, the teacher takes a class photo near the bird house.
إلى أين يذهب الطلاب صباح الأربعاء؟
ar.hint: انظر إلى الجملة الأولى بعد الفعل visit.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نحدد المكان الذي زاره الطلاب من الجملة الأولى.

الخطوة 1: توضح الجملة الأولى أن الطلاب يزورون حديقة حيوان الرياض (Riyadh Zoo).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: To the Riyadh Zoo.

en.question:
Read the story about Layan and answer the question.
Layan plays football with her friends every Friday evening. They meet at the neighborhood park before sunset. After the game, Layan drinks cold water and waves goodbye.
When does Layan play football?
en.hint: Read the end of the first sentence carefully.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Match 'When' to the time phrase in Sentence 1.

Step 1: The first sentence says she plays football every Friday evening.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Every Friday evening.

ar.question:
اقرأ قصة ليان ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Layan plays football with her friends every Friday evening. They meet at the neighborhood park before sunset. After the game, Layan drinks cold water and waves goodbye.
متى تلعب ليان كرة القدم؟
ar.hint: اقرأ نهاية الجملة الأولى بدقة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نربط أداة الاستفهام When بعبارة الوقت في الجملة الأولى.

الخطوة 1: تذكر الجملة الأولى أنها تلعب مساء كل جمعة (every Friday evening).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Every Friday evening.

en.question:
Read the story carefully and answer the question.
Tariq and his father drive to Grandpa's farm in Taif on Saturday. Grandpa shows them sweet green grapes growing near the stone wall. At four o'clock, Aunt Huda brings warm tea and dates to the garden.
Who brings warm tea and dates to the garden?
en.hint: Check the third sentence because three different people are named in the story.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Distinguish the roles of Grandpa, Tariq, and Aunt Huda.

Step 1: Grandpa shows the grapes.

Step 2: Aunt Huda brings warm tea and dates at four o'clock.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Aunt Huda.

ar.question:
اقرأ القصة بعناية ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Tariq and his father drive to Grandpa's farm in Taif on Saturday. Grandpa shows them sweet green grapes growing near the stone wall. At four o'clock, Aunt Huda brings warm tea and dates to the garden.
من يحضر الشاي الدافئ والتمر إلى الحديقة؟
ar.hint: راجع الجملة الثالثة لأن القصة تذكر أكثر من شخص.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نميّز بين الشخصيات الثلاث المذكورة في القصة.

الخطوة 1: الجد يعرض العنب، بينما العمة هدى (Aunt Huda) هي من يحضر الشاي والتمر.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Aunt Huda.

en.question:
Read the story about Maha's lost book and answer the question.
Maha looks for her English storybook before reading class. It is not in her locker or on the teacher's table. Then her friend Reem finds the book under a blue chair near the window.
Where does Reem find the storybook?
en.hint: Notice which places had NO book, then read the last sentence.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Separate the places checked unsuccessfully from where the book was found.

Step 1: The locker and teacher's table were empty.

Step 2: Sentence 3 states Reem finds it under a blue chair.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Under a blue chair.

ar.question:
اقرأ قصة كتاب مها الضائع ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Maha looks for her English storybook before reading class. It is not in her locker or on the teacher's table. Then her friend Reem finds the book under a blue chair near the window.
أين تجد ريم كتاب القصص؟
ar.hint: انتبه للأماكن التي لم يكن الكتاب فيها، ثم اقرأ الجملة الأخيرة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نستبعد الأماكن التي لم يوجد فيها الكتاب ونأخذ المكان المذكور في الجملة الأخيرة.

الخطوة 1: تقول الجملة الأخيرة إن ريم وجدته تحت كرسي أزرق (under a blue chair).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Under a blue chair.

en.question:
Read the story about the rainy afternoon and answer the question.
Dark clouds cover the sky over Abha in the afternoon. Rakan runs inside the house before the heavy rain begins. His mother bakes soft bread in the kitchen while they watch the rain through the glass window.
When does Rakan run inside the house?
options: After the rain stops at night
en.hint: Look at the second sentence for the exact time phrase.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Track the time phrase 'before...' in Sentence 2.

Step 1: Sentence 2 says Rakan runs inside before the heavy rain begins.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Before the heavy rain begins.

ar.question:
اقرأ القصة عن المساء الممطر ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Dark clouds cover the sky over Abha in the afternoon. Rakan runs inside the house before the heavy rain begins. His mother bakes soft bread in the kitchen while they watch the rain through the glass window.
متى يركض راكان إلى داخل المنزل؟
options: After the rain stops at night
ar.hint: انظر إلى الجملة الثانية للعثور على عبارة الوقت الدقيقة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نبحث عن توقيت دخول راكان في الجملة الثانية.

الخطوة 1: توضح الجملة الثانية أنه ركض إلى الداخل قبل بدء المطر الغزير (before the heavy rain begins).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Before the heavy rain begins.

en.question:
Read the story about school helpers and answer the question.
In our school, Mr. Khalid takes care of the green garden every morning. Ms. Amal checks out library books during break time. At noon, Coach Badr leads fun running games on the field.
Who works in the library during break time?
en.hint: Match the word 'library' to the name in the same sentence.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Pair each staff member with their exact job and location.

Step 1: Mr. Khalid cares for the garden.

Step 2: Ms. Amal checks out library books during break time.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Ms. Amal.

ar.question:
اقرأ القصة عن مساعدي المدرسة ثم أجب عن السؤال.
In our school, Mr. Khalid takes care of the green garden every morning. Ms. Amal checks out library books during break time. At noon, Coach Badr leads fun running games on the field.
من يعمل في المكتبة وقت الفسحة؟
ar.hint: اربط كلمة library بالاسم الموجود في الجملة نفسها.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نربط كل موظف بمكان عمله المذكور في جملته.

الخطوة 1: تذكر الجملة الثانية أن Ms. Amal مسؤولة عن كتب المكتبة وقت الفسحة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Ms. Amal.

en.question:
Read the story about the market visit and answer the question.
Dana goes to the weekend market with her mom in Jeddah. First, they buy sweet mangoes from a corner stall. Next, they stop by the flower booth near the fountain to pick white jasmine for Grandma.
Where is the flower booth located?
en.hint: Read the last sentence carefully to distinguish the two stalls.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Separate the mango stall location from the flower booth location.

Step 1: The mango stall is at a corner.

Step 2: The flower booth is near the fountain.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Near the fountain.

ar.question:
اقرأ القصة عن زيارة السوق ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Dana goes to the weekend market with her mom in Jeddah. First, they buy sweet mangoes from a corner stall. Next, they stop by the flower booth near the fountain to pick white jasmine for Grandma.
أين يقع كشك الزهور؟
ar.hint: اقرأ الجملة الأخيرة بدقة للتمييز بين الكشكين.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نميّز موقع كشك المانجو عن موقع كشك الزهور.

الخطوة 1: تذكر الجملة الأخيرة أن كشك الزهور يقع قرب النافورة (near the fountain).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Near the fountain.

en.question:
Read the short story carefully and answer the question.
Ziad planned to visit his cousin Faisal on Monday, but Faisal had a dentist visit that day. Instead, Ziad met Faisal on Tuesday afternoon at the community library. Together, they read two space books and borrowed a puzzle.
When did Ziad actually meet his cousin Faisal?
en.hint: Watch out for the word 'Instead'—the original plan on Monday changed!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Contrast planned time with the actual time introduced by 'Instead'.

Step 1: Monday was only the original plan.

Step 2: Sentence 2 shows they actually met on Tuesday afternoon.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: On Tuesday afternoon.

ar.question:
اقرأ القصة القصيرة بدقة ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Ziad planned to visit his cousin Faisal on Monday, but Faisal had a dentist visit that day. Instead, Ziad met Faisal on Tuesday afternoon at the community library. Together, they read two space books and borrowed a puzzle.
متى التقى زياد بابن عمه فيصل فعلًا؟
ar.hint: انتبه لكلمة Instead، فقد تغيّر الموعد الأصلي الذي كان يوم الإثنين!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نفرّق بين الخطة الأولى والوقت الفعلي بعد كلمة Instead.

الخطوة 1: تم إلغاء موعد الإثنين، والتقيا فعلًا بعد ظهر الثلاثاء (on Tuesday afternoon).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: On Tuesday afternoon.

en.question:
Read the story about the class pet and answer the question.
Room 4 keeps a little green turtle in a glass tank beside the bookshelf. Every Monday, Omar cleans the tank, while Yara changes the water on Thursdays. On weekends, Mr. Tariq takes the turtle home to his quiet apartment.
Where does the turtle stay on Saturday?
en.hint: Think about which days are 'weekends' in Saudi schools and check Sentence 3.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Connect 'Saturday' to 'On weekends' in the final sentence.

Step 1: Saturday is part of the weekend.

Step 2: Sentence 3 says Mr. Tariq takes the turtle to his apartment on weekends.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: At Mr. Tariq's apartment.

ar.question:
اقرأ القصة عن حيوان الصف الأليف ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Room 4 keeps a little green turtle in a glass tank beside the bookshelf. Every Monday, Omar cleans the tank, while Yara changes the water on Thursdays. On weekends, Mr. Tariq takes the turtle home to his quiet apartment.
أين تبقى السلحفاة يوم السبت؟
ar.hint: تذكّر أن يوم السبت من أيام عطلة نهاية الأسبوع (weekends) وراجع الجملة الثالثة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نربط يوم السبت بعبارة On weekends في الجملة الأخيرة.

الخطوة 1: السبت عطلة نهاية الأسبوع، وفيها يأخذ Mr. Tariq السلحفاة إلى شقته (his apartment).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: At Mr. Tariq's apartment.

en.question:
Read the story about the lost key and answer the question.
Layla thought she left her house key in her coat pocket at school. Her brother Anas checked the coat rack at home, and Mom looked on the dining table. Finally, Dad spotted the silver key shining inside Layla's lunchbox.
Who found Layla's house key?
en.hint: Check who looked without finding it versus who spotted the key at the end.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Read the final sentence to identify the person who succeeded.

Step 1: Anas checked the rack and Mom looked on the table.

Step 2: Finally, Dad spotted the key inside the lunchbox.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Dad.

ar.question:
اقرأ القصة عن المفتاح المفقود ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Layla thought she left her house key in her coat pocket at school. Her brother Anas checked the coat rack at home, and Mom looked on the dining table. Finally, Dad spotted the silver key shining inside Layla's lunchbox.
من الذي وجد مفتاح منزل ليلى؟
ar.hint: فرّق بين من بحث دون أن يجده وبين من رآه في الجملة الأخيرة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نقرأ الجملة الأخيرة لتحديد الشخص الذي عثر على المفتاح.

الخطوة 1: فحص أنس والأم أماكن أخرى، بينما الأب (Dad) هو من رأى المفتاح داخل صندوق الغداء.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Dad.

correct_answer: Near the main door of the school hall

en.question:
Read the story about the science fair and answer the question.
The science fair opens in the school hall at nine o'clock, right after morning assembly. Parents arrive first to see plant posters near the main door. Later, at ten-thirty, the judges walk to the stage to award three gold ribbons.
Where are the plant posters displayed?
options: Near the main door of the school hall
Outside by the morning assembly gate
en.hint: Scan the second sentence carefully for the location of 'plant posters'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Separate the three locations: school hall, near the main door, and the stage.

Step 1: Sentence 2 says parents see plant posters near the main door (inside the hall).

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Near the main door of the school hall.

ar.question:
اقرأ القصة عن معرض العلوم ثم أجب عن السؤال.
The science fair opens in the school hall at nine o'clock, right after morning assembly. Parents arrive first to see plant posters near the main door. Later, at ten-thirty, the judges walk to the stage to award three gold ribbons.
أين تُعرَض ملصقات النباتات؟
options: Near the main door of the school hall
Outside by the morning assembly gate
ar.hint: ابحث في الجملة الثانية بدقة عن مكان plant posters.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نميّز موقع الملصقات عن موقع المنصة (stage).

الخطوة 1: توضح الجملة الثانية أن ملصقات النباتات معروضة قرب الباب الرئيس (near the main door) داخل القاعة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Near the main door of the school hall.

en.question:
Read the story about the bicycle race and answer the question.
Four friends rode bikes along the sea road in Dammam before dinner. Kareem wore a yellow helmet, and Majid rode a red bike behind him. At the finish flag near the palm trees, Majid passed Kareem just one second before the whistle.
Who reached the finish flag first?
en.hint: Read the last sentence carefully—Majid was behind at first, then something changed!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Track the final change in position at the finish flag.

Step 1: Early in the race Majid was behind Kareem.

Step 2: At the finish flag, Majid passed Kareem before the whistle.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Majid.

ar.question:
اقرأ القصة عن سباق الدراجات ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Four friends rode bikes along the sea road in Dammam before dinner. Kareem wore a yellow helmet, and Majid rode a red bike behind him. At the finish flag near the palm trees, Majid passed Kareem just one second before the whistle.
من وصل إلى علم النهاية أولًا؟
ar.hint: اقرأ الجملة الأخيرة بدقة؛ كان ماجد خلفه في البداية لكنه تجاوزه قبل النهاية!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نتتبع التغيير في الترتيب عند خط النهاية في الجملة الأخيرة.

الخطوة 1: رغم أن ماجد كان خلف كريم أولًا، فإنه تجاوزه عند علم النهاية (Majid passed Kareem) وفاز.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Majid.

en.question:
Read the story and look at the sequence strip.
First, Amal washes two shiny apples in the sink. Next, she slices them carefully on a wooden board. Last, she puts the apple slices into a small bowl for her brother.
What does Amal do NEXT (Step 2)?
en.hint: Look for the word 'Next' in the second sentence.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Sequence signal words (First, Next, Last) mark Steps 1, 2, and 3.

Step 1: Step 1 (First): Washes apples.

Step 2: Step 2 (Next): Slices the apples.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Slices the apples.

ar.question:
اقرأ القصة وانظر إلى شريط تسلسل الأحداث.
First, Amal washes two shiny apples in the sink. Next, she slices them carefully on a wooden board. Last, she puts the apple slices into a small bowl for her brother.
ماذا تفعل أمل في الخطوة الثانية (Next)؟
ar.hint: ابحث عن كلمة Next في الجملة الثانية.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تدل كلمات First وNext وLast على ترتيب الخطوات الثلاث.

الخطوة 1: الخطوة الأولى غسل التفاح، والثانية بعد Next هي تقطيع التفاح (Slices the apples).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Slices the apples.

ar.hint: ابحث في البطاقة عن يوم لا يوجد فيه مطر ولا رياح قوية.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نستبعد الأيام التي فيها مطر أو رياح قوية وفق رسالة المدرسة.

الخطوة 1: الأحد والثلاثاء فيهما مطر، والإثنين فيه رياح قوية، لذا يُقام التدريب يوم الأربعاء (Wednesday) المشمس والهادئ.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Wednesday.

en.question:
Read the reading challenge card and note, then answer the question.
Challenge Rule: Students earn a Gold Star badge only if they read 12 books AND write 3 book cards.
Who has ALREADY earned the Gold Star badge?
en.hint: A student needs AT LEAST 12 books AND AT LEAST 3 cards—check both numbers!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Test every student against both thresholds (>= 12 books and >= 3 cards).

Step 1: Ziad: 14 books, 2 cards (missing 1 card).

Step 2: Nora: 12 books, 4 cards (meets BOTH!).

Step 3: Maha: 10 books, 3 cards (short on books).

Step 4: Kareem: 15 books, 1 card.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Nora.

Challenge Rule: Students earn a Gold Star badge only if they read 12 books AND write 3 book cards.
من الذي استحق شارة النجمة الذهبية (Gold Star) بالفعل؟
ar.hint: يحتاج الطالب إلى 12 كتابًا على الأقل و3 بطاقات على الأقل—تحقق من الشرطين معًا!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نختبر الشرطين معًا (12 كتابًا فأكثر و3 بطاقات فأكثر) لكل طالب.

الخطوة 1: زياد وكريم لديهما أقل من 3 بطاقات، ومها قرأت 10 كتب فقط، بينما نورة (Nora) حققت 12 كتابًا و4 بطاقات.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Nora.

en.question:
Read the museum ticket card and note, then answer the question.
Museum Notice: Children aged 8 and under enter FREE on Fridays. All tickets include a free map.
How much will a 9-year-old boy and his 6-year-old sister pay to visit on Friday?
en.hint: Check the age rule: 6 is 8 and under (free on Friday!), while 9 pays the Child ticket.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Apply the Friday free-entry rule only to the 6-year-old.

Step 1: 6-year-old sister (aged 8 and under) on Friday: Free (0 riyals).

Step 2: 9-year-old boy: Child ticket (10 riyals).

Step 3: Total = 10 + 0 = 10 riyals.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: 10 riyals.

ar.question:
اقرأ بطاقة تذاكر المتحف والملاحظة ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Museum Notice: Children aged 8 and under enter FREE on Fridays. All tickets include a free map.
كم سيدفع ولد عمره 9 سنوات وأخته ذات 6 سنوات للزيارة يوم الجمعة؟
ar.hint: تحقق من قاعدة العمر: عمر 6 سنوات مجاني يوم الجمعة، أما عمر 9 سنوات فيدفع تذكرة طفل!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نطبّق قاعدة المجانية ليوم الجمعة على الأخت ذات 6 سنوات فقط، والولد يدفع تذكرة طفل.

الخطوة 1: الأخت (6 سنوات) تدخل مجانًا يوم الجمعة، والأخ (9 سنوات) يدفع تذكرة طفل 10 ريالات، فالمجموع 10 riyals.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: 10 riyals.

en.question:
Read the plant care card and note, then answer the question.
Garden Note: Place sunny-window plants on Shelf A and shade plants on Shelf B.
Which plant belongs on Shelf B and needs water ONLY once a week?
en.hint: Check two clues: 'shade' (Shelf B) AND '1 time/wk' (once a week).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Filter the card rows by both light and water frequency.

Step 1: Shelf B needs 'Shade'. Mint and Cactus need Sun.

Step 2: Between Fern and Basil, Fern needs water '1 time/wk' while Basil needs '3 times/wk'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Fern.

Garden Note: Place sunny-window plants on Shelf A and shade plants on Shelf B.
أي نبتة مكانها الرف B وتحتاج إلى الماء مرة واحدة فقط في الأسبوع؟
ar.hint: تحقق من شرطين: الظل (shade للرف B) والري مرة واحدة أسبوعيًا (1 time/wk).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نصفّي النباتات حسب الضوء (Shade) وعدد مرات السقي (1 time/wk).

en.question:
Read the sports day table and note, then answer the question.
Sports Day Note: Students cannot enter two races that start at the exact same time.
Lina signs up for the Jump Rope event and the Sack Race. Which other event can she ALSO join?
en.hint: Look at the times of Jump Rope and Sack Race, then find an event at a DIFFERENT time.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Check time conflicts across all four rows on the card.

Step 1: Jump Rope = 9:00 (blocks 50m Dash).

Step 2: Sack Race = 10:00 (blocks Relay Run).

Step 3: Beanbag Toss = 11:00, which has no conflict!

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Beanbag Toss.

Sports Day Note: Students cannot enter two races that start at the exact same time.
سجّلت لينا في مسابقتي Jump Rope وSack Race. أي مسابقة أخرى يمكنها الاشتراك فيها أيضًا؟
ar.hint: انظر إلى وقتي Jump Rope وSack Race ثم ابحث عن مسابقة في وقت مختلف.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نتجنب المسابقات التي تبدأ في الساعة نفسها (9:00 أو 10:00).

ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نتحقق من الترتيب الزمني: ربط الحذاء بشكل غير محكم أولاً، فتعثر ثانيًا.

الخطوة 1: السبب (ربط الحذاء بشكل مرتخٍ) يسبق so، والنتيجة (التعثر) تأتي بعدها.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Ali tied his laces loosely, so he tripped when one came undone.

correct_answer: Because blowing sand made it hard to see ahead

en.question:
Read the story and answer the question.
The desert wind blew fine sand across the road all morning, making it hard to see far ahead. Therefore, bus drivers slowed down and turned on their bright headlights for safety.
Why did the bus drivers slow down and turn on headlights?
options: Because blowing sand made it hard to see ahead
Because the buses ran out of fuel
Because students asked for a longer ride
Because it was midnight and dark outside
en.hint: Read the cause before the word 'Therefore'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'Therefore' introduces an effect just like 'so'.

Step 1: Before 'Therefore': blowing sand made it hard to see far ahead.

Step 2: Effect: Drivers slowed down and used headlights.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Because blowing sand made it hard to see ahead.

ar.question:
اقرأ القصة ثم أجب عن السؤال.
The desert wind blew fine sand across the road all morning, making it hard to see far ahead. Therefore, bus drivers slowed down and turned on their bright headlights for safety.
لماذا أبطأ سائقو الحافلات وأضاءوا المصابيح الأمامية؟
options: Because blowing sand made it hard to see ahead
Because the buses ran out of fuel
Because students asked for a longer ride
Because it was midnight and dark outside
ar.hint: اقرأ السبب المذكور قبل كلمة Therefore (لذلك).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: كلمة Therefore تعمل مثل so وتقدّم النتيجة بعد ذكر السبب.

الخطوة 1: السبب المذكور أولاً هو هبوب الرمال الذي صعّب الرؤية (hard to see far ahead).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Because blowing sand made it hard to see ahead.

en.question:
Read the clues about Salem and answer the question.
Salem held his shiny gold medal high in the air. He smiled from ear to ear and hopped up and down to show his parents.
How does Salem feel?
en.hint: Look at his smile and how he jumps while holding his medal.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use facial expression and body actions (smile, hop) to infer feelings.

Step 1: Clues: holding a gold medal, smiling wide, hopping up and down -> proud and happy.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Happy and proud.

ar.question:
اقرأ الدلائل عن سالم ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Salem held his shiny gold medal high in the air. He smiled from ear to ear and hopped up and down to show his parents.
بماذا يشعر سالم؟
ar.hint: انظر إلى ابتسامته وقفزه وهو يرفع الميدالية الذهبية.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نستنتج الشعور من ملامح الوجه والحركات (الابتسام والقفز بالميدالية).

الخطوة 1: الابتسام العريض ورفع الميدالية يدلان على السعادة والفخر (Happy and proud).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Happy and proud.

en.question:
Read the clues about little Dana and answer the question.
Dana rubbed her heavy eyes and let out a big yawn. She leaned her head gently onto the soft pillow and pulled up the warm blanket.
How does Dana feel?
en.hint: Think about what rubbing eyes and yawning show.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Match physical clues (yawning, rubbing eyes, pillow) to feeling sleepy.

Step 1: Clues: heavy eyes, big yawn, leaning on pillow -> sleepy and tired.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Sleepy and tired.

ar.question:
اقرأ الدلائل عن الطفلة دانة ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Dana rubbed her heavy eyes and let out a big yawn. She leaned her head gently onto the soft pillow and pulled up the warm blanket.
بماذا تشعر دانة؟
ar.hint: فكّر في دلالة فرك العينين والتثاؤب والاتكاء على الوسادة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نربط الدلائل الجسدية (التثاؤب والوسادة) بالشعور المناسب.

الخطوة 1: فرك العينين والتثاؤب والغطاء الدافئ كلها دلائل على النعاس والتعب (Sleepy and tired).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Sleepy and tired.

en.question:
Read the clues about Omar's afternoon and answer the question.
Omar dropped his strawberry ice cream cone onto the sidewalk. He stared down at the puddle with watery eyes and walked slowly back to the bench.
How does Omar feel?
en.hint: Notice the watery eyes and slow walk after dropping his cone.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Infer sadness from disappointment and watery eyes.

Step 1: Clues: dropped ice cream, watery eyes, walked slowly -> sad.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Sad.

ar.question:
اقرأ الدلائل عن مساء عمر ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Omar dropped his strawberry ice cream cone onto the sidewalk. He stared down at the puddle with watery eyes and walked slowly back to the bench.
بماذا يشعر عمر؟
ar.hint: انتبه للدموع والمشي البطيء بعد سقوط المثلجات.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نستنتج الحزن من سقوط المثلجات وامتلاء العينين بالدموع.

الخطوة 1: سقوط المثلجات والدموع والمشي ببطء تدل على الحزن (Sad).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Sad.

en.question:
Read the clues about Ziad and answer the question.
Ziad stood at the edge of the dark hallway and heard a sudden loud knock. He stepped back quickly and held tightly onto his older brother's hand.
How does Ziad feel?
en.hint: Why would someone step back and hold tightly in a dark hallway?
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Connect stepping back and holding tight after a sudden noise to fear.

Step 1: Clues: dark hallway, sudden knock, stepped back, held tightly -> scared.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Scared.

ar.question:
اقرأ الدلائل عن زياد ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Ziad stood at the edge of the dark hallway and heard a sudden loud knock. He stepped back quickly and held tightly onto his older brother's hand.
بماذا يشعر زياد؟
ar.hint: لماذا يتراجع طفل للخلف ويمسك بيد أخيه بقوة في ممر مظلم؟
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نستنتج الخوف من التراجع السريع والإمساك بيد أخيه بقوة.

الخطوة 1: التراجع والتمسك الشديد بيد أخيه عند سماع طرق مفاجئ يدلان على الخوف (Scared).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Scared.

en.question:
Read the clues about Layla and answer the question.
Layla's stomach gave a loud rumble as she smelled fresh bread baking in the kitchen. She walked straight to the table and asked Mom when dinner would be ready.
How does Layla feel?
en.hint: Think about a rumbling stomach and asking when dinner is ready.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Match 'stomach rumbled' + smelling food to feeling hungry.

Step 1: Clues: stomach rumbled, smelled fresh bread, asked about dinner -> hungry.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Hungry.

ar.question:
اقرأ الدلائل عن ليلى ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Layla's stomach gave a loud rumble as she smelled fresh bread baking in the kitchen. She walked straight to the table and asked Mom when dinner would be ready.
بماذا تشعر ليلى؟
ar.hint: فكّر في صوت البطن (rumble) والسؤال عن موعد العشاء.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: صوت المعدة والسؤال عن العشاء يدلان بوضوح على الجوع.

الخطوة 1: قرقرة المعدة وشم رائحة الخبز والسؤال عن العشاء تعني أنها جائعة (Hungry).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Hungry.

correct_answer: Give the extra pencil to Majid

en.question:
Read the story clues and predict what will happen.
Rakan walked into the classroom and saw his friend Majid looking everywhere for a pencil before the quiz. Rakan opened his own pencil case and pulled out an extra sharpened pencil.
What will Rakan probably do next?
options: Throw the extra pencil out the window
Hide his pencil case in his bag
Give the extra pencil to Majid
en.hint: Think about why Rakan took out an EXTRA sharpened pencil.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Predict a helpful action based on the character's preparation.

Step 1: Majid needs a pencil; Rakan pulls out an extra sharpened one -> he plans to share it.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Give the extra pencil to Majid.

ar.question:
اقرأ دلائل القصة وتوقّع ماذا سيحدث.
Rakan walked into the classroom and saw his friend Majid looking everywhere for a pencil before the quiz. Rakan opened his own pencil case and pulled out an extra sharpened pencil.
ماذا سيفعل راكان على الأرجح بعد ذلك؟
options: Throw the extra pencil out the window
Hide his pencil case in his bag
Give the extra pencil to Majid
ar.hint: فكّر لماذا أخرج راكان قلمًا إضافيًا مبريًا وهو يرى صديقه يبحث عن قلم.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نتوقّع التصرف اللطيف من إخراج راكان لقلم إضافي عندما رأى صديقه بحاجة إليه.

الخطوة 1: أخرج راكان قلمًا إضافيًا ليساعد صديقه ماجد ويعيره إياه (Give the extra pencil to Majid).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Give the extra pencil to Majid.

en.question:
Read the clues about Sara's gift box and answer the question.
Sara gasped and covered her mouth with both hands when she opened the ribboned box. Inside sat the exact blue telescope she had wished for all year!
How does Sara feel?
en.hint: Notice the words 'gasped' and 'exact blue telescope she had wished for'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Infer amazed excitement from gasping over a wished-for gift.

Step 1: Clues: gasped, covered mouth, got what she wished for -> surprised and thrilled.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Surprised and thrilled.

ar.question:
اقرأ الدلائل عن صندوق هدية سارة ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Sara gasped and covered her mouth with both hands when she opened the ribboned box. Inside sat the exact blue telescope she had wished for all year!
بماذا تشعر سارة؟
ar.hint: لاحظ كلمة gasped (شهقت دهشةً) وحصولها على التلسكوب الذي تمنّته طوال العام.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نربط الدهشة الإيجابية (gasped) بتحقق الأمنية لنعرف شعورها.

الخطوة 1: شهقة الدهشة وحصولها على ما تمنت طوال العام تدل على المفاجأة والسرور الشديد (Surprised and thrilled).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Surprised and thrilled.

en.question:
Read the clues about Khalid and answer the question.
Khalid crossed his arms, frowned deeply, and stomped his foot when his little brother knocked over his tall block tower on purpose.
How does Khalid feel?
en.hint: Crossed arms, a frown, and stomping a foot show strong frustration.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use body language clues (frown, stomped foot) to infer anger.

Step 1: Clues: crossed arms, frowned, stomped foot -> angry.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Angry.

ar.question:
اقرأ الدلائل عن خالد ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Khalid crossed his arms, frowned deeply, and stomped his foot when his little brother knocked over his tall block tower on purpose.
بماذا يشعر خالد؟
ar.hint: عقد الذراعين والعبوس وضرب القدم بالأرض علامات غضب واضحة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: لغة الجسد (العبوس وضرب القدم) تعبّر عن الغضب.

الخطوة 1: عقد الذراعين والعبوس وضرب القدم بالأرض تدل على الغضب (Angry).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Angry.

en.question:
Read the clues about Reem on stage and answer the question.
Before reading her poem to the whole school, Reem peeked behind the curtain. Her hands felt shaky, and she took three slow deep breaths to calm down.
How does Reem feel before going on stage?
en.hint: Shaky hands and taking deep breaths to calm down are clues.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Recognize nervousness from shaky hands and calming breaths.

Step 1: Clues: peeking behind curtain, shaky hands, deep breaths to calm down -> nervous.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Nervous.

ar.question:
اقرأ الدلائل عن ريم على المسرح ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Before reading her poem to the whole school, Reem peeked behind the curtain. Her hands felt shaky, and she took three slow deep breaths to calm down.
بماذا تشعر ريم قبل الصعود إلى المسرح؟
ar.hint: ارتجاف اليدين وأخذ أنفاس عميقة لتهدئة النفس دلائل واضحة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نربط ارتجاف اليدين وأخذ نفس عميق لتهدئة التوتر بشعور القلق/التوتر.

الخطوة 1: ارتجاف اليدين والتنفس العميق قبل الإلقاء أمام المدرسة يدلان على التوتر (Nervous).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Nervous.

en.question:
Read the clues about Bader after gym class and answer the question.
Bader ran four laps around the hot sunny track. He wiped sweat off his forehead with his sleeve and hurried straight toward the water fountain.
What does Bader need right away?
en.hint: Why does someone hurry to the water fountain after running in the heat?
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Infer thirst and need for water from sweat and running to the fountain.

Step 1: Clues: ran four laps in heat, sweaty, hurried to water fountain -> needs water.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: A cold drink of water.

ar.question:
اقرأ الدلائل عن بدر بعد حصة الرياضة ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Bader ran four laps around the hot sunny track. He wiped sweat off his forehead with his sleeve and hurried straight toward the water fountain.
ما الذي يحتاجه بدر فورًا؟
ar.hint: لماذا يسرع طالب إلى نافورة الشرب بعد الجري في الحر؟
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: التعرّق والاتجاه لنافورة الماء بعد الجري يدلان على حاجته للماء.

الخطوة 1: بعد الجري في الجو الحار والذهاب مسرعًا لبرادة الماء، هو يحتاج إلى شرب ماء بارد.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: A cold drink of water.

en.question:
Read the clues carefully and infer what kind of person Huda is.
When a new student dropped her folder in the busy hallway, papers flew everywhere. While other students walked past, Huda knelt down right away, gathered every sheet, and walked the new girl to Room 3.
Which word BEST describes Huda from her actions?
en.hint: Look at what Huda chose to do when others kept walking.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Infer character trait from altruistic action.

Step 1: She stopped to gather the papers and guided the new girl -> kind and helpful.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Kind and helpful.

ar.question:
اقرأ الدلائل بعناية واستنتج صفة هدى.
When a new student dropped her folder in the busy hallway, papers flew everywhere. While other students walked past, Huda knelt down right away, gathered every sheet, and walked the new girl to Room 3.
أي صفة تصف هدى وصفًا أدق من خلال تصرفها؟
ar.hint: انظر إلى ما فعلته هدى عندما واصل الآخرون المشي دون مساعدة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نستنتج صفة الشخصية من أفعالها تجاه الطالبة الجديدة.

الخطوة 1: مساعدتها للطالبة الجديدة وجمع أوراقها ومرافقتها للفصل تدل على أنها لطيفة ومتعاونة (Kind and helpful).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Kind and helpful.

en.question:
Read the clues carefully and infer how Kareem feels.
Kareem stared out the rainy window for half an hour. He tossed a ball lightly from hand to hand, sighed twice, and complained, 'Nothing fun is on, and I already read all my books!'
How does Kareem feel?
en.hint: Notice the sighing and saying 'Nothing fun is on' with nothing left to do.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Connect sighing, restlessness, and 'nothing fun' to boredom.

Step 1: Clues: staring out window, sighing, saying nothing fun is on -> bored.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Bored.

ar.question:
اقرأ الدلائل بعناية واستنتج شعور كريم.
Kareem stared out the rainy window for half an hour. He tossed a ball lightly from hand to hand, sighed twice, and complained, 'Nothing fun is on, and I already read all my books!'
بماذا يشعر كريم؟
ar.hint: انتبه للتنهد وقوله إنه لا يوجد ما يسلّيه وقد قرأ كل كتبه.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نستنتج الملل من التنهد والشكوى من عدم وجود شيء ممتع.

الخطوة 1: التنهد والتذمر من انتهاء كل الأنشطة يدلان على الملل (Bored).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Bored.

en.question:
Read the clues about Noura's first day at the pool and answer.
At first, Noura stood at the top of the pool steps and gripped the metal rail. Then she watched her sister float safely, let go of the rail, and kicked across the shallow lane by herself!
How did Noura's feelings change from the start to the end?
en.hint: Compare gripping the rail nervously at first with letting go and swimming alone.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Track emotional shift across the two sentences.

Step 1: Start: gripped rail (nervous/afraid).

Step 2: End: let go and kicked across alone (brave/confident).

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: From nervous to brave.

ar.question:
اقرأ الدلائل عن يوم نورة الأول في المسبح ثم أجب.
At first, Noura stood at the top of the pool steps and gripped the metal rail. Then she watched her sister float safely, let go of the rail, and kicked across the shallow lane by herself!
كيف تغيّر شعور نورة من البداية إلى النهاية؟
ar.hint: قارن بين تمسكها بالدرابزين بتردد في البداية وسباحتها وحدها في النهاية.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نتتبع تحوّل الشعور بين البداية والنهاية.

الخطوة 1: في البداية كانت متوترة وتتمسك بالدرابزين، وفي النهاية أصبحت شجاعة وسبحت وحدها (From nervous to brave).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: From nervous to brave.

en.question:
Read the clues about Salman and answer the question.
Salman finished coloring his thank-you card for Grandma. He wrote 'Thank you for baking my favorite honey cake!' inside, slipped it into an envelope, and ran happily to give it to her.
How does Salman feel toward his grandmother?
en.hint: Think about why someone makes a special thank-you card.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Connect making a thank-you card for a kind deed to gratitude.

Step 1: He wrote 'Thank you' for her cake and ran happily -> grateful and loving.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Grateful and loving.

ar.question:
اقرأ الدلائل عن سلمان ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Salman finished coloring his thank-you card for Grandma. He wrote 'Thank you for baking my favorite honey cake!' inside, slipped it into an envelope, and ran happily to give it to her.
ما الشعور الذي يعبّر عنه سلمان تجاه جدته؟
ar.hint: فكّر لماذا يصنع طفل بطاقة شكر خاصة لجدته.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: صناعة بطاقة شكر وكتابة عبارة الامتنان تدل على الامتنان والمحبة.

الخطوة 1: كتابة بطاقة شكر للجدة على كعكتها تعبّر عن الامتنان والمحبة (Grateful and loving).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Grateful and loving.

correct_answer: Could you please help me understand this problem?

en.question:
Read the clues about Yara's math homework and predict her next action.
Yara looked at the last word problem for five minutes and scratched her head. She tried drawing circles on scratch paper, still couldn't see the answer, and walked toward her big brother who was reading nearby.
What will Yara most likely say to her brother?
options: Please turn up the loud television volume.
Look, I finished every problem in one minute!
Would you like to play soccer outside now?
Could you please help me understand this problem?
en.hint: Notice she is stuck on the last problem and walking over to her older brother.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Infer the purpose of approaching an older sibling when stuck on homework.

Step 1: She cannot solve the problem on her own and approaches her brother -> to ask for help.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Could you please help me understand this problem?

ar.question:
اقرأ الدلائل عن واجب يارا وتوقّع خطوتها التالية.
Yara looked at the last word problem for five minutes and scratched her head. She tried drawing circles on scratch paper, still couldn't see the answer, and walked toward her big brother who was reading nearby.
ما الذي ستقوله يارا لأخيها على الأرجح؟
options: Please turn up the loud television volume.
Look, I finished every problem in one minute!
Would you like to play soccer outside now?
Could you please help me understand this problem?
ar.hint: لاحظ أنها لم تستطع حل المسألة الأخيرة واتجهت نحو أخيها الأكبر.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: عندما عجزت عن الحل واتجهت لأخيها، فمن الطبيعي أن تطلب مساعدته.

الخطوة 1: توجّهها لأخيها بعد تعثّرها في المسألة يدل على أنها ستطلب منه شرحها ومساعدتها.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Could you please help me understand this problem?

correct_answer: Fold a big sheet of paper in half

en.question:
Read the craft instructions and look at the strip.
How to Make a Paper Hat: Step 1: Fold a big sheet of paper in half. Step 2: Fold the top two corners down to meet in the middle. Step 3: Fold the bottom edges up on both sides.
What do you do in Step 1?
options: Cut the paper into tiny squares
Fold a big sheet of paper in half
Glue red stars onto the sides
en.hint: Read the exact words after 'Step 1:'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Follow numbered imperative steps sequentially.

en.question:

School Fire Drill: Step 1: Stop working at once when the bell rings and leave bags behind. Step 2: Walk quietly in a single line behind your teacher. Step 3: Stand still on your class spot in the yard for roll call.
Which action follows EVERY rule of the fire drill?
options: Talking loudly with friends during roll call
Running past your teacher to reach the yard first
Leaving your backpack and walking quietly in line
Stopping to pack every book into your bag
en.hint: Check all three steps: leave bags, walk quietly in line, stand still for roll call.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Verify an option satisfies all constraints in Steps 1–3.

Step 1: Step 1: Leave bags behind.

A compass is a handy little tool for hikers in the outdoors. Its tiny magnetic needle always spins to point toward the north. Even on cloudy days when the sun is hidden, hikers can use a compass to stay on the right trail.
Which statement is a SMALL DETAIL from the paragraph?
options: A compass is a useful guide for outdoor hikers.
Hikers rely on compasses to travel safely.
Navigation tools help travelers find their path.
The compass needle points toward the north.
en.hint: Pick the sentence that describes one specific part of the compass.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Distinguish the specific mechanism detail from general main-idea statements.

Step 1: 'The compass needle points toward the north' is one specific detail on the map.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: The compass needle points toward the north.

A compass is a handy little tool for hikers in the outdoors. Its tiny magnetic needle always spins to point toward the north. Even on cloudy days when the sun is hidden, hikers can use a compass to stay on the right trail.
أي عبارة تمثّل تفصيلاً صغيرًا ورد في الفقرة؟
options: A compass is a useful guide for outdoor hikers.
Hikers rely on compasses to travel safely.
Navigation tools help travelers find their path.
The compass needle points toward the north.
ar.hint: اختر الجملة التي تصف جزءًا محددًا واحدًا من البوصلة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: التفصيل الصغير يصف عمل الإبرة المغناطيسية تحديدًا.

الخطوة 1: إشارة الإبرة نحو الشمال تفصيل محدد داخل الفقرة يدعم الفكرة الرئيسة عن فائدة البوصلة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: The compass needle points toward the north.

en.question:
Read the paragraph and look at the Main Idea Map.
Reading aloud every evening builds strong English skills. Hearing each word helps you pronounce tricky sounds clearly. Talking about the pictures with a parent also grows your vocabulary day by day.
Which sentence BEST expresses the MAIN IDEA?
options: Some English sounds are very tricky.
Books have colorful pictures on every page.
Parents like looking at funny pictures.
Reading aloud daily improves your English in several ways.
en.hint: Notice how Sentence 1 introduces the main habit, and Sentences 2–3 give two benefits.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Select the broad topic sentence linking pronunciation and vocabulary gains.

Step 1: Pronunciation and vocabulary growth are details proving that reading aloud builds English skills.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Reading aloud daily improves your English in several ways.

options: Some English sounds are very tricky.
Books have colorful pictures on every page.
Parents like looking at funny pictures.
Reading aloud daily improves your English in several ways.
ar.hint: لاحظ أن الجملة الأولى تقدم العادة الرئيسة، والجملتين 2 و3 تذكران فائدتين لها.
ar.explanation:

en.question:
Read carefully! The main idea is NOT in the first sentence.
Did you ever notice tiny holes in old desert rocks? Strong winds lift sand grains and blast them softly against cliff walls. Over thousands of years, wind and sand carve tall stone arches and smooth caves. Wind slowly shapes the desert land.
Which sentence states the MAIN IDEA of the paragraph?
options: People like visiting smooth stone caves.
Sand grains fly softly in the air.
There are tiny holes in desert rocks.
Wind slowly shapes desert rocks over time.
en.hint: Look at the LAST sentence—it pulls all the earlier details together!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Recognize a concluding main idea sentence at the end of a paragraph.

Step 1: Sentence 1 is a hook question; Sentences 2–3 give details; Sentence 4 states the main idea.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Wind slowly shapes desert rocks over time.

اقرأ بعناية! الفكرة الرئيسة ليست في الجملة الأولى هذه المرة.
Did you ever notice tiny holes in old desert rocks? Strong winds lift sand grains and blast them softly against cliff walls. Over thousands of years, wind and sand carve tall stone arches and smooth caves. Wind slowly shapes the desert land.
أي جملة تذكر الفكرة الرئيسة للفقرة؟
options: People like visiting smooth stone caves.
Sand grains fly softly in the air.
There are tiny holes in desert rocks.
Wind slowly shapes desert rocks over time.
ar.hint: انظر إلى الجملة الأخيرة؛ فهي تجمع كل التفاصيل السابقة في فكرة واحدة!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: أحيانًا تأتي الفكرة الرئيسة في ختام الفقرة لا في بدايتها.

الخطوة 1: السؤال الأول تمهيد، والجملتان التاليتان تفاصيل، والخاتمة هي الفكرة الرئيسة: الرياح تشكّل صخور الصحراء ببطء.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Wind slowly shapes desert rocks over time.

en.question:
Read the paragraph carefully and check the Idea Map.
Before plastic bottles existed, travelers carried water in woven goat-skin bags. Glass jars stayed clean, yet they broke easily on bumpy trails. Today, lightweight metal flasks keep water cool without breaking or leaking.
Which detail does NOT support the idea of 'How Water Containers Improved'?
options: Plastic cups come in bright neon colors.
Metal flasks keep water cool without breaking.
Glass jars broke easily on bumpy trails.
Goat-skin bags were used before plastic.
en.hint: Check which choice is NOT even mentioned in the paragraph!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Eliminate details present in the paragraph to find the unsupported one.

Step 1: Goat-skin bags, breakable glass jars, and sturdy metal flasks are all in the text.

Step 2: Neon plastic cups never appear in the paragraph.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Plastic cups come in bright neon colors.

Before plastic bottles existed, travelers carried water in woven goat-skin bags. Glass jars stayed clean, yet they broke easily on bumpy trails. Today, lightweight metal flasks keep water cool without breaking or leaking.
أي تفصيل لا يدعم فكرة «تطور أوعية حمل الماء»؟
options: Plastic cups come in bright neon colors.
Metal flasks keep water cool without breaking.
Glass jars broke easily on bumpy trails.
Goat-skin bags were used before plastic.
ar.hint: تحقق أي خيار لم يُذكر أصلاً في الفقرة!

الخطوة 1: جرب الماء والزجاج والقوارير المعدنية كلها مذكورة في النص، عدا الأكواب البلاستيكية الملونة فلم ترد.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Plastic cups come in bright neon colors.

en.question:
Read the paragraph carefully and answer the question.
Trees planted along sunny sidewalks give cities many quiet gifts. Thick branches shade benches so families stay cooler in July. Leafy crowns also trap fine street dust and give songbirds safe spots to build nests.
Why would 'Songbirds Need Safe Nests' be a POOR main idea for this paragraph?
options: Because it only names one small detail at the end
Because families only visit parks in winter
Because the paragraph never mentions songbirds
Because trees cannot grow near city sidewalks
en.hint: Compare the whole paragraph (shade + trapping dust + bird nests) to just 'songbird nests'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Explain why a detail-level statement fails to represent the whole paragraph.

Step 1: Songbird nests appear only in the final clause; the whole paragraph is about multiple benefits of sidewalk trees.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Because it only names one small detail at the end.
