en.question:
Read the sentence carefully and check the timeline.
Why ____ Rakan ____ under the table right now? Did he drop his coin?
Which pair forms a correct Present Continuous question?
en.hint: A 'Why' question happening 'right now' puts 'is' before Rakan and '-ing' after!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Form present continuous Wh-question: Wh- + is/are + subject + verb-ing.

Step 1: Singular 'Rakan' + 'right now' -> 'Why is Rakan looking...' (never 'is ... looks').

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: is ... looking.
en.diagram: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 360 145" dir="ltr" role="img" aria-label="Question Now" style="display:block;direction:ltr;max-width:100%;width:360px;max-height:280px;margin:14px auto;background:#ffffff;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1"><title>Question Now</title><rect x="8" y="8" width="344" height="129" rx="12" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.3"/><text x="180" y="29" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#231942">Question Now</text><line x1="36" y1="88" x2="324" y2="88" stroke="#231942" stroke-width="2.2"/><line x1="180" y1="74" x2="180" y2="102" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/><text x="52" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#64748b">Past</text><text x="180" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#0f766e">Now</text><text x="308" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#64748b">Future</text><circle cx="180.0" cy="88" r="7" fill="#dc2626" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5"/><text x="180.0" y="66" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#dc2626">Right now?</text></svg>

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة بعناية وتحقّق من خط الزمن.
Why ____ Rakan ____ under the table right now? Did he drop his coin?
أي زوج يكوّن سؤال مضارع مستمر صحيحًا؟
ar.hint: سؤال Why عن شيء يحدث الآن يضع is قبل الفاعل Rakan والفعل بـ -ing بعده!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: صيغة سؤال المضارع المستمر هي: أداة الاستفهام + is + الفاعل + الفعل بـ ing.

الخطوة 1: للسؤال عما يفعله راكان الآن نضع is قبل الاسم وlooking بعده.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: is ... looking.
ar.diagram: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 360 145" dir="ltr" role="img" aria-label="Question Now" style="display:block;direction:ltr;max-width:100%;width:360px;max-height:280px;margin:14px auto;background:#ffffff;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1"><title>Question Now</title><rect x="8" y="8" width="344" height="129" rx="12" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.3"/><text x="180" y="29" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#231942">Question Now</text><line x1="36" y1="88" x2="324" y2="88" stroke="#231942" stroke-width="2.2"/><line x1="180" y1="74" x2="180" y2="102" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/><text x="52" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#64748b">Past</text><text x="180" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#0f766e">Now</text><text x="308" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#64748b">Future</text><circle cx="180.0" cy="88" r="7" fill="#dc2626" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5"/><text x="180.0" y="66" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#dc2626">Right now?</text></svg>

correct_answer: Amal waters her garden every morning.

en.question:
Read the sentence carefully! Spot the ONLY sentence written correctly.
Remember: Routine signals ('every day') need Simple Present, while 'right now' needs 'am/is/are + -ing'.
Which sentence uses the CORRECT tense and verb form?
options: Amal waters her garden right now.
Amal watering her garden every morning.
Amal waters her garden every morning.
Amal is water her garden right now.
en.hint: Check each trap: missing 'is' before -ing, 'is' without -ing, and routine verb used for 'right now'!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Verify complete auxiliary + inflection matching time markers.

Step 1: 'Amal watering' misses 'is'; 'is water' misses '-ing'; 'waters ... right now' mismatches 'right now'.

Step 2: 'Amal waters her garden every morning' matches singular + routine perfectly!

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Amal waters her garden every morning.
en.diagram: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 360 145" dir="ltr" role="img" aria-label="Match Signal + Verb" style="display:block;direction:ltr;max-width:100%;width:360px;max-height:280px;margin:14px auto;background:#ffffff;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1"><title>Match Signal + Verb</title><rect x="8" y="8" width="344" height="129" rx="12" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.3"/><text x="180" y="29" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#231942">Match Signal + Verb</text><line x1="36" y1="88" x2="324" y2="88" stroke="#231942" stroke-width="2.2"/><line x1="180" y1="74" x2="180" y2="102" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/><text x="52" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#64748b">Past</text><text x="180" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#0f766e">Now</text><text x="308" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#64748b">Future</text><line x1="99.4" y1="76" x2="260.6" y2="76" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="4"/><text x="180.0" y="62" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#2563eb">Every morning</text></svg>

ar.question:
اقرأ الجمل بعناية! اكتشف الجملة الوحيدة المكتوبة كتابة صحيحة.
Remember: Routine signals ('every day') need Simple Present, while 'right now' needs 'am/is/are + -ing'.
أي جملة تستخدم الزمن وصيغة الفعل الصحيحة؟
options: Amal waters her garden right now.
Amal watering her garden every morning.
Amal waters her garden every morning.
Amal is water her garden right now.
ar.hint: تفحّص الأخطاء: غياب is قبل ing، أو is بدون ing، أو فعل العادة مع right now!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نتأكد من تطابق الفعل المساعد ونهاية الفعل مع دلالة الزمن.

الخطوة 1: الجملة الأولى صحيحة تمامًا (مضارع بسيط مع -s للروتين)، بينما الأخريات تحوي أخطاء زمنية أو تركيباً ناقصاً.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Amal waters her garden every morning.
ar.diagram: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 360 145" dir="ltr" role="img" aria-label="Match Signal + Verb" style="display:block;direction:ltr;max-width:100%;width:360px;max-height:280px;margin:14px auto;background:#ffffff;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1"><title>Match Signal + Verb</title><rect x="8" y="8" width="344" height="129" rx="12" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.3"/><text x="180" y="29" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#231942">Match Signal + Verb</text><line x1="36" y1="88" x2="324" y2="88" stroke="#231942" stroke-width="2.2"/><line x1="180" y1="74" x2="180" y2="102" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/><text x="52" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#64748b">Past</text><text x="180" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#0f766e">Now</text><text x="308" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#64748b">Future</text><line x1="99.4" y1="76" x2="260.6" y2="76" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="4"/><text x="180.0" y="62" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#2563eb">Every morning</text></svg>

en.question:
Read the sentence and choose the right preposition of place.
The red apples are sitting ____ the wooden kitchen table.
Which word tells where the apples are?
en.hint: Think about apples resting on the top surface of a table.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'on' for something resting on a flat top surface.

Step 1: Apples sit on top of a surface -> 'on the wooden kitchen table'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: on.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة واختر حرف الجر المكاني الصحيح.
The red apples are sitting ____ the wooden kitchen table.
أي كلمة تحدد مكان التفاح فوق السطح؟
ar.hint: فكّر في التفاح موضوعًا فوق سطح الطاولة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نستخدم on للشيء الموضوع فوق سطح مستوٍ.

الخطوة 1: التفاح فوق سطح الطاولة، لذا حرف الجر الصحيح هو on.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: on.

en.question:
Read the sentence and choose the right preposition of place.
Huda packed her pencils and glue stick neatly ____ her blue pencil box.
Which word shows the supplies are inside the box?
en.hint: When things are inside a closed container, which preposition fits?
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'in' when objects are inside an enclosed space or container.

Step 1: Items enclosed inside a box take 'in'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: in.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة واختر حرف الجر المكاني الصحيح.
Huda packed her pencils and glue stick neatly ____ her blue pencil box.
أي كلمة تدل على أن الأدوات داخل العلبة؟
ar.hint: عندما تكون الأغراض داخل صندوق أو حافظة، ما حرف الجر المناسب؟
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: للشيء الموجود داخل وعاء أو حيز مغلق نستخدم in.

الخطوة 1: الأقلام والغراء داخل المقلمة (pencil box)، فنستخدم in.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: in.

en.question:
Read the sentence and choose the right preposition of place.
Our shy puppy crawled down on the floor ____ the heavy sofa so nobody could reach it.
Which word fits best?
en.hint: It crawled DOWN on the floor beneath the sofa!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'under' for a position directly below something.

Step 1: Down on the floor beneath a sofa = 'under the heavy sofa'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: under.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة واختر حرف الجر المكاني الصحيح.
Our shy puppy crawled down on the floor ____ the heavy sofa so nobody could reach it.
أي كلمة مكانية تناسب الفراغ؟
ar.hint: لقد زحف إلى الأسفل على الأرض تحت الأريكة!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: للموقع أسفل شيء ما على الأرض نستخدم under.

الخطوة 1: الزحف أسفل الأريكة على الأرض يعبّر عنه بـ under.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: under.

en.question:
Read the sentence and choose the right preposition of time.
Our first morning class starts ____ eight o'clock sharp.
Which word goes before a clock time?
en.hint: Exact clock times always use one short preposition: '____ 8:00'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'at' before specific clock times ('at eight o'clock', 'at 7:30').

Step 1: Clock times take 'at' -> 'at eight o'clock'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: at.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة واختر حرف الجر الزماني الصحيح.
Our first morning class starts ____ eight o'clock sharp.
أي كلمة تأتي قبل الساعة المحددة؟
ar.hint: أوقات الساعة المحددة تأخذ دائمًا حرف جر قصيرًا واحدًا!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: قبل الساعات والأوقات الدقيقة نستخدم حرف الجر at.

الخطوة 1: الساعة الثامنة وقت محدد على الساعة، لذا يأخذ at.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: at.

en.question:
Read the sentence and choose the right preposition of time.
We visit Grandma's garden ____ Friday every single week.
Which word goes before a day of the week?
en.hint: Days of the week ('Sunday', 'Monday', 'Friday') always take ____!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'on' before specific days of the week.

Step 1: Days of the week take 'on' -> 'on Friday'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: on.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة واختر حرف الجر الزماني الصحيح.
We visit Grandma's garden ____ Friday every single week.
أي كلمة تأتي قبل اسم يوم من أيام الأسبوع؟
ar.hint: أيام الأسبوع (Sunday, Monday, Friday) تأخذ دائمًا حرف الجر ____!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: قبل أيام الأسبوع نستخدم حرف الجر on.

الخطوة 1: يوم الجمعة (Friday) من أيام الأسبوع، وحرف الجر المناسب له هو on.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: on.

en.question:
Read the sentence and choose the right preposition of place.
My cozy study desk sits right in the middle, ____ the tall bookcase and the window.
Which word fits with TWO objects ('the bookcase and the window')?
en.hint: Look at 'in the middle' and TWO things joined by 'and'!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'between' when something sits in the middle of two objects.

Step 1: Two items ('the tall bookcase and the window') + 'in the middle' -> 'between'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: between.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة واختر حرف الجر المكاني الصحيح.
My cozy study desk sits right in the middle, ____ the tall bookcase and the window.
أي كلمة تناسب الموقع المتوسط بين شيئين (the bookcase and the window)؟
ar.hint: انظر لعبارة in the middle (في المنتصف) ووجود شيئين بعد الفراغ!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: عند وجود شيء في المنتصف بين عنصرين نستخدم between.

الخطوة 1: المكتب في المنتصف بين المكتبة والنافذة، لذا الكلمة الصحيحة هي between.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: between.

en.question:
Read the sentence and choose the right preposition of place.
During hide-and-seek, little Ziad stood completely out of sight ____ the wide front door.
Which word tells where Ziad hid?
en.hint: Where can you hide out of sight at a wide door—at the back of it!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'behind' for at the back of / hidden on the far side of an object.

Step 1: Standing out of sight on the back side of a door = 'behind the wide front door'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: behind.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة واختر حرف الجر المكاني الصحيح.
During hide-and-seek, little Ziad stood completely out of sight ____ the wide front door.
أي كلمة تحدد أين اختبأ زياد؟
ar.hint: أين يختبئ طفل بعيدًا عن الأنظار عند باب واسع؟ في الجهة الخلفية منه!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: للموقع خلف شيء ما بحيث يحجب الرؤية نستخدم behind.

الخطوة 1: الاختباء بعيدًا عن الأنظار في الجهة الخلفية من الباب يُعبر عنه بـ behind.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: behind.

en.question:
Read the sentence and choose the right preposition of time.
Cool mountain winds blow gently over Abha ____ winter.
Which word goes before seasons like 'winter' and 'summer'?
en.hint: Months, seasons, and years all use the same preposition!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'in' before seasons ('in winter'), months ('in May'), and parts of the day.

Step 1: Seasons take 'in' -> 'in winter'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: in.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة واختر حرف الجر الزماني الصحيح.
Cool mountain winds blow gently over Abha ____ winter.
أي كلمة تأتي قبل فصول السنة مثل winter وsummer؟
ar.hint: الشهور وفصول السنة والسنوات كلها تستخدم حرف الجر نفسه!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: قبل فصول السنة والشهور نستخدم حرف الجر in.

الخطوة 1: فصل الشتاء (winter) فصل من السنة ويأخذ حرف الجر in.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: in.

en.question:
Read the sentence and choose the right preposition of time.
The family eats warm dates and drinks Arabic coffee ____ the afternoon.
Which word completes '____ the afternoon'?
en.hint: Remember: '____ the morning', '____ the afternoon', '____ the evening'!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Parts of the day with 'the' ('the morning/afternoon/evening') take 'in'.

Step 1: 'the afternoon' takes 'in' (unlike 'at noon' or 'at night').

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: in.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة واختر حرف الجر الزماني الصحيح.
The family eats warm dates and drinks Arabic coffee ____ the afternoon.
أي كلمة تكمل عبارة ____ the afternoon؟
ar.hint: تذكّر العبارات الثلاث: ____ the morning و____ the afternoon و____ the evening!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: أجزاء اليوم المسبوقة بـ the (morning/afternoon/evening) تأخذ in.

الخطوة 1: العبارة الصحيحة هي in the afternoon.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: in.

en.question:
Read the sentence and choose the right preposition of place.
Ms. Sara pinned our gold star chart flat ____ the classroom wall.
Which preposition goes with something attached flat on a wall?
en.hint: Pictures, clocks, and posters hang ON a wall!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'on' for surfaces including walls, ceilings, and floors.

Step 1: Flat against a wall surface takes 'on' -> 'on the classroom wall'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: on.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة واختر حرف الجر المكاني الصحيح.
Ms. Sara pinned our gold star chart flat ____ the classroom wall.
أي حرف جر يُستخدم مع شيء معلّق أو ملصق على الجدار؟
ar.hint: الصور والساعات والملصقات تُعلَّق على الجدار باستخدام حرف الجر ____!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: الجدار سطح مستوٍ تُعلق عليه الأشياء بحرف الجر on.

الخطوة 1: تعليق اللوحة على سطح الجدار يستخدم حرف الجر on.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: on.

en.question:
Read the sentence carefully! Check BOTH time clues.
Our Grade 3 science fair opens ____ nine o'clock ____ Tuesday morning.
Which pair completes BOTH time phrases correctly?
en.hint: Blank 1 is a clock time ('nine o'clock'); Blank 2 names a DAY ('Tuesday morning')!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'at' for clock times and 'on' whenever a specific day is named (even 'Tuesday morning').

Step 1: 'nine o'clock' (clock time) -> 'at'.

Step 2: 'Tuesday morning' (day named!) -> 'on'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: at ... on.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة بعناية! تحقّق من دلالتي الوقت معًا.
Our Grade 3 science fair opens ____ nine o'clock ____ Tuesday morning.
أي زوج يكمل عبارتي الوقت إكمالاً صحيحًا؟
ar.hint: الفراغ الأول ساعة محددة (nine o'clock)، والثاني يتضمن يوم أسبوع (Tuesday morning)!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: الساعات تأخذ at، وأي عبارة فيها اسم يوم مثل Tuesday morning تأخذ on.

الخطوة 1: الوقت الدقيق (nine o'clock) يأخذ at، وذكر اليوم (Tuesday morning) يأخذ on.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: at ... on.

en.question:
Read the sentence carefully! Check BOTH place clues.
The gray rabbit hid out of sight ____ the tall bush, while the turtle slept ____ a flat rock.
Which pair fits BOTH blanks logically?
en.hint: Can a rabbit hide behind ONE bush? Yes! (Not 'between'—there is only one bush!) And under a shady rock!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Verify semantic & grammatical constraints: 'behind' takes 1 object; 'between' requires 2.

Step 1: 'the tall bush' is one object (ruling out 'between').

Step 2: 'behind the tall bush' and 'under a flat rock' both make perfect sense.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: behind ... under.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة بعناية! تحقّق من دلالتي المكان معًا.
The gray rabbit hid out of sight ____ the tall bush, while the turtle slept ____ a flat rock.
أي زوج يناسب الفراغين منطقيًا ونحويًا؟
ar.hint: هل يختبئ الأرنب خلف شجيرة واحدة (behind)؟ نعم! ولا تصلح between لأنه لا يوجد شيئان!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نختبر المعنى والقواعد: between تحتاج شيئين، بينما behind وunder تناسبان المفرد.

الخطوة 1: الأرنب يختبئ خلف الشجيرة (behind) والسلحفاة تنام تحت صخرة (under).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: behind ... under.

en.question:
Read the sentence carefully! Watch the tricky time words.
Owls hunt ____ night, yet they rest quietly inside hollow trees ____ May and June.
Which pair completes BOTH blanks correctly?
en.hint: Remember: we say '____ night' (just like 'at noon'), and '____ May' (a month)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Pair fixed expression 'at night' with month preposition 'in May and June'.

Step 1: 'at night' is a fixed English phrase.

Step 2: Months ('May and June') take 'in'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: at ... in.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة بعناية! انتبه لكلمتي الوقت المخادعتين.
Owls hunt ____ night, yet they rest quietly inside hollow trees ____ May and June.
أي زوج يكمل الفراغين إكمالاً صحيحًا؟
ar.hint: تذكّر: نقول ____ night (مثل at noon)، ونقول ____ May مع أسماء الشهور!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: عبارة at night تعبير ثابت، والشهور تأخذ حرف الجر in.

الخطوة 1: نقول at night ليلاً، ومع الشهور (May and June) نستخدم in.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: at ... in.

en.question:
Read the sentence carefully! Spot the picture-map clue.
On the shelf, the red clock stands on the left, the globe stands on the right, and the trophy sits right ____ them.
Which preposition describes the trophy's exact position?
en.hint: Red clock on left + trophy in the middle + globe on right = between two things!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'between' when positioned in the middle of two named items ('them' = clock + globe).

Step 1: The clock (left) and globe (right) are two objects, with the trophy sitting between them.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: between.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة بعناية! تتبّع ترتيب الأشياء الثلاثة على الرف.
On the shelf, the red clock stands on the left, the globe stands on the right, and the trophy sits right ____ them.
أي حرف جر يصف موقع الكأس بدقة؟
ar.hint: الساعة على اليسار، والكرة الأرضية على اليمين، والكأس في المنتصف = بين شيئين!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: الكأس يقع في الوسط بين عنصرين (الساعة والكرة الأرضية)، لذا نستخدم between.

الخطوة 1: الترتيب على اليسار واليمين يجعل الكأس بينهما تمامًا (between them).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: between.

correct_answer: Our school picnic starts at ten o'clock on Wednesday.

en.question:
Read the four sentences carefully! Only ONE uses the time preposition correctly.
Check each time phrase carefully: days use 'on', clock times use 'at', and months/seasons use 'in'.
Which sentence is written CORRECTLY?
options: Our school picnic starts in ten o'clock at Wednesday.
Our school picnic starts on ten o'clock in Wednesday.
Our school picnic starts at ten o'clock on Wednesday.
Our school picnic starts at Wednesday on spring.
en.hint: Match: 'at' + clock time ('ten o'clock') AND 'on' + day ('Wednesday').
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Verify both time prepositions in the same sentence.

Step 1: 'at ten o'clock' (clock time) + 'on Wednesday' (day of week) are both correct.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Our school picnic starts at ten o'clock on Wednesday.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجمل الأربع بعناية! جملة واحدة فقط تستخدم حرف الجر الزماني استخدامًا صحيحًا.
Check each time phrase carefully: days use 'on', clock times use 'at', and months/seasons use 'in'.
أي جملة مكتوبة بشكل صحيح؟
options: Our school picnic starts in ten o'clock at Wednesday.
Our school picnic starts on ten o'clock in Wednesday.
Our school picnic starts at ten o'clock on Wednesday.
Our school picnic starts at Wednesday on spring.
ar.hint: طابِق: at قبل الساعة (ten o'clock) وon قبل اليوم (Wednesday).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نتحقق من حرفي الجر معًا في الجملة نفسها.

الخطوة 1: الساعة تأخذ at (at ten o'clock) واليوم يأخذ on (on Wednesday) في الجملة الأولى فقط.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Our school picnic starts at ten o'clock on Wednesday.

en.question:
Read the dialogue and choose the right question word.
Lina: ____ is your English teacher?
Reem: Ms. Amal is my teacher.
Which question word fits the blank?
en.hint: The answer 'Ms. Amal' names a PERSON!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'Who' when asking about a person.

Step 1: 'Ms. Amal' is a person -> 'Who is your English teacher?'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Who.

ar.question:
اقرأ الحوار واختر أداة الاستفهام الصحيحة.
Lina: ____ is your English teacher?
Reem: Ms. Amal is my teacher.
أي أداة استفهام تناسب الفراغ؟
ar.hint: الإجابة (Ms. Amal) تذكر اسم شخص!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: للسؤال عن شخص نستخدم أداة الاستفهام Who.

الخطوة 1: الإجابة تذكر اسم المعلمة (شخص)، لذا نسأل بـ Who.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Who.

en.question:
Read the dialogue and choose the right question word.
Sami: ____ did you put my blue backpack?
Mom: I put it on the hallway bench.
Which question word fits the blank?
en.hint: The answer 'on the hallway bench' tells a PLACE!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'Where' when the answer names a location.

Step 1: 'on the hallway bench' is a place -> 'Where did you put...'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Where.

ar.question:
اقرأ الحوار واختر أداة الاستفهام الصحيحة.
Sami: ____ did you put my blue backpack?
Mom: I put it on the hallway bench.
أي أداة استفهام تناسب الفراغ؟
ar.hint: الإجابة (on the hallway bench) تحدّد مكانًا!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: للسؤال عن المكان نستخدم أداة الاستفهام Where.

الخطوة 1: الجواب يحدد المكان (على مقعد الممر)، لذا نسأل بـ Where.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Where.

en.question:
Read the dialogue and choose the right question word.
Tariq: ____ markers are inside that green jar?
Huda: There are twelve markers inside.
Which question word fits the blank?
en.hint: The answer gives a COUNT ('twelve markers')!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'How many' before a plural noun to ask for a count.

Step 1: 'twelve markers' is a count -> 'How many markers are...'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: How many.

ar.question:
اقرأ الحوار واختر أداة الاستفهام الصحيحة.
Tariq: ____ markers are inside that green jar?
Huda: There are twelve markers inside.
أي أداة استفهام تناسب الفراغ؟
ar.hint: الإجابة تذكر عددًا (twelve markers = اثني عشر قلمًا)!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: للسؤال عن العدد مع الاسم الجمع المعدود نستخدم How many.

الخطوة 1: الجواب يذكر العدد 12، وأداة السؤال عن العدد هي How many.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: How many.

en.question:
Read the sentence and choose the right end punctuation mark.
Did you finish coloring your map of Saudi Arabia___
Which punctuation mark goes at the end?
en.hint: Notice it starts with 'Did you...'—it is asking a QUESTION!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Questions always end with a question mark (?).

Step 1: 'Did you finish...?' asks a yes/no question, so it ends with '?'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: ?.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة واختر علامة الترقيم المناسبة في نهايتها.
Did you finish coloring your map of Saudi Arabia___
أي علامة ترقيم توضع في نهاية هذه الجملة؟
ar.hint: لاحظ أنها تبدأ بـ Did you...—إنها تسأل سؤالاً!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: الجملة الاستفهامية تنتهي دائمًا بعلامة الاستفهام (?).

الخطوة 1: تبدأ الجملة بصيغة السؤال Did you، لذا تنتهي بعلامة الاستفهام ?.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: ?.

en.question:
Read the sentence and choose the right end punctuation mark.
My uncle owns three white camels on his farm___
Which punctuation mark goes at the end?
en.hint: This sentence simply tells a calm fact—not asking or shouting!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Telling (declarative) sentences end with a period (.).

Step 1: 'My uncle owns three white camels on his farm.' states a calm fact -> '.'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: .

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة واختر علامة الترقيم المناسبة في نهايتها.
My uncle owns three white camels on his farm___
أي علامة ترقيم توضع في نهاية هذه الجملة؟
ar.hint: هذه الجملة تخبر بمعلومة عادية بهدوء—ليست سؤالاً ولا تعجبًا!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: الجملة الخبرية العادية تنتهي بنقطة (.).

الخطوة 1: تخبر الجملة حقيقة هادئة، لذا نضع في نهايتها نقطة (.).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: .

en.question:
Read the dialogue and choose the right question word.
Nora: ____ does the Riyadh Book Fair open?
Dad: It opens on Thursday morning at nine o'clock.
Which question word fits the blank?
en.hint: The answer gives a DAY and TIME ('Thursday morning at nine o'clock')!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'When' to ask about time, days, or dates.

Step 1: 'on Thursday morning at nine o'clock' answers 'When'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: When.

ar.question:
اقرأ الحوار واختر أداة الاستفهام الصحيحة.
Nora: ____ does the Riyadh Book Fair open?
Dad: It opens on Thursday morning at nine o'clock.
أي أداة استفهام تناسب الفراغ؟
ar.hint: الإجابة تذكر يومًا وساعة (Thursday morning at nine o'clock)!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: للسؤال عن الوقت أو اليوم نستخدم أداة الاستفهام When.

الخطوة 1: توضح الإجابة الموعد (الخميس الساعة التاسعة)، لذا الأداة المناسبة هي When.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: When.

en.question:
Read the dialogue and choose the right question word.
Badr: ____ is inside that small red box?
Salma: It is a shiny brass compass!
Which question word fits the blank?
en.hint: A brass compass is a THING, not a person or a place!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'What' to ask about objects or things.

Step 1: 'a shiny brass compass' is an object -> 'What is inside...'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: What.

ar.question:
اقرأ الحوار واختر أداة الاستفهام الصحيحة.
Badr: ____ is inside that small red box?
Salma: It is a shiny brass compass!
أي أداة استفهام تناسب الفراغ؟
ar.hint: البوصلة النحاسية شيء غير عاقل (thing)، وليست شخصًا ولا مكانًا!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: للسؤال عن الأشياء نستخدم أداة الاستفهام What.

الخطوة 1: الإجابة تذكر شيئًا (بوصلة نحاسية)، لذا نسأل بـ What.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: What.

en.question:
Read the excited sentence and choose the right end punctuation mark.
Hooray, our class team just won the reading trophy___
Which punctuation mark matches the strong excitement?
en.hint: Look at 'Hooray' and 'just won the trophy'—strong excitement uses an exclamation mark!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Exclamatory sentences showing strong joy or surprise end with '!'.

Step 1: 'Hooray, our class team just won the reading trophy!' shows strong feeling -> '!'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: !

ar.question:
اقرأ جملة الحماس واختر علامة الترقيم المناسبة في نهايتها.
Hooray, our class team just won the reading trophy___
أي علامة ترقيم تناسب شدة الفرح والحماس هنا؟
ar.hint: انظر لكلمة Hooray والفوز بالكأس—الحماس الشديد يأخذ علامة التعجب!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: الجملة الدالة على الفرح الشديد أو التعجب تنتهي بعلامة التعجب (!).

الخطوة 1: كلمة Hooray والفوز بالكأس يعبران عن حماس قوي، لذا نضع علامة التعجب !.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: !

en.question:
Read the sentence carefully and fix the capitalization mistake.
Last week, omar visited a big museum with his class.
Which word in this sentence MUST start with a capital letter?
en.hint: A person's first name is a proper noun and ALWAYS starts with a capital letter!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Proper nouns (names of specific people, days, and cities) must be capitalized.

Step 1: 'omar' is a person's name -> must be written 'Omar'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: omar.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة بعناية واكتشف الكلمة التي تحتاج إلى حرف كبير.
Last week, omar visited a big museum with his class.
أي كلمة في هذه الجملة يجب أن تبدأ بحرف كبير (Capital letter)؟
ar.hint: الاسم الشخصي (اسم علم) يبدأ دائمًا بحرف كبير!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: أسماء الأشخاص تُكتب دائمًا بحرف كبير في بدايتها.

الخطوة 1: كلمة omar اسم شخص، لذا يجب كتابتها بحرف كبير: Omar.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: omar.

en.question:
Look at all four phrases carefully for capital letters.
Proper nouns—like a person's name and a city name—always start with capital letters.
Which phrase capitalizes BOTH the person's name and the city correctly?
en.hint: Check BOTH words in each choice: both the name AND the city must start with capitals!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Ensure every proper noun (person + city) starts with an uppercase letter.

Step 1: 'Sara in Riyadh' capitalizes both 'Sara' and 'Riyadh'.

Step 2: The others leave 'ali', 'dammam', or 'omar/abha' lowercase.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Sara in Riyadh.

ar.question:
انظر إلى العبارات الأربع بدقة للتأكد من الأحرف الكبيرة.
Proper nouns—like a person's name and a city name—always start with capital letters.
أي عبارة تكتب اسم الشخص واسم المدينة كليهما بأحرف كبيرة صحيحة؟
ar.hint: تفحّص الكلمتين في كل خيار: اسم الشخص واسم المدينة يجب أن يبدآ معًا بحرف كبير!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: أسماء الأشخاص والمدن أسماء علم تبدأ دائمًا بحرف كبير.

الخطوة 1: العبارة الوحيدة التي بدأت فيها الكلمتان معًا بحرف كبير هي Sara in Riyadh.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Sara in Riyadh.

en.question:
Read the sentence carefully! Two words need capital letters.
We have an english quiz and a science project on tuesday.
Which choice lists BOTH words that must start with a capital letter?
en.hint: Languages ('English') and days of the week ('Tuesday') always start with capital letters—school subjects like 'science' stay lowercase!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Capitalize languages and days of the week; do not capitalize common school subjects like 'science' or 'math'.

Step 1: 'English' (language) and 'Tuesday' (day of week) both require capital letters.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: english and tuesday.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة بعناية! هناك كلمتان تحتاجان إلى حروف كبيرة.
We have an english quiz and a science project on tuesday.
أي خيار يذكر الكلمتين اللتين يجب أن تبدآ بحرف كبير؟
ar.hint: اللغات (English) وأيام الأسبوع (Tuesday) تبدأ بحرف كبير، بينما المواد مثل science تبقى بحرف صغير!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: اللغات وأيام الأسبوع أسماء علم تُكتب بحرف كبير في بدايتها.

الخطوة 1: كلمتا english (اسم لغة) وtuesday (يوم أسبوع) يجب أن تبدآ بحرف كبير: English وTuesday.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: english and tuesday.

en.question:
Read the sentence carefully and check the sentence ending.
Be careful, a bright red bicycle is zooming fast right behind you___
Which punctuation mark fits this urgent warning BEST?
en.hint: Is this an urgent warning shouted to keep someone safe? Notice no question is asked!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Urgent warnings and commands with strong feeling end with an exclamation mark (!).

Step 1: 'Be careful, a bright red bicycle is zooming fast right behind you!' is an urgent warning -> '!'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: !

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة بعناية وتحقّق من علامة نهايتها.
Be careful, a bright red bicycle is zooming fast right behind you___
أي علامة ترقيم تناسب هذا التحذير العاجل؟
ar.hint: هل هذا تحذير عاجل لتنبيه شخص من خطر الدراجة؟ لاحظ أنه ليس سؤالاً!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: التنبيه التحذيري العاجل ينتهي بعلامة التعجب (!).

الخطوة 1: عبارة Be careful وتحذير اقتراب الدراجة السريعة يتطلبان علامة التعجب !.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: !

en.question:
Read the two-turn dialogue carefully! Pay attention to BOTH answers.
Majid: ____ did you go yesterday, and ____ went with you?
Faisal: We went to the Diriyah museum, and my older brother went with me.
Which pair of question words completes BOTH blanks?
en.hint: Answer 1: 'to the Diriyah museum' (a PLACE!). Answer 2: 'my older brother' (a PERSON!).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Match Blank 1 to place ('Where') and Blank 2 to person ('who').

Step 1: Blank 1 -> 'Where' (for 'to the Diriyah museum').

Step 2: Blank 2 -> 'who' (for 'my older brother').

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Where ... who.

ar.question:
اقرأ الحوار القصير بعناية! انتبه للإجابتين معًا.
Majid: ____ did you go yesterday, and ____ went with you?
Faisal: We went to the Diriyah museum, and my older brother went with me.
أي زوج من أدوات الاستفهام يكمل الفراغين إكمالاً صحيحًا؟
ar.hint: الجواب الأول: إلى متحف الدرعية (مكان!). الجواب الثاني: أخي الأكبر (شخص!).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نطابق كل فراغ مع الجزء المقابل له في الإجابة.

الخطوة 1: المكان (Diriyah museum) يسأل عنه بـ Where، والشخص (older brother) يسأل عنه بـ who.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Where ... who.

en.question:
Read the dialogue carefully! Watch out for 'What' vs 'Who' vs 'When'.
Amal: ____ kind of trees grow in your grandpa's garden?
Yara: Date palms and lemon trees grow there.
Which question word fits right before 'kind of trees'?
en.hint: Notice '____ kind of trees' asks about the TYPE of trees ('Date palms and lemon trees')!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'What kind of...' to ask for the type or category of things.

Step 1: 'What kind of trees...' is the standard English pattern asking for types of trees.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: What.

ar.question:
اقرأ الحوار بعناية! فرّق بدقة بين What وWho وWhen.
Amal: ____ kind of trees grow in your grandpa's garden?
Yara: Date palms and lemon trees grow there.
أي أداة استفهام تناسب العبارة قبل kind of trees؟
ar.hint: لاحظ أن ____ kind of trees تسأل عن نوع الأشجار (النخيل والليمون)!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: السؤال عن النوع يستخدم التركيب الثابت What kind of...?.

الخطوة 1: للسؤال عن نوع الأشجار نقول What kind of trees، والجواب يذكر النخيل والليمون.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: What.

correct_answer: Do Ali and Nora live in Jeddah?

en.question:
Read the four sentences carefully! Only ONE is completely correct in capitalization AND punctuation.
Check the FIRST letter, proper nouns (names/places/days), and the END mark!
Which sentence has ZERO capitalization or punctuation mistakes?
options: Do Ali and Nora live in Jeddah?
do Ali and Nora live in jeddah.
Where does tariq walk on sunday?
en.hint: Look carefully at every name, city, day ('Sunday'/'Friday'), first letter, and question mark!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Verify sentence start, proper noun capitals (Ali, Nora, Jeddah), and question mark.

Step 1: 'Do Ali and Nora live in Jeddah?' capitalizes 'Do', 'Ali', 'Nora', 'Jeddah' and ends with '?'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Do Ali and Nora live in Jeddah?

ar.question:
اقرأ الجمل الأربع بعناية! جملة واحدة فقط صحيحة تمامًا في الحروف الكبيرة وعلامة الترقيم.
Check the FIRST letter, proper nouns (names/places/days), and the END mark!

en.question:
Read the short passage about Al-Ula and answer the question.
Al-Ula is a historic valley in northwest Saudi Arabia. Visitors travel there to see tall sandstone mountains and ancient tombs carved into rock over two thousand years ago. Many families visit in winter because the daytime weather is cool and sunny.
Why do many families prefer to visit Al-Ula in winter?
options: Because snow covers the desert roads all week
Because the sandstone mountains turn bright green
Because all the ancient tombs close during winter
Because the daytime weather is cool and sunny
en.hint: Look at the last sentence for the word 'because'.

Step 1: The final sentence states that many families visit in winter 'because the daytime weather is cool and sunny.'

Step 2: The other options mention green mountains, closed tombs, or snow, none of which appear in the passage.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Because the daytime weather is cool and sunny.

The Arabian oryx is a white desert antelope with two long, straight horns. Its bright white coat reflects sunlight and helps keep its body cool in the hot desert. Today, protected reserves in Saudi Arabia keep hundreds of oryx safe.
How does the Arabian oryx stay cool in the desert?
options: Its bright white coat reflects sunlight
It swims in deep mountain rivers every noon
Its short curved horns blow cold wind
It sleeps inside snowy caves during summer

Step 2: Swimming in rivers, snowy caves, and curved horns are untrue details not found in the text.

en.hint: Read the second sentence carefully and spot which option is absent.

The desert jerboa is a small hopping rodent no larger than a child's fist. It hides in cool underground burrows all day and comes out after sunset to search for seeds and roots. Amazingly, a jerboa gets all the moisture it needs from its food and rarely drinks plain water.
When does the desert jerboa search for food, and how does it get moisture?
options: At noon; from deep desert puddles
After sunset; from the seeds and roots it eats
Early in the morning; by licking tree leaves
Only in winter; from melting mountain snow

Step 1: Sentence 2 tells us it comes out 'after sunset' to look for 'seeds and roots.'

Step 2: Sentence 3 confirms it gets all its moisture 'from its food' rather than drinking puddles or snow.

Hundreds of years ago, Muslim astronomers studied the night sky with a brass instrument called an astrolabe. By measuring the angle of bright stars above the horizon, travelers could find their latitude at sea and know the time of day or night. Many astrolabes had interchangeable metal plates for different cities.
Why did many astrolabes include interchangeable metal plates?
options: To make the instrument heavier during strong storms
So sailors could cook food on the brass surface
So travelers could use the tool in different cities
To cover the stars when the sky became too bright

Step 1: The final sentence directly links the interchangeable metal plates to use 'for different cities.'

Step 2: Cooking, adding weight, and hiding stars contradict the purpose of an astronomical measuring device.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: So travelers could use the tool in different cities.

en.question:
Read the science report on mangrove forests and answer the question.
Along parts of the Red Sea and Arabian Gulf coasts, mangrove trees grow directly in salty shallow water. Unlike most trees, mangroves filter salt through their roots or push extra salt out through special pores on their leaves. Their tangled underwater roots act like a safe nursery where young crabs and small fish hide from larger predators. Coastal rangers plant new mangrove seedlings every spring because healthy mangrove belts also absorb up to four times more carbon than inland forests of the same size.
According to the report, what are two distinct ways mangrove trees handle or benefit their coastal environment?
options: They freeze salty waves in winter and bloom only once every ten years
They absorb less carbon than inland forests and drop salt into drinking wells
They filter or release salt and shelter young marine animals among their roots
They grow only in freshwater lakes and frighten away all tiny fish
en.hint: Check sentences 2 and 3 to verify both parts of the correct choice.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Harder detail questions require checking two facts in the same option without missing distortions.

Step 1: Sentence 2 explains salt filtering/excretion, and sentence 3 calls their roots a 'safe nursery' for young crabs and fish.

Step 2: The distractors wrongly claim freshwater lakes, reverse 'four times more carbon' to 'less', or invent freezing waves.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: They filter or release salt and shelter young marine animals among their roots.

Along parts of the Red Sea and Arabian Gulf coasts, mangrove trees grow directly in salty shallow water. Unlike most trees, mangroves filter salt through their roots or push extra salt out through special pores on their leaves. Their tangled underwater roots act like a safe nursery where young crabs and small fish hide from larger predators. Coastal rangers plant new mangrove seedlings every spring because healthy mangrove belts also absorb up to four times more carbon than inland forests of the same size.
وفقًا للتقرير، ما الطريقتان اللتان تتعامل بهما أشجار المانغروف مع بيئتها الساحلية أو تفيدانها؟
options: They freeze salty waves in winter and bloom only once every ten years
They absorb less carbon than inland forests and drop salt into drinking wells
They filter or release salt and shelter young marine animals among their roots
They grow only in freshwater lakes and frighten away all tiny fish
ar.hint: راجع الجملتين الثانية والثالثة للتحقق من شطري الإجابة الصحيحة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: في الأسئلة المتقدمة، يجب التحقق من صحة كلا الجزأين في الخيار وملاحظة الكلمات المقلوبة مثل more مقابل less.

الخطوة 1: توضح الجملة الثانية ترشيح الملح أو إخراجه عبر الأوراق، وتصف الجملة الثالثة الجذور بأنها مأوى آمن لصغار الأسماك والسرطانات.

الخطوة 2: بقية الخيارات تقلب الحقائق (مياه عذبة، كربون أقل) أو تضيف معلومات مختلقة عن تجمد الأمواج.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: They filter or release salt and shelter young marine animals among their roots.

correct_answer: Because dim red light helps protect people's night vision

en.question:
Read the passage about stargazing in the desert and answer the question.
City streetlights brighten the night sky so much that only a few dozen stars remain visible above busy neighborhoods. By contrast, far away from tall buildings and traffic, dark desert parks let observers spot thousands of stars and even the faint band of the Milky Way. Astronomers measure sky darkness using a scale from 1 to 9, where class 1 means the clearest dark sky. Before joining a desert stargazing trip, visitors are asked to cover bright flashlights with red cellophane because soft red light protects night vision.
Why do organizers ask visitors to put red cellophane over their flashlights?
options: Because the Milky Way disappears whenever someone uses red glass
Because red light turns a class 9 sky into a class 1 sky
Because dim red light helps protect people's night vision
Because white batteries stop working after midnight in the desert
en.hint: Look closely at the final clause of the last sentence.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Separate real causal explanations in the final sentence from plausible-sounding inventions.

Step 1: The final sentence explicitly states: 'because soft red light protects night vision.'

Step 2: A flashlight filter cannot change the sky's light-pollution class (1 to 9), nor do batteries fail or stars vanish from red light.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Because dim red light helps protect people's night vision.

ar.question:
اقرأ النص التالي عن رصد النجوم في الصحراء ثم أجب عن السؤال.
City streetlights brighten the night sky so much that only a few dozen stars remain visible above busy neighborhoods. By contrast, far away from tall buildings and traffic, dark desert parks let observers spot thousands of stars and even the faint band of the Milky Way. Astronomers measure sky darkness using a scale from 1 to 9, where class 1 means the clearest dark sky. Before joining a desert stargazing trip, visitors are asked to cover bright flashlights with red cellophane because soft red light protects night vision.
لماذا يطلب المنظمون من الزوار تغطية المصابيح بالسيلوفان الأحمر؟
options: Because the Milky Way disappears whenever someone uses red glass
Because red light turns a class 9 sky into a class 1 sky
Because dim red light helps protect people's night vision
Because white batteries stop working after midnight in the desert
ar.hint: دقّق في السبب المذكور في نهاية الجملة الأخيرة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نميّز السبب الحقيقي المذكور في الجملة الأخيرة عن الخيارات التي تخلط بين مقياس الظلام ووظيفة الضوء الأحمر.

الخطوة 1: تذكر الجملة الأخيرة أن الضوء الأحمر الخافت يحمي الرؤية الليلية (protects night vision).

الخطوة 2: لا يغيّر غطاء المصباح درجة تلوث السماء، ولم يتحدث النص عن تعطل البطاريات أو اختفاء المجرة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Because dim red light helps protect people's night vision.

correct_answer: Cooler air boosts panel power while panel shade reduces water evaporation

en.question:
Read the passage about floating solar farms and answer the question.
When engineers place solar panels on land, dust storms and intense heat can reduce how much electricity the panels produce. On a calm reservoir, however, floating solar panels rest on buoyant platforms above the water. The cool air rising from the reservoir lowers the temperature of the panels, helping them generate more power. At the same time, the shade from the platforms slows down water evaporation during dry summer months.
What are the two mutual benefits described when solar panels float on a reservoir?
options: Floating platforms sink in winter while land panels double in size
Dust storms clean the glass while fish turn the platforms around
Cooler air boosts panel power while panel shade reduces water evaporation
Hot panels boil drinking water while waves create loud thunder
en.hint: Read the third and fourth sentences to see how the water helps the panels and how the panels help the water.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Understand reciprocal relationships in informational texts by pairing both effects accurately.

Step 1: Sentence 3 states cool air from the water cools the panels so they generate more power.

Step 2: Sentence 4 states shade from the platforms slows water evaporation.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Cooler air boosts panel power while panel shade reduces water evaporation.

ar.question:
اقرأ النص التالي عن مزارع الطاقة الشمسية العائمة ثم أجب عن السؤال.
When engineers place solar panels on land, dust storms and intense heat can reduce how much electricity the panels produce. On a calm reservoir, however, floating solar panels rest on buoyant platforms above the water. The cool air rising from the reservoir lowers the temperature of the panels, helping them generate more power. At the same time, the shade from the platforms slows down water evaporation during dry summer months.
ما الفائدتان المتبادلتان المذكورتان عند وضع الألواح الشمسية طافيةً فوق خزان مائي؟
options: Floating platforms sink in winter while land panels double in size
Dust storms clean the glass while fish turn the platforms around
Cooler air boosts panel power while panel shade reduces water evaporation
Hot panels boil drinking water while waves create loud thunder
ar.hint: اقرأ الجملتين الثالثة والرابعة لترى كيف يبرّد الماء الألواح وكيف يحمي ظل الألواح الماء.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: العلاقة هنا تبادلية بين الماء والألواح: الماء يبرّد الألواح، وظل الألواح يقلل تبخر الماء.

الخطوة 1: توضح الجملة الثالثة أن الهواء البارد فوق الماء يخفض حرارة الألواح فيزيد إنتاج الكهرباء.

الخطوة 2: وتوضح الجملة الرابعة أن ظل الألواح يبطئ تبخر الماء (slows down water evaporation)، بينما بقية الخيارات مختلقة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Cooler air boosts panel power while panel shade reduces water evaporation.

correct_answer: Some internal organs shrink slightly to save oxygen and reduce water loss

en.question:
Read the passage about the sand gazelle and answer the question.
The Arabian sand gazelle, locally known as the Reem, is built for survival in open gravel and sand plains. Although a sand gazelle can sprint at speeds near 70 kilometers per hour to escape danger, it prefers to graze quietly at dawn and dusk when temperatures drop. During extreme summer heat, its heart and liver actually shrink slightly so its body uses less oxygen and loses less water through breathing.
Which statement accurately explains how the sand gazelle adapts to extreme summer heat?
options: Some internal organs shrink slightly to save oxygen and reduce water loss
It migrates across oceans every July to find green valleys
It stops breathing completely whenever sand temperatures rise
It runs constantly at 70 km/h at midday to catch cool breezes
en.hint: Look carefully at the final sentence beginning with 'During extreme summer heat'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Distinguish between a survival escape behavior (sprinting) and a physiological heat adaptation (organ shrinking).

Step 1: The last sentence explains that its heart and liver shrink slightly so it uses less oxygen and loses less water through breathing.

Step 2: Running at 70 km/h is for escaping danger, not cooling down at midday; migrating across oceans and stopping breathing are false.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Some internal organs shrink slightly to save oxygen and reduce water loss.

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة التالية عن غزال الريم ثم أجب عن السؤال.
The Arabian sand gazelle, locally known as the Reem, is built for survival in open gravel and sand plains. Although a sand gazelle can sprint at speeds near 70 kilometers per hour to escape danger, it prefers to graze quietly at dawn and dusk when temperatures drop. During extreme summer heat, its heart and liver actually shrink slightly so its body uses less oxygen and loses less water through breathing.
أي عبارة تشرح بدقة كيف يتكيف غزال الريم مع الحر الشديد في الصيف؟
options: Some internal organs shrink slightly to save oxygen and reduce water loss
It migrates across oceans every July to find green valleys
It stops breathing completely whenever sand temperatures rise
It runs constantly at 70 km/h at midday to catch cool breezes
ar.hint: اقرأ الجملة الأخيرة التي تبدأ بعبارة During extreme summer heat.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نميز بين سلوك الهرب من الخطر (الجري السريع) وبين التكيف الفسيولوجي مع الحر الشديد في الجملة الأخيرة.

الخطوة 1: تذكر الجملة الأخيرة أن قلبه وكبده ينكمشان قليلًا (shrink slightly) ليستهلك أكسجينًا أقل ويفقد ماءً أقل أثناء التنفس.

الخطوة 2: الجري بسرعة 70 كم/س مخصص للهروب من الخطر، والهجرة عبر المحيطات أو التوقف عن التنفس غير صحيحين.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Some internal organs shrink slightly to save oxygen and reduce water loss.

correct_answer: Librarians still rely on old paper index cards to sort returned books

en.question:
Read the passage about the Ithra Library and answer the question.
The library at the King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture (Ithra) in Dhahran rises across four bright floors filled with more than 300,000 books in Arabic, English, and other languages. Instead of using old paper index cards, automated sorting belts quietly return checked-in books to the proper floor within minutes. Students can reserve quiet study pods on the upper levels or attend Saturday storytelling workshops on the children's floor.
Which statement about the Ithra Library is FALSE according to the passage?
options: The library holds over three hundred thousand books across four floors
Children can attend storytelling workshops on Saturdays
Visitors can find books written in both Arabic and English
Librarians still rely on old paper index cards to sort returned books
en.hint: Check the second sentence for how returned books are handled.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Watch for 'Instead of X, Y' structures: X is the thing NOT used!

Step 1: Sentence 2 says 'Instead of using old paper index cards, automated sorting belts' handle returns, making the claim about paper index cards false.

Step 2: The other three statements are all directly confirmed in sentences 1 and 3.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Librarians still rely on old paper index cards to sort returned books.

ar.question:
اقرأ النص التالي عن مكتبة إثراء ثم أجب عن السؤال.
The library at the King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture (Ithra) in Dhahran rises across four bright floors filled with more than 300,000 books in Arabic, English, and other languages. أي عبارة عن مكتبة إثراء غير صحيحة (FALSE) وفقًا للنص؟
options: The library holds over three hundred thousand books across four floors
Children can attend storytelling workshops on Saturdays
Visitors can find books written in both Arabic and English
Librarians still rely on old paper index cards to sort returned books
ar.hint: راجع الجملة الثانية لمعرفة الطريقة الفعلية لفرز الكتب المُعادة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تعبير Instead of X يعني أن X غير مستخدم، وهو الفخ في أسئلة العبارة الخاطئة (FALSE).

الخطوة 1: تنص الجملة الثانية على أن المكتبة تستخدم أحزمة فرز آلية بدلًا من بطاقات الفهرس الورقية القديمة (Instead of using old paper index cards)، إذن الادعاء باستخدام البطاقات القديمة خاطئ.

الخطوة 2: جميع الخيارات الأخرى (أكثر من 300 ألف كتاب، لغات عربية وإنجليزية، وورش السبت) مذكورة بوضوح.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Librarians still rely on old paper index cards to sort returned books.

en.question:
Read the passage about desalinating seawater and look at the sequence strip.
Many coastal towns turn salty seawater into fresh drinking water. First, workers pump seawater into large tanks. Next, heaters warm the water until clean steam rises, leaving the salt behind. Finally, cold pipes cool the steam back into fresh liquid water.
Which step belongs in the blank box (Step 2)?
en.hint: Look at what happens right after 'Next,' in the passage.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Time-order words ('First', 'Next', 'Finally') map directly onto Step 1, Step 2, and Step 3.

Step 1: Step 1 is 'Pump water' ('First, workers pump seawater'). Step 3 is 'Cool steam' ('Finally, cold pipes cool').

Step 2: Between them, 'Next, heaters warm the water until clean steam rises' matches 'Heat water into steam.'

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Heat water into steam.

أي خطوة تناسب المربع الفارغ (Step 2) في شريط التسلسل؟
ar.hint: انظر إلى ما يحدث مباشرة بعد كلمة Next في النص.
ar.explanation:

الخطوة 1: الخطوة 1 هي ضخ الماء (Pump water)، والخطوة 3 هي تبريد البخار (Cool steam).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Heat water into steam.

en.question:
Read the paragraph about date harvesting and look at the sequence strip.
At an oasis farm in Al-Ahsa, workers follow careful steps every autumn. First, climbers gently cut ripe date bunches from tall palm trees. Then, helpers rinse dust off the dates with clean water. After drying, the workers pack the sweet dates into wooden boxes for local markets.
Which step completes Step 3 in the strip?
en.hint: Check what happens 'After drying' in the last sentence.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Identify the final action in a process sequence by checking 'After ...' and the end of the paragraph.

Step 1: Step 1 ('Cut bunches') and Step 2 ('Rinse dust') are already shown.

Step 2: The final action is 'pack the sweet dates into wooden boxes.'

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Pack dates in boxes.

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة التالية عن حصاد التمر وانظر إلى شريط الخطوات.
At an oasis farm in Al-Ahsa, workers follow careful steps every autumn. First, climbers gently cut ripe date bunches from tall palm trees. Then, helpers rinse dust off the dates with clean water. After drying, the workers pack the sweet dates into wooden boxes for local markets.
أي خطوة تكمل الخطوة الثالثة (Step 3) في شريط التسلسل؟
ar.hint: اقرأ الجملة الأخيرة بعد عبارة After drying.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: الخطوة الأخيرة في الشريط تطابق آخر حدث في العملية بعد التجفيف.

الخطوة 1: الخطوة 1 هي قطع العذوق (Cut bunches) والخطوة 2 غسل الغبار (Rinse dust).

الخطوة 2: توضح الجملة الأخيرة أن الخطوة الثالثة هي تعبئة التمور في صناديق خشبية (Pack dates in boxes).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Pack dates in boxes.

Recycling old notebooks saves trees and water. First, machines shred used paper into tiny pieces and mix them with warm water to make soft pulp. Next, screens wash away ink and glue. Finally, heavy rollers press the clean pulp flat and dry it into new sheets.

Ibn Al-Haytham was born in Basra more than a thousand years ago. As a young scholar, he read Greek and Arabic books on mathematics and light. Later, while living in Cairo, he built a dark room with a tiny pinhole to prove that light travels in straight lines.
Which stage of his life belongs in Step 2?

To plant a lemon sapling in your garden, dig a wide hole twice the size of its roots. Next, place the sapling upright and fill the hole with rich soil. Then press the soil gently with your hands and give the young tree a full bucket of water.
What happens right after placing the sapling upright and filling the hole with soil?
options: Pull the roots out into the sun
Press the soil and water it
Dig a deeper hole beside it
en.hint: Read the final sentence beginning with 'Then'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Follow 'Next' -> 'Then' markers in procedural text to locate the final action.

Step 1: Step 1 ('Dig wide hole') and Step 2 ('Set in soil') lead to Step 3.

Step 2: The 'Then' sentence instructs you to press the soil gently and water the young tree.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Press the soil and water it.

en.question:
Read the science text about sea turtles and check the sequence strip.
Every summer, green sea turtles swim to quiet sandy beaches near Yanbu at night. First, a mother turtle uses her flippers to dig a deep nest in dry sand and lays nearly a hundred eggs. She covers the nest carefully and returns to the waves. Eight weeks later, tiny hatchlings break out of their shells and crawl toward the moonlight reflecting off the sea.
What does the mother turtle do right before returning to the waves?
options: She covers the nest carefully with sand
She stays beside the nest for eight weeks
She carries the hatchlings to deep reefs
She cracks all the shells with her flippers
en.hint: Find the words 'returns to the waves' and look at the action just before 'and'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Two actions joined by 'and' show exact immediate order: Action A and Action B.

Step 1: Sentence 3 says: 'She covers the nest carefully and returns to the waves.'

Step 2: She does not wait eight weeks or crack the shells; the hatchlings emerge much later on their own.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: She covers the nest carefully with sand.

She covers the nest carefully and returns to the waves. Eight weeks later, tiny hatchlings break out of their shells and crawl toward the moonlight reflecting off the sea.

She stays beside the nest for eight weeks

Years later, after inheriting wealth from her father, she spent it to found Al-Qarawiyyin in 859 CE, which grew into the oldest continually operating university in the world.

Step 1: First, she grew up in Qayrawan. Next, while young, her family moved to Fez.

Step 2: Finally, years later, she founded Al-Qarawiyyin in 859 CE.

en.question:
Read the passage about honey production and examine the sequence strip.
Honeybees work as a team to make honey inside their hive. First, worker bees fly from flower to flower sucking sweet nectar with their long tongues. Back at the hive, they pass the nectar to house bees, which chew it and add natural enzymes. Then the bees fan the thick liquid with their wings to evaporate extra water before sealing each wax cell.
Why do bees fan the nectar with their wings during Step 3?
options: To cool down flowers outside in the garden
To evaporate extra water before sealing the wax cells
To wake up the worker bees at sunrise
To blow away all the natural enzymes
en.hint: Look at the final sentence starting with 'Then the bees fan...'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Combine sequence understanding with purpose ('to evaporate...') inside the final stage.

Step 1: Step 1 is gathering nectar, Step 2 is adding enzymes, and Step 3 is fanning and sealing.

Step 2: The text explains they fan the thick liquid 'to evaporate extra water before sealing each wax cell.'

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: To evaporate extra water before sealing the wax cells.

en.question:
Read the passage about the water cycle and check the sequence strip.
Sunbeams warm rivers, lakes, and seas, turning liquid water into invisible vapor that floats upward. High in the chilly sky, the vapor cools around tiny dust specks and forms clouds during condensation. When cloud droplets grow heavy enough, gravity pulls them back down to Earth as rain or hail.
What happens right after water vapor rises into the chilly sky?
options: It turns into solid desert sand
It cools and condenses into clouds
It sinks back down before cooling
en.hint: Read the second sentence about condensation.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Trace physical state changes in order: evaporation -> condensation -> precipitation.

Step 1: Sentence 1 describes evaporation (vapor rising). Sentence 2 explains what happens next: vapor cools and forms clouds (condensation).

Step 2: Rain falling happens later in sentence 3 only after droplets grow heavy.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: It cools and condenses into clouds.

Sunbeams warm rivers, lakes, and seas, turning liquid water into invisible vapor that floats upward. High in the chilly sky, the vapor cools around tiny dust specks and forms clouds during condensation. When cloud droplets grow heavy enough, gravity pulls them back down to Earth as rain or hail.
ماذا يحدث مباشرةً بعد صعود بخار الماء إلى السماء الباردة؟
options: It turns into solid desert sand
It cools and condenses into clouds
It sinks back down before cooling

ar.explanation:

الخطوة 1: توضح الجملة الثانية أن البخار يبرد في السماء الباردة ويتكاثف مكونًا السحب (condenses into clouds).

الخطوة 2: الهطول يحدث في الخطوة الثالثة بعد ثقل القطرات، لا قبل التبريد.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: It cools and condenses into clouds.

In the twelfth century, engineer Ismail Al-Jazari designed an amazing water clock shaped like an elephant. First, a perforated metal bowl floated inside a hidden water tank inside the elephant. As water slowly leaked through a tiny hole, the bowl sank over thirty minutes. Before the bowl hit the bottom, a chain pulled a ball that rolled down a track, rang a cymbal, and moved a wooden scribe's pen.
Which event happens IMMEDIATELY before the ball rolls down the track?
options: The metal bowl sinks for a full hour
The wooden scribe moves its pen
A cymbal rings inside the tank
en.hint: Look carefully at the order of actions in the final sentence.

💡 Key Idea: Watch timing traps: 'Before the bowl hit the bottom, a chain pulled a ball that rolled...' orders micro-steps precisely.

Step 1: First, the perforated bowl floats and slowly sinks over 30 minutes (not a full hour).

Step 2: Just before hitting bottom, 'a chain pulled a ball'—then the ball rolled down, rang a cymbal, and moved the pen.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: A chain pulls the ball.

en.question:
Read the science steps for measuring rainfall and check the sequence strip.
Students can build a simple rain gauge using a clear plastic bottle. Before taping a ruler to the outside wall, carefully ask an adult to cut off the top third of the bottle. Turn that cut top upside down like a funnel inside the bottle so rainwater flows in without evaporating quickly. Always place the finished gauge in an open yard away from tree branches before recording daily measurements.
According to the instructions, which action must you do FIRST?
options: Record daily measurements under thick tree branches
Tape a ruler onto the outside wall of the bottle
Have an adult cut off the top third of the bottle
Turn the cut top upside down inside the bottle
en.hint: Pay special attention to the word 'Before' at the start of sentence 2.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Notice 'Before doing A, do B' puts B chronologically BEFORE A even though A is mentioned earlier in the sentence!

Step 1: Sentence 2 says: 'Before taping a ruler..., ask an adult to cut off the top third.'

Step 2: Cutting comes first, taping the ruler comes second, turning the funnel upside down comes third, and placing it away from trees comes last.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Have an adult cut off the top third of the bottle.

Kleija is a beloved spiced cookie from the Qassim region. Prior to rolling the dough into thin circles, bakers mix whole-wheat flour, butter, and warm water and let the dough rest for half an hour. Which step is completed BEFORE rolling the dough into thin circles?
options: Baking the cookies until they turn golden brown
Stamping the dough with a carved wooden mold
Mixing the dough and letting it rest for 30 minutes
Stuffing each circle with date paste and cardamom
en.hint: Check the meaning of 'Prior to' in the second sentence.

Step 1: Sentence 2 says: 'Prior to rolling the dough into thin circles, bakers mix... and let the dough rest for half an hour.'

Step 2: Stuffing, stamping, and baking all happen after the dough is rolled into circles.

أي خطوة تُنجَز قبل فرد العجينة على شكل دوائر رقيقة؟
options: Baking the cookies until they turn golden brown
Stamping the dough with a carved wooden mold
Mixing the dough and letting it rest for 30 minutes
Stuffing each circle with date paste and cardamom
ar.hint: انتبه لمعنى عبارة Prior to (قبل) في الجملة الثانية.

الخطوة 2: الحشو والختم بالقالب الخشبي والخبز كلها خطوات لاحقة.

correct_answer: It hangs upside down and forms a chrysalis

en.question:
Read the passage about butterfly life stages and check the sequence strip.
A painted lady butterfly undergoes four remarkable stages. After hatching from a tiny green egg on a leaf, the hungry caterpillar eats steadily for two weeks and sheds its tight skin several times. Once it reaches full size, it hangs upside down and forms a hard protective case called a chrysalis. Inside that case, its body reorganizes completely, and about ten days later, a winged adult emerges.
Which event happens right AFTER the caterpillar reaches full size?
options: It flies away immediately with colorful wings
It hatches out of a tiny green egg on a leaf
It hangs upside down and forms a chrysalis
It eats leaves for another two full weeks
en.hint: Read the sentence beginning with 'Once it reaches full size'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'Once X happens, Y happens' signals that Y immediately follows X.

Step 1: Sentence 3 clearly explains: 'Once it reaches full size, it hangs upside down and forms a hard protective case called a chrysalis.'

Step 2: Hatching and eating for two weeks happen earlier; emerging with wings happens ten days later.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: It hangs upside down and forms a chrysalis.

correct_answer: Cut a flap in the top lid of the pizza box

en.question:
Read the passage about building a desert solar oven and check the strip.
For a Grade 6 science project, Tariq built a solar oven from a pizza box. After lining the inside lid with shiny aluminum foil to bounce sunlight downward, he taped black construction paper to the bottom tray to absorb heat. He had actually cut a flap in the top lid before gluing any foil at all. Finally, he covered the opening with clear plastic wrap to trap warm air inside while melting cheese on bread.
Which task did Tariq do FIRST when building his solar oven?
options: Cover the opening with clear plastic wrap
Line the inside lid with shiny aluminum foil
Tape black construction paper to the bottom tray
Cut a flap in the top lid of the pizza box
en.hint: Notice the past perfect clue 'had actually cut... before gluing any foil at all'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Even if mentioned in sentence 3, past perfect ('had cut ... before gluing') reveals the earliest event!

Step 1: Sentence 3 tells us Tariq 'had actually cut a flap in the top lid before gluing any foil at all.'

Step 2: So cutting the flap happened before lining with foil, taping black paper, and adding plastic wrap.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Cut a flap in the top lid of the pizza box.

اقرأ النص التالي عن صنع فرن شمسي صحراوي وانظر إلى شريط التسلسل.
For a Grade 6 science project, Tariq built a solar oven from a pizza box. After lining the inside lid with shiny aluminum foil to bounce sunlight downward, he taped black construction paper to the bottom tray to absorb heat. He had actually cut a flap in the top lid before gluing any foil at all. Finally, he covered the opening with clear plastic wrap to trap warm air inside while melting cheese on bread.
أي مهمة نفّذها طارق أولًا عند صنع الفرن الشمسي؟
options: Cover the opening with clear plastic wrap
Line the inside lid with shiny aluminum foil
Tape black construction paper to the bottom tray
Cut a flap in the top lid of the pizza box
ar.hint: انتبه لزمن الماضي التام had cut وعبارة before gluing any foil at all.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: يُستخدم الماضي التام (had + V3) في القراءة لبيان حدث وقع قبل أحداث ذُكرت قبله في النص.

الخطوة 1: تكشف الجملة الثالثة أن طارق قصّ فتحة في الغطاء العلوي قبل إلصاق ورق القصدير تمامًا (before gluing any foil at all).

الخطوة 2: إذًا القصّ كان الخطوة الأولى، تلاه القصدير، فالورق الأسود، ثم الغلاف البلاستيكي.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Cut a flap in the top lid of the pizza box.

correct_answer: Because tall shaded walls blocked direct sunlight

en.question:
Read the passage about courtyard houses and answer the cause-and-effect question.
Traditional Najdi houses often had tall shaded walls around an open central courtyard. Because direct sunlight could not easily hit the narrow ground below, the stone floor stayed cool for hours.
Why did the stone floor stay cool for hours?
options: Because rainwater flooded the courtyard every noon
Because cold ocean winds blew through Riyadh
Because builders buried ice under every stone
Because tall shaded walls blocked direct sunlight
en.hint: Look at the clause starting with 'Because' in sentence 2.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'Because [cause], [effect]' clearly marks why the stone floor stayed cool.

Step 1: The cause is that tall shaded walls prevented direct sunlight from hitting the ground.

Step 2: Flooding, buried ice, and ocean winds are false distractors.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Because tall shaded walls blocked direct sunlight.

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة التالية عن البيوت ذات الأفنية ثم أجب عن سؤال السبب والنتيجة.
Traditional Najdi houses often had tall shaded walls around an open central courtyard. Because direct sunlight could not easily hit the narrow ground below, the stone floor stayed cool for hours.
لماذا بقيت الأرضية الحجرية باردةً لساعات طويلة؟
options: Because rainwater flooded the courtyard every noon
Because cold ocean winds blew through Riyadh
Because builders buried ice under every stone
Because tall shaded walls blocked direct sunlight
ar.hint: انظر إلى الجملة التي تبدأ بكلمة Because في السطر الثاني.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تربط أداة السبب Because بين حجب أشعة الشمس المباشرة (السبب) وبرودة الأرضية (النتيجة).

الخطوة 1: تذكر الجملة الثانية أن الشمس المباشرة لم تصل إلى الأرض الضيقة بفضل الجدران الظليلة العالية.

الخطوة 2: المطر والثلج المدفون ورياح المحيط خيارات غير صحيحة لم ترد في النص.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Because tall shaded walls blocked direct sunlight.

correct_answer: Less sunlight enters, so electricity production drops

en.question:
Read the passage about desert sandstorms and solar panels, then answer.
Dust storms sometimes sweep across desert solar stations and leave a thick layer of sand on the glass. As a result, less sunlight reaches the solar cells, and the station produces less electricity until workers wipe the panels clean.
What happens as a result of thick sand covering the solar glass?
options: The station doubles its power output overnight
Workers replace every panel with wooden boards
The glass panels turn bright red and melt
Less sunlight enters, so electricity production drops
en.hint: Check the sentence starting with 'As a result'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'As a result' introduces the direct effect of the preceding cause.

Step 1: Thick sand blocks sunlight; as a result, 'less sunlight reaches the solar cells, and the station produces less electricity.'

Step 2: Melting, doubling power, and wooden boards contradict the passage.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Less sunlight enters, so electricity production drops.

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة التالية عن العواصف الرملية والألواح الشمسية ثم أجب.
Dust storms sometimes sweep across desert solar stations and leave a thick layer of sand on the glass. As a result, less sunlight reaches the solar cells, and the station produces less electricity until workers wipe the panels clean.
ماذا يحدث نتيجةً لتراكم الرمل الكثيف على زجاج الألواح الشمسية؟
options: The station doubles its power output overnight
Workers replace every panel with wooden boards
The glass panels turn bright red and melt
Less sunlight enters, so electricity production drops
ar.hint: اقرأ الجملة التي تبدأ بعبارة As a result.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: عبارة As a result تدل مباشرة على النتيجة المترتبة على تراكم الغبار.

الخطوة 1: يقل ضوء الشمس الواصل إلى الخلايا الشمسية، فينخفض إنتاج الكهرباء حتى ينظف العمال الألواح.

الخطوة 2: بقية الخيارات تناقض المعنى العلمي الوارد في النص.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Less sunlight enters, so electricity production drops.

correct_answer: Omar watered the cactus too often every morning

en.question:
Read the note about caring for a cactus and answer the question.
Omar wanted his small potted cactus to grow fast, so he poured a full cup of water into the pot every morning. However, desert cactuses store water in thick stems, so too much water caused the roots to rot.
What caused the cactus roots to rot?
options: The cactus had thick stems that blocked sunshine
Omar forgot to water the plant for two years
Omar watered the cactus too often every morning
The pot sat in sunny dry air beside the window
en.hint: Find the phrase 'caused the roots to rot' and look just before it.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Track how 'so' connects an action (daily watering) to an unwanted outcome (root rot).

Step 1: Omar poured a full cup every morning; 'too much water caused the roots to rot.'

Step 2: He watered too much, not too little, and sunlight was not the problem.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Omar watered the cactus too often every morning.

ar.question:
اقرأ الملاحظة التالية عن العناية بنبات الصبار ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Omar wanted his small potted cactus to grow fast, so he poured a full cup of water into the pot every morning. However, desert cactuses store water in thick stems, so too much water caused the roots to rot.
ما السبب الذي أدى إلى تعفّن جذور نبات الصبار؟
options: The cactus had thick stems that blocked sunshine
Omar forgot to water the plant for two years
Omar watered the cactus too often every morning
The pot sat in sunny dry air beside the window
ar.hint: ابحث عن عبارة caused the roots to rot وانظر إلى السبب قبلها.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: فعل cause يربط بوضوح بين السبب (الإفراط في السقي) والنتيجة (تعفن الجذور).

الخطوة 1: صبّ عمر كوبًا كاملًا كل صباح، وبسبب كثرة الماء (too much water) تعفّنت الجذور.

الخطوة 2: لم ينسَ عمر السقي، ولم تكن الشمس أو الساق السميكة سبب التلف.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Omar watered the cactus too often every morning.

correct_answer: Because melting old cans saves 95 percent of the energy

en.question:
Read the passage about recycling aluminum cans and answer.
Making new aluminum cans from raw rock takes huge amounts of heat and electricity. Because melting recycled cans uses ninety-five percent less energy, towns encourage families to drop empty cans into blue recycling bins.
Why do towns ask families to recycle empty aluminum cans?
options: Because blue bins turn aluminum into soft paper
Because recycled cans cannot hold cold juice
Because raw rock costs nothing to dig and heat
Because melting old cans saves 95 percent of the energy
en.hint: Read the reason clause beginning with 'Because' in sentence 2.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Match the motivation ('encourage families to...') to the energy-saving cause.

Step 1: Sentence 2 explains: 'Because melting recycled cans uses ninety-five percent less energy, towns encourage families...'

Step 2: Turning into paper, zero cost for rock, and failing to hold juice are untrue distractors.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Because melting old cans saves 95 percent of the energy.

ar.question:
اقرأ النص التالي عن إعادة تدوير علب الألمنيوم ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Making new aluminum cans from raw rock takes huge amounts of heat and electricity. Because melting recycled cans uses ninety-five percent less energy, towns encourage families to drop empty cans into blue recycling bins.
لماذا تشجع المدن العائلات على إعادة تدوير علب الألمنيوم الفارغة؟
options: Because blue bins turn aluminum into soft paper
Because recycled cans cannot hold cold juice
Because raw rock costs nothing to dig and heat
Because melting old cans saves 95 percent of the energy
ar.hint: اقرأ جملة السبب التي تبدأ بكلمة Because في الجملة الثانية.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: توضح الجملة الثانية السبب الاقتصادي والبيئي لتشجيع إعادة التدوير.

الخطوة 1: صهر العلب المعاد تدويرها يوفّر 95% من الطاقة مقارنة بتصنيعها من الصخور الخام.

الخطوة 2: تحويل المعدن إلى ورق أو عدم صلاحية العلب للعصير خيارات خاطئة تمامًا.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Because melting old cans saves 95 percent of the energy.

correct_answer: Students fall asleep faster and feel more alert in the morning

en.question:
Read the passage about reading before bedtime and answer the question.
Bright phone screens shine blue light that tricks the brain into staying awake late at night. Therefore, students who read a paper book for twenty minutes before bed fall asleep faster and wake up more alert for morning classes.
What is the effect of reading a paper book instead of using a bright screen before bed?
options: Students stay awake all night looking at blue light
Paper books glow brighter than phone screens in the dark
Students fall asleep faster and feel more alert in the morning
Morning classes become two hours shorter every day
en.hint: Look after the transition word 'Therefore' in sentence 2.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'Therefore' signals the positive outcome resulting from avoiding blue light before sleep.

Step 1: Sentence 2 states that students who read a paper book 'fall asleep faster and wake up more alert for morning classes.'

Step 2: Staying awake all night describes screen light, not paper books.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Students fall asleep faster and feel more alert in the morning.

ما أثر قراءة كتاب ورقي قبل النوم بدلًا من استخدام شاشة مضيئة؟
options: Students stay awake all night looking at blue light

Morning classes become two hours shorter every day
