الخطوة 1: تتدرج الفقرة خطوةً بخطوة عبر First و Next و Finally.

الخطوة 2: لا توجد مقارنة بين شيئين ولا عرض مشكلة وحل ولا تحليل سبب ونتيجة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Time order (sequence).

en.question:
Read the paragraph comparing two birds and identify its text structure.
Both eagles and ostriches have feathers and lay hard-shelled eggs. However, eagles soar high across mountain cliffs with wide wings, whereas ostriches cannot fly at all and instead sprint rapidly across open plains on powerful legs.
How did the author organize this paragraph?
en.hint: Notice 'Both' (similarity) alongside 'However' and 'whereas' (differences).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Comparing similarities ('Both') and differences ('However', 'whereas') uses compare-and-contrast structure.

Step 1: Sentence 1 names what eagles and ostriches share ('Both'). Sentence 2 contrasts how they move ('However', 'whereas').

Step 2: This clearly fits compare and contrast.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Compare and contrast.

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة التالية التي تقارن بين طائرين ثم حدّد البنية التنظيمية للنص.
Both eagles and ostriches have feathers and lay hard-shelled eggs. However, eagles soar high across mountain cliffs with wide wings, whereas ostriches cannot fly at all and instead sprint rapidly across open plains on powerful legs.
كيف نظّم الكاتب أفكار هذه الفقرة؟
ar.hint: لاحظ كلمات التشابه (Both) والاختلاف (However و whereas).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تستخدم بنية المقارنة والمقابلة (Compare and contrast) أدوات مثل Both للتشابه و However / whereas للاختلاف.

الخطوة 1: تذكر الجملة الأولى ما يتشارك فيه النسر والنعامة (الريش والبيض)، ثم تبرز الجملة الثانية أوجه الاختلاف في الطيران والجري.

الخطوة 2: لذلك فالبنية هي المقارنة والمقابلة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Compare and contrast.

en.question:
Read the school notice and identify its organizational structure.
Many bicycles leaned against classroom windows every morning because the school lacked enough parking racks, causing students to trip along the narrow walkway. To fix this issue, the student council raised funds for twenty steel bike stands beside the side gate, keeping paths clear and safe.
Which text structure best describes this paragraph?
options: Cause and effect only without any fix
en.hint: Look at the trouble described in Sentence 1 and the fix introduced by 'To fix this issue'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Stating an unwanted trouble followed by 'To fix this issue...' marks problem-and-solution structure.

Step 1: Problem: bikes blocked walkways and caused tripping.

Step 2: Solution: 'To fix this issue, the student council raised funds for twenty steel bike stands.'

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Problem and solution.

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة التالية ثم حدّد بنيتها التنظيمية.
Many bicycles leaned against classroom windows every morning because the school lacked enough parking racks, causing students to trip along the narrow walkway. To fix this issue, the student council raised funds for twenty steel bike stands beside the side gate, keeping paths clear and safe.
أي بنية تنظيمية تصف هذه الفقرة بأفضل صورة؟
options: Cause and effect only without any fix
ar.hint: انتبه للمشكلة في الجملة الأولى والحل المقدم بعبارة To fix this issue.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تقديم مشكلة واضحة ثم اقتراح وتنفيذ حل عملي (To fix this issue) يحدد بنية المشكلة والحل.

الخطوة 1: المشكلة هي تكدس الدراجات في الممر الضيق، والحل هو تركيب عشرين حامل دراجات بجانب البوابة الجانبية.

الخطوة 2: لا توجد مقارنة ولا خطوات زمنية متسلسلة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Problem and solution.

en.question:
Read the weather paragraph and identify its organizational structure.
When a thick fog blankets coastal roads early in the morning, drivers can barely see fifty meters ahead. As a result, traffic slows down sharply, ferry boats wait inside the harbor, and morning school buses sometimes arrive fifteen minutes late.
Which structure did the author use to organize this paragraph?
en.hint: Notice the signal phrase 'As a result' connecting fog to three outcomes.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: One trigger ('thick fog') followed by 'As a result' and multiple outcomes shows cause-and-effect structure.

Step 1: Cause: dense morning fog cuts visibility. Effects: slower traffic, delayed ferries, and late buses.

Step 2: No solution is proposed, and two items are not being compared.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Cause and effect.

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة التالية عن الطقس ثم حدّد بنيتها التنظيمية.
When a thick fog blankets coastal roads early in the morning, drivers can barely see fifty meters ahead. As a result, traffic slows down sharply, ferry boats wait inside the harbor, and morning school buses sometimes arrive fifteen minutes late.
أي بنية استخدمها الكاتب لتنظيم هذه الفقرة؟
ar.hint: لاحظ عبارة الربط As a result (ونتيجة لذلك) التي تصل الضباب بثلاث نتائج.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: وجود سبب رئيس (الضباب الكثيف) تتبعه نتائج متعددة بعد عبارة As a result يعني بنية السبب والنتيجة.

الخطوة 1: توضح الجملة الأولى السبب (ضعف الرؤية بسبب الضباب) وتذكر الجملة الثانية ثلاث نتائج مترتبة عليه.

الخطوة 2: لم يُعرض حل للمشكلة، وليست هناك مقارنة أو خطوات متسلسلة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Cause and effect.

en.question:
Read the biography snippet and determine its text structure.
Mariam started learning calligraphy at age nine after watching her grandfather carve wooden signs. At eleven, she won second place in her city's youth art exhibition. Two years later, she designed colorful welcome banners for her middle school library.
How are the details in this paragraph organized?
en.hint: Track the ages and time markers: 'at age nine', 'At eleven', 'Two years later'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Events arranged from earlier ages to later years follow chronological time order.

Step 1: The paragraph moves steadily forward in time: age 9 -> age 11 -> two years later (age 13).

Step 2: No problem/solution or two-item comparison is presented.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Time order (sequence).

ar.question:
اقرأ المقطع القصير من السيرة التالية ثم حدّد بنيته التنظيمية.
Mariam started learning calligraphy at age nine after watching her grandfather carve wooden signs. At eleven, she won second place in her city's youth art exhibition. Two years later, she designed colorful welcome banners for her middle school library.
كيف نُظمت التفاصيل في هذه الفقرة؟
ar.hint: تتبع علامات العمر والزمن: at age nine و At eleven و Two years later.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تقدم الأحداث من عمر 9 إلى 11 ثم بعد سنتين يُظهر التسلسل الزمني.

الخطوة 1: رتّب الكاتب محطات حياة مريم تصاعديًا عبر الزمن دون عرض مشكلة وحل أو مقارنة.

الخطوة 2: لذلك البنية هي التسلسل الزمني (Time order).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Time order (sequence).

en.question:
Read the passage about desert heat and identify the text structure.
Outdoor playgrounds often grow dangerously hot under midday summer sun, leaving metal slides too scorching for children to use. To solve this challenge, engineers stretch wide UV-blocking shade sails above play areas and replace dark rubber mats with heat-reflecting tiles. Consequently, playground surfaces stay comfortably cooler all afternoon.
Which organizational structure shapes this paragraph?
en.hint: Look at the opening difficulty ('too scorching') and the phrase 'To solve this challenge'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Signal phrase 'To solve this challenge' explicitly marks problem-and-solution organization.

Step 1: Problem: summer sun overheats playground slides. Solution: shade sails and heat-reflecting tiles.

Step 2: It does not compare two playgrounds or tell a step-by-step recipe.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Problem and solution.

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة التالية عن حرارة الصحراء ثم حدّد البنية التنظيمية للنص.
Outdoor playgrounds often grow dangerously hot under midday summer sun, leaving metal slides too scorching for children to use. To solve this challenge, engineers stretch wide UV-blocking shade sails above play areas and replace dark rubber mats with heat-reflecting tiles. Consequently, playground surfaces stay comfortably cooler all afternoon.
ما البنية التنظيمية التي تشكّل هذه الفقرة؟
ar.hint: انتبه للمشكلة في البداية (المزالق الحارة جدًا) ثم عبارة To solve this challenge.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: كلمة To solve this challenge (لحل هذا التحدي) تدل مباشرة على بنية المشكلة والحل.

الخطوة 1: يبدأ النص بمشكلة سخونة الملاعب الصيفية، ثم يعرض الحل عبر المظلات والبلاط العاكس للحرارة.

الخطوة 2: لا توجد مقارنة بين مكانين ولا سيرة ذاتية.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Problem and solution.

en.question:
Read the passage about two writing tools and identify its structure.
Paper notebooks and digital tablets both help sixth graders organize daily study notes. Similar to a notebook, a tablet lets students draw diagrams and highlight key vocabulary. On the other hand, paper notebooks never run out of battery during exams, while tablets allow instant keyword searches across hundreds of saved pages.
Which signal words help prove this paragraph uses a compare-and-contrast structure?
en.hint: Check which signal words actually appear in the passage to show similarities and differences.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Identify the actual discourse markers in the text that signal similarities ('both', 'Similar to') and differences ('On the other hand', 'while').

Step 1: The text uses 'both' and 'Similar to' for likenesses, and 'On the other hand' and 'while' for contrasts.

Step 2: None of the words in the sequence, problem-solution, or cause-effect sets appear as the main structure signals here.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: 'both', 'Similar to', and 'On the other hand'.

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة التالية عن أداتي كتابة ثم حدّد بنيتها التنظيمية.
Paper notebooks and digital tablets both help sixth graders organize daily study notes. Similar to a notebook, a tablet lets students draw diagrams and highlight key vocabulary. On the other hand, paper notebooks never run out of battery during exams, while tablets allow instant keyword searches across hundreds of saved pages.
أي كلمات ربط تثبت أن هذه الفقرة مبنية على المقارنة والمقابلة (compare and contrast)؟
ar.hint: تحقق من كلمات الربط الموجودة فعلًا في النص لإظهار التشابه والاختلاف.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نحدد أدوات الربط الفعلية في الفقرة التي تشير للتشابه والاختلاف.

الخطوة 1: يظهر في النص استخدام both و Similar to للتشابه، و On the other hand للتقابل والاختلاف بين الدفاتر الورقية والأجهزة اللوحية.

الخطوة 2: كلمات الخيارات الأخرى لا توجد في الفقرة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: 'both', 'Similar to', and 'On the other hand'.

en.question:
Read the passage about forest fires and soil, then identify the structure.
When wildfires burn away bushes and tree roots on steep hillsides, nothing remains to anchor loose soil. Therefore, the very next heavy rainstorm washes thick mud downhill into streams. That muddy runoff clouds clear water and makes breathing difficult for river fish.
How is this paragraph organized?
en.hint: Notice how each event triggers the next: fire -> bare soil -> mud runoff -> clouded streams.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: A chain where Event A triggers B ('Therefore'), which causes C, is cause-and-effect organization.

Step 1: Wildfires remove roots (cause 1) -> rain washes mud into streams (effect 1 / cause 2) -> fish struggle to breathe (effect 2).

Step 2: No human solution is offered, nor are two items compared.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Cause and effect (chain of consequences).

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة التالية عن حرائق الغابات والتربة ثم حدّد البنية التنظيمية.
When wildfires burn away bushes and tree roots on steep hillsides, nothing remains to anchor loose soil. Therefore, the very next heavy rainstorm washes thick mud downhill into streams. That muddy runoff clouds clear water and makes breathing difficult for river fish.
كيف نُظمت هذه الفقرة؟
ar.hint: لاحظ كيف يولّد كل حدث النتيجة التالية عبر كلمة Therefore.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تتابع الأسباب والنتائج المتولدة عنها (حريق -> جرف الطين -> تعكّر الماء) يمثل بنية السبب والنتيجة.

الخطوة 1: أدت الحرائق إلى فقدان الجذور، فجرفت الأمطار الطين (Therefore)، مما ضرّ بأسماك النهر.

الخطوة 2: لم يُطرح حل ولم تُقارن شيئان.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Cause and effect (chain of consequences).

en.question:
Read the paragraph about lost-and-found bins and identify the missing transition.
Hundreds of unlabeled jackets piled up in the school hallway every term because owners could not recognize identical sweaters. [ ____ ], the parent volunteer team set up a labeled photo board and iron-on name tags at the start of autumn. Within six weeks, nearly ninety percent of misplaced coats returned home.
Which transition best fits the blank [ ____ ] to match the problem-and-solution structure?
options: Before sewing the very first button
By contrast, on the other hand
en.hint: Sentence 1 states a problem (unlabeled jackets piling up); Sentence 2 gives the fix.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Choose a transition that matches the text's logical shift from problem to solution.

Step 1: 'To address this problem' smoothly links the jacket pileup to the volunteer tag/photo board solution.

Step 2: 'By contrast' and 'Similarly' signal comparison, and 'Before sewing' belongs to sewing steps.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: To address this problem.

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة التالية ثم اختر أداة الربط المناسبة لبنيتها التنظيمية.
Hundreds of unlabeled jackets piled up in the school hallway every term because owners could not recognize identical sweaters. [ ____ ], the parent volunteer team set up a labeled photo board and iron-on name tags at the start of autumn. Within six weeks, nearly ninety percent of misplaced coats returned home.
أي عبارة ربط تناسب الفراغ [ ____ ] لتتوافق مع بنية المشكلة والحل؟
options: Before sewing the very first button
By contrast, on the other hand
ar.hint: الجملة الأولى تذكر مشكلة (تراكم السترات المفقودة)، والجملة الثانية تقدم الحل.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نختار أداة الربط التي تعكس الانتقال المنطقي من المشكلة إلى الحل.

الخطوة 1: تصف الجملة الأولى مشكلة تراكم السترات غير المعلمة، وتعرض الجملة الثانية الحل (لوحة الصور وملصقات الأسماء)، فتناسبها عبارة To address this problem.

الخطوة 2: عبارات المقارنة أو الخياطة لا تناسب السياق.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: To address this problem.

en.question:
Read the passage about how chocolate bars are made and identify its structure.
Turning bitter cacao beans into sweet chocolate takes several careful stages. Initially, workers ferment and dry raw beans under tropical sunshine for about a week. After roasting the dried beans to bring out rich flavor, machines grind them into smooth paste before sugar and milk are blended in.
Which organizational pattern does this paragraph follow?
en.hint: Look at 'several careful stages', 'Initially', 'After roasting', and 'before... blended in'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Process descriptions organized across ordered stages ('Initially', 'After...', 'before...') use time order.

Step 1: The stages proceed chronologically: ferment/dry -> roast -> grind -> blend sugar/milk.

Step 2: It does not solve a crisis or compare two competing products.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Time order (process sequence).

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة التالية عن مراحل صناعة الشوكولاتة ثم حدّد البنية التنظيمية.
Turning bitter cacao beans into sweet chocolate takes several careful stages. Initially, workers ferment and dry raw beans under tropical sunshine for about a week. After roasting the dried beans to bring out rich flavor, machines grind them into smooth paste before sugar and milk are blended in.
ما النمط التنظيمي الذي تتبعه هذه الفقرة؟
ar.hint: انتبه لعبارات المراحل الزمنية: several careful stages و Initially و After roasting و before.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: عرض خطوات التصنيع المتعاقبة عبر الزمن (Initially / After / before) يندرج تحت التسلسل الزمني.

الخطوة 1: تمر حبوب الكاكاو بمراحل متتالية: التخمير والتجفيف، ثم التحميص، فالطحن، فالخلط.

الخطوة 2: لذا البنية هي التسلسل الزمني (Time order).

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Time order (process sequence).

en.question:
Read the passage carefully—it contains both sequence words and a problem—and identify its PRIMARY structure.
For years, heavy traffic outside Al-Noor Primary School forced buses to wait twenty minutes just to drop students off safely. Last fall, school leaders introduced staggered arrival windows for lower and upper grades and opened a second side gate for carpools. Although the first week required extra signs, morning waits dropped to under four minutes by October.
Even though time phrases ('Last fall', 'by October') appear, what is the author's PRIMARY organizational structure?
options: Cause and effect with no outcome
en.hint: Ask what the whole paragraph centers on: a traffic difficulty and how leaders fixed it.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Look at the big picture: time markers show when the fix worked, while the core structure is Problem -> Solution -> Result.

Step 1: Sentence 1 sets up the problem (20-minute traffic wait). Sentence 2 gives the solution (staggered times + second gate). Sentence 3 confirms the solution worked (< 4 min).

Step 2: Time words merely date the fix; they do not make it a recipe or comparison.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Problem and solution.

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة التالية بعناية—رغم وجود إشارات زمنية—ثم حدّد بنيتها التنظيمية الأساس.
For years, heavy traffic outside Al-Noor Primary School forced buses to wait twenty minutes just to drop students off safely. Last fall, school leaders introduced staggered arrival windows for lower and upper grades and opened a second side gate for carpools. Although the first week required extra signs, morning waits dropped to under four minutes by October.
رغم وجود عبارات زمنية (Last fall و by October)، ما البنية التنظيمية الرئيسة للنص؟
options: Cause and effect with no outcome
ar.hint: تأمل محور الفقرة كلها: مشكلة الازدحام الصباحي وكيف عالجتها الإدارة بنجاح.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: في النصوص المتقدمة، قد ترد تواريخ لتأريخ نجاح الحل، لكن الإطار العام للفقرة يظل مشكلةً وحلًا.

الخطوة 1: تطرح الجملة الأولى مشكلة الانتظار 20 دقيقة، وتعرض الثانية الحل (توزيع أوقات الوصول وفتح بوابة إضافية)، وتثبت الثالثة نجاحه.

الخطوة 2: التواريخ هنا لتوثيق وقت تنفيذ الحل فقط.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Problem and solution.

correct_answer: Compare and contrast paired with cause and effect

en.question:
Read the passage comparing fresh-water and salt-water lakes and answer.
At first glance, freshwater lakes and saltwater lakes look alike on a map because both are surrounded by land. Yet they differ sharply in how water escapes. Freshwater lakes usually have an outlet river that carries dissolved minerals out to sea, whereas saltwater lakes—such as the Dead Sea—have no outlet river, so evaporation leaves salt behind year after year.
Which combination of structures works together in this paragraph?
options: Time order paired with safety warnings
Problem and solution paired with fiction dialogue
Compare and contrast paired with cause and effect
Time order paired with problem and solution
en.hint: Look at 'both / differ sharply / whereas' AND 'so evaporation leaves salt behind'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Advanced informational paragraphs often use compare-and-contrast overall while explaining WHY via cause-and-effect ('so...').

Step 1: 'both', 'differ sharply', and 'whereas' compare/contrast freshwater and saltwater lakes.

Step 2: 'no outlet river, so evaporation leaves salt behind' explains the cause and effect behind that difference.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Compare and contrast paired with cause and effect.

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة التالية التي تقارن بين البحيرات العذبة والمالحة ثم أجب عن السؤال.
At first glance, freshwater lakes and saltwater lakes look alike on a map because both are surrounded by land. Yet they differ sharply in how water escapes. Freshwater lakes usually have an outlet river that carries dissolved minerals out to sea, whereas saltwater lakes—such as the Dead Sea—have no outlet river, so evaporation leaves salt behind year after year.
أي بنيتين تعملان معًا في هذه الفقرة؟
options: Time order paired with safety warnings
Problem and solution paired with fiction dialogue
Compare and contrast paired with cause and effect
Time order paired with problem and solution
ar.hint: لاحظ أدوات المقارنة (both / differ / whereas) مع أداة السبب والنتيجة (so).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: يجمع النص بين مقارنة نوعين من البحيرات وتفسير سبب اختلاف ملوحتهما عبر السبب والنتيجة.

الخطوة 1: تبرز كلمات both و differ و whereas المقارنة والمقابلة بين البحيرات العذبة والمالحة.

الخطوة 2: وتوضح عبارة so evaporation leaves salt behind علاقة السبب والنتيجة وراء تراكم الملح.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Compare and contrast paired with cause and effect.

correct_answer: Paragraph 1 presents a problem, and Paragraph 2 presents a practical solution

en.question:
Read the two-paragraph excerpt and identify how the author connects Paragraph 1 to Paragraph 2.
Paragraph 1: Leaving classroom projectors switched on during recess wastes electricity and shortens bulb life every week. Paragraph 2: Starting Monday, two Eco-Captains in each class will check switches before walking out to the courtyard, cutting wasted power without delaying lunch.
What is the relationship between Paragraph 1 and Paragraph 2?
options: Paragraph 1 presents a problem, and Paragraph 2 presents a practical solution
Paragraph 1 describes morning recess, and Paragraph 2 describes Friday night
Paragraph 1 tells an old myth, and Paragraph 2 proves it false
Paragraph 1 compares two projectors, and Paragraph 2 compares two courtyards
en.hint: Notice 'wastes electricity and shortens bulb life' vs 'two Eco-Captains... will check switches'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Multi-paragraph structure often places the problem in Paragraph 1 and the action plan/solution in Paragraph 2.

Step 1: Paragraph 1 explains the waste problem; Paragraph 2 introduces a student-led solution ('check switches').

Step 2: There is no myth, Friday night setting, or product comparison.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Paragraph 1 presents a problem, and Paragraph 2 presents a practical solution.

ar.question:
اقرأ المقتطف التالي المكون من فقرتين وحدّد كيف ربط الكاتب الفقرة الأولى بالفقرة الثانية.
Paragraph 1: Leaving classroom projectors switched on during recess wastes electricity and shortens bulb life every week. Paragraph 2: Starting Monday, two Eco-Captains in each class will check switches before walking out to the courtyard, cutting wasted power without delaying lunch.
ما العلاقة التنظيمية بين الفقرة الأولى والفقرة الثانية؟
options: Paragraph 1 presents a problem, and Paragraph 2 presents a practical solution
Paragraph 1 describes morning recess, and Paragraph 2 describes Friday night
Paragraph 1 tells an old myth, and Paragraph 2 proves it false
Paragraph 1 compares two projectors, and Paragraph 2 compares two courtyards
ar.hint: قارن بين هدر الكهرباء في الفقرة الأولى وتكليف قادة البيئة بفحص المفاتيح في الفقرة الثانية.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: يربط الكاتب بين الفقرتين بعلاقة المشكلة والحل: الفقرة 1 تعرض الهدر، والفقرة 2 تقدم خطة المعالجة.

الخطوة 1: تطرح الفقرة الأولى مشكلة هدر الكهرباء وتلف المصابيح، وتطرح الثانية حلًا عمليًا عبر متابعة قادة البيئة.

الخطوة 2: بقية الخيارات لا تصف العلاقة بين الفقرتين.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Paragraph 1 presents a problem, and Paragraph 2 presents a practical solution.

correct_answer: Sentence (3): Last Friday, my uncle baked cardamom bread while listening to the radio.

en.question:
Read the paragraph about bridges and identify which sentence breaks its compare-and-contrast structure.
(1) Suspension bridges hang their road decks from tall towers using steel cables, whereas arch bridges push weight outward along curved stone or steel ribs. (2) Both designs carry heavy trains safely across wide valleys and rivers. (3) Last Friday, my uncle baked cardamom bread while listening to the radio. (4) However, suspension bridges span much longer distances across deep sea channels than most stone arches.
Which sentence does NOT belong to the paragraph's compare-and-contrast structure?
options: Sentence (1): Suspension bridges hang decks from cables, whereas arch bridges push weight along arches.
Sentence (4): However, suspension bridges span longer distances than most stone arches.
Sentence (3): Last Friday, my uncle baked cardamom bread while listening to the radio.
Sentence (2): Both designs carry heavy trains safely across wide valleys and rivers.
en.hint: Spot the off-topic sentence that has nothing to do with bridges.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Every sentence in a well-structured paragraph must support its central topic and comparison frame.

Step 1: Sentences (1), (2), and (4) all compare suspension and arch bridges using 'whereas', 'Both', and 'However'.

Step 2: Sentence (3) abruptly talks about baking cardamom bread—completely off-topic!

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Sentence (3).

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة التالية عن الجسور ثم حدّد الجملة التي لا تتناسب مع بنية المقارنة والمقابلة.
(1) Suspension bridges hang their road decks from tall towers using steel cables, whereas arch bridges push weight outward along curved stone or steel ribs. (2) Both designs carry heavy trains safely across wide valleys and rivers. (3) Last Friday, my uncle baked cardamom bread while listening to the radio. (4) However, suspension bridges span much longer distances across deep sea channels than most stone arches.
أي جملة لا تنتمي إلى بنية المقارنة والمقابلة في هذه الفقرة؟
options: Sentence (1): Suspension bridges hang decks from cables, whereas arch bridges push weight along arches.
Sentence (4): However, suspension bridges span longer distances than most stone arches.
Sentence (3): Last Friday, my uncle baked cardamom bread while listening to the radio.
Sentence (2): Both designs carry heavy trains safely across wide valleys and rivers.
ar.hint: حدّد الجملة الخارجة تمامًا عن موضوع الجسور.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تعتمد الوحدة العضوية للفقرة على ارتباط كل جملة بالموضوع والبنية التنظيمية للمقارنة.

الخطوة 1: الجمل (1) و (2) و (4) تقارن بين الجسور المعلقة والجسور المقوسة.

الخطوة 2: الجملة (3) تتحدث عن خبز الهيل والاستماع للمذياع، فهي دخيلة وتكسر تماسك النص.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Sentence (3).

correct_answer: It clearly links paving wetlands to two serious downstream impacts: street floods and cloudy bay water

en.question:
Read the science paragraph and determine why the author chose a cause-and-effect structure.
When coastal wetlands are paved over for parking lots, rainwater can no longer soak slowly into spongy marsh soil. Consequently, storm water races straight off smooth asphalt into low neighborhood streets, increasing flood depth during winter storms. Because fewer reeds remain to filter mud, nearby bay water also turns cloudy after every downpour.
Why does the cause-and-effect structure best serve the author's purpose here?
options: It tells a humorous story about reeds racing down neighborhood streets
It clearly links paving wetlands to two serious downstream impacts: street floods and cloudy bay water
It gives readers step-by-step instructions for pouring smooth asphalt parking lots
It compares the cost of asphalt against the price of colorful winter umbrellas
en.hint: Look at how 'When... are paved over' leads to 'Consequently...' and 'Because fewer reeds remain...'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Authors choose cause-and-effect to demonstrate how one human action produces cascading environmental outcomes.

Step 1: Paving wetlands removes spongy soil and reeds, causing both neighborhood street flooding and cloudy bay water.

Step 2: There are no paving instructions, umbrella prices, or funny stories.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: It clearly links paving wetlands to two serious downstream impacts: street floods and cloudy bay water.

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة العلمية التالية ثم حدّد سبب اختيار الكاتب لبنية السبب والنتيجة.
When coastal wetlands are paved over for parking lots, rainwater can no longer soak slowly into spongy marsh soil. Consequently, storm water races straight off smooth asphalt into low neighborhood streets, increasing flood depth during winter storms. Because fewer reeds remain to filter mud, nearby bay water also turns cloudy after every downpour.
لماذا تخدم بنية السبب والنتيجة غرض الكاتب في هذه الفقرة بأفضل صورة؟
options: It tells a humorous story about reeds racing down neighborhood streets
It clearly links paving wetlands to two serious downstream impacts: street floods and cloudy bay water
It gives readers step-by-step instructions for pouring smooth asphalt parking lots
It compares the cost of asphalt against the price of colorful winter umbrellas
ar.hint: انظر كيف يربط النص بين رصف الأراضي الرطبة وبين نتيجتين خطيرتين (الفيضانات وتعكّر الخليج).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تختار المقالات البيئية بنية السبب والنتيجة لإبراز التداعيات المتسلسلة لتصرف بشري واحد على البيئة والمجتمع.

الخطوة 1: تربط الفقرة بوضوح بين تغطية الأراضي الرطبة بالإسفلت وبين فيضان الشوارع وتعكر مياه الخليج.

الخطوة 2: بقية الخيارات لا تطابق مضمون الفقرة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: It clearly links paving wetlands to two serious downstream impacts: street floods and cloudy bay water.

en.question:
Read the dialogue and figure out the meaning of the bold idiom.
Nasser: 'Were you nervous about today's spelling quiz?' Karim: 'Not at all! After practicing every evening this week, the quiz was a piece of cake.'
What does 'a piece of cake' mean in Karim's reply?
en.hint: Use the clues 'Not at all [nervous]' and 'After practicing every evening'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Idioms carry a figurative meaning rather than literal food words; context clues point to the real sense.

Step 1: Karim practiced all week and felt zero nervousness, so the quiz felt very easy.

Step 2: 'Served with sweet tea' takes 'cake' literally, which makes no sense for a spelling quiz.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Very easy to do.

ar.question:
اقرأ الحوار التالي ثم حدّد معنى التعبير المجازي المكتوب بخط عريض.
Nasser: 'Were you nervous about today's spelling quiz?' Karim: 'Not at all! After practicing every evening this week, the quiz was a piece of cake.'
ما معنى عبارة a piece of cake في رد كريم؟
ar.hint: استعن بالسياق: ليس متوترًا على الإطلاق لأنه تدرب كل مساء طوال الأسبوع.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: التعبير المجازي (idiom) لا يُفهم حرفيًا، بل من سياق الجملة الذي يشير هنا إلى السهولة التامة.

الخطوة 1: عبارة a piece of cake تعني «سهل جدًا» (Very easy to do)، وهو ما يؤكده تدرب كريم طوال الأسبوع وعدم توتره.

الخطوة 2: الترجمة الحرفية «قطعة كعك مع الشاي» خاطئة في سياق الاختبار.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Very easy to do.

en.question:
Read the sentence and determine what the underlined-style bold idiom means.
We planned an outdoor picnic in the park, but we had to move inside because it started raining cats and dogs.
What does 'raining cats and dogs' mean here?
en.hint: Think about why they had to cancel an outdoor picnic and move inside.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Moving a picnic indoors signals a heavy downpour, which matches the idiom 'raining cats and dogs'.

Step 1: Heavy rain forces people indoors; two tiny drops or sunny weather would not.

Step 2: Cats and dogs are figurative—never literal falling animals.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Raining very heavily.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة التالية ثم حدّد معنى التعبير المجازي الموضح بخط عريض.
We planned an outdoor picnic in the park, but we had to move inside because it started raining cats and dogs.
ما معنى عبارة raining cats and dogs في هذه الجملة؟
ar.hint: فكّر في سبب إلغاء النزهة الخارجية والانتقال إلى الداخل.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تدل عبارة raining cats and dogs على هطول المطر بغزارة شديدة.

الخطوة 1: اضطروا لنقل النزهة إلى الداخل لأن المطر كان ينهمر بغزارة (Raining very heavily).

الخطوة 2: المعنى الحرفي بسقوط الحيوانات خاطئ، والرذاذ الخفيف لا يفسد النزهة بهذه الصورة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Raining very heavily.

en.question:
Read the short message and identify what the bold idiom means.
Mona stayed home in bed with warm soup and honey today because she was feeling a bit under the weather.
What does 'under the weather' mean?
en.hint: Notice the context clues: 'stayed home in bed with warm soup and honey'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Resting in bed with warm soup and honey shows that 'under the weather' means feeling unwell.

Step 1: Someone staying in bed with soup and honey is mildly ill.

Step 2: The idiom is unrelated to rainbows or running marathons.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Slightly sick or unwell.

ar.question:
اقرأ الرسالة القصيرة التالية ثم حدّد معنى التعبير المجازي المكتوب بخط عريض.
Mona stayed home in bed with warm soup and honey today because she was feeling a bit under the weather.
ما معنى عبارة under the weather في هذه الجملة؟
ar.hint: انتبه لقرائن السياق: بقيت في السرير في المنزل مع حساء دافئ وعسل.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: البقاء في السرير وتناول الحساء الدافئ والعسل يوضح أن التعبير يعني الشعور بتوعك صحي خفيف.

الخطوة 1: عبارة under the weather تعني «متوعّك أو مريض قليلًا» (Slightly sick or unwell).

الخطوة 2: لا علاقة لها بالوقوف تحت المطر أو قوس قزح.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Slightly sick or unwell.

correct_answer: Watch and guard the suitcase carefully

en.question:
Read the sentence and identify the meaning of the bold idiom.
Before stepping inside the bookstore for two minutes, Dad asked Omar to keep an eye on his silver suitcase beside the bench.
What did Dad ask Omar to do?
options: Draw an eye on the silver suitcase
Carry the suitcase into the bookstore
Leave the suitcase behind and walk home
Watch and guard the suitcase carefully
en.hint: What would a parent ask you to do with luggage right outside a shop?
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'Keep an eye on' means watching something closely to keep it safe.

Step 1: Dad goes inside for two minutes and wants Omar to guard the suitcase so nobody takes it.

Step 2: Drawing on it or abandoning it contradicts the situation.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Watch and guard the suitcase carefully.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة التالية ثم حدّد معنى التعبير المجازي المكتوب بخط عريض.
Before stepping inside the bookstore for two minutes, Dad asked Omar to keep an eye on his silver suitcase beside the bench.
ماذا طلب الأب من عمر أن يفعل؟
options: Draw an eye on the silver suitcase
Carry the suitcase into the bookstore
Leave the suitcase behind and walk home
Watch and guard the suitcase carefully
ar.hint: ماذا يطلب الأب من ابنه عند ترك حقيبة بجوار المقعد لدقيقتين؟
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تعبير keep an eye on يعني مراقبة الشيء وحراسته بالعينين حتى لا يُفقد.

الخطوة 1: طلب الأب من عمر مراقبة الحقيبة وحمايتها بجانب المقعد (Watch and guard).

الخطوة 2: الرسم عليها أو تركها لا يتفقان مع الموقف.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Watch and guard the suitcase carefully.

correct_answer: Very calm and not nervous at all

en.question:
Read the classroom note and identify the meaning of the bold simile.
Even though everyone else panicked when the microphone stopped working during the school play, Yara stayed as cool as a cucumber and kept speaking clearly.
What does the simile 'as cool as a cucumber' mean about Yara?
options: Angry because she forgot her lines
Very calm and not nervous at all
Too shy to say another single word
Freezing cold like ice in a salad
en.hint: Contrast 'everyone else panicked' with Yara speaking clearly.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Similes compare two things using 'as... as' or 'like'; contrast clues reveal the figurative trait.

Step 1: Others panicked, while Yara kept speaking clearly—showing she remained completely calm.

Step 2: Cucumbers feel cool inside, figuratively representing calm composure under pressure.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Very calm and not nervous at all.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة التالية ثم حدّد معنى التشبيه (Simile) المكتوب بخط عريض.
Even though everyone else panicked when the microphone stopped working during the school play, Yara stayed as cool as a cucumber and kept speaking clearly.
ماذا يعني التشبيه as cool as a cucumber عن يارا؟
options: Angry because she forgot her lines
Very calm and not nervous at all
Too shy to say another single word
Freezing cold like ice in a salad
ar.hint: قارن بين ارتباك الآخرين (panicked) واستمرار يارا في التحدث بوضوح.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: التشبيه as cool as a cucumber يصف الهدوء ورباطة الجأش في المواقف الصعبة.

الخطوة 1: على عكس ارتباك الآخرين، واصلت يارا الحديث بوضوح، أي كانت هادئة تمامًا (Very calm).

الخطوة 2: لا يقصد برودة حرارة الجسم ولا الغضب ولا الخجل.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Very calm and not nervous at all.

correct_answer: Help strangers feel relaxed and start talking friendly

en.question:
Read the paragraph and identify what the bold idiom means in context.
At the start of summer camp, the new sixth graders sat silently at separate tables because nobody knew anyone yet. To break the ice, the counselor led a quick two-truths-and-a-lie name game, and soon the room filled with laughter.
What does 'break the ice' mean in this passage?
options: Help strangers feel relaxed and start talking friendly
End the camp early because tables were too cold
Make everyone sit quietly without saying a word
Smash frozen water cubes inside a camp cooler
en.hint: Look at the contrast between 'sat silently' before the game and 'filled with laughter' afterward.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Context shifts from awkward silence to cheerful conversation, explaining 'break the ice'.

Step 1: Before the game, students were silent strangers; the game helped them relax and start talking.

Step 2: Smashing real ice cubes does not fit a room where nobody knew anyone.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Help strangers feel relaxed and start talking friendly.

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة التالية ثم حدّد معنى التعبير المجازي في سياقه.
At the start of summer camp, the new sixth graders sat silently at separate tables because nobody knew anyone yet. To break the ice, the counselor led a quick two-truths-and-a-lie name game, and soon the room filled with laughter.
ما معنى عبارة break the ice في هذه الفقرة؟
options: Help strangers feel relaxed and start talking friendly
End the camp early because tables were too cold
Make everyone sit quietly without saying a word
Smash frozen water cubes inside a camp cooler
ar.hint: قارن بين الصمت في البداية (sat silently) والضحك والتعارف بعد اللعبة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تعبير break the ice يعني كسر حاجز الجمود والخجل في بداية التعارف بين أشخاص جدد.

الخطوة 1: ساعدت اللعبة التمهيدية الطلاب الجدد على كسر الصمت والتعارف بمرح، وهو المعنى المقصود بالتعبير.

الخطوة 2: لا يوجد ثلج حقيقي في الغرفة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Help strangers feel relaxed and start talking friendly.

correct_answer: Because she has been working actively and constantly all week

en.question:
Read the conversation and determine the meaning of the bold simile.
All week before the Science Fair, Sara painted posters, tested circuits, labeled jars, and helped her teammates rehearse. Her dad smiled and said, 'You have been as busy as a bee since Sunday!'
Why did Dad compare Sara to a bee?
options: Because she slept through the afternoon without finishing her work
Because she has been working actively and constantly all week
Because she was wearing a bright yellow jacket in the yard
Because she kept buzzing loudly while her teammates worked
en.hint: List everything Sara did: painted, tested, labeled, and helped rehearse.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'As busy as a bee' praises hardworking, energetic effort across many tasks.

Step 1: Sara actively painted, tested, labeled, and rehearsed—matching a bee's nonstop busy work.

Step 2: She did not sleep, buzz loudly, or earn the comparison just from clothing color.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Because she has been working actively and constantly all week.

ar.question:
اقرأ الموقف التالي ثم حدّد معنى التشبيه المكتوب بخط عريض.
All week before the Science Fair, Sara painted posters, tested circuits, labeled jars, and helped her teammates rehearse. Her dad smiled and said, 'You have been as busy as a bee since Sunday!'
لماذا شبّه الأب سارة بالنحلة؟
options: Because she slept through the afternoon without finishing her work
Because she has been working actively and constantly all week
Because she was wearing a bright yellow jacket in the yard
Because she kept buzzing loudly while her teammates worked
ar.hint: تأمّل كثرة الأعمال التي أنجزتها سارة طوال الأسبوع.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: التشبيه as busy as a bee يدل على النشاط والعمل الدؤوب المستمر.

الخطوة 1: شاركت سارة في عدة مهام متواصلة (الرسم والتجربة والترتيب والتدريب)، ولذلك شبّهها والدها بالنحلة النشطة.

الخطوة 2: لا يقصد لون ملابسها ولا النوم ولا إصدار صوت طنين.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Because she has been working actively and constantly all week.

correct_answer: Study hard for his upcoming test

en.question:
Read the dialogue and figure out what the bold idiom means.
Bilal: 'Want to join us at the arcade this afternoon?' Tamer: 'Sorry, I have my final English test tomorrow morning, so I really need to hit the books tonight.'
What does Tamer mean by 'hit the books'?
options: Return his books to the bookstore
Draw comic pictures inside his notebook
Knock his textbooks off the desk
Study hard for his upcoming test
en.hint: Connect Tamer's decision to skip the arcade with 'final English test tomorrow morning'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'Hit the books' is a common student idiom meaning to study seriously.

Step 1: Because Tamer has a final test tomorrow, he stays home to study hard.

Step 2: Literally hitting books or drawing comics would not prepare him for a final test.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Study hard for his upcoming test.

ar.question:
اقرأ الحوار التالي ثم حدّد معنى التعبير المجازي المكتوب بخط عريض.
Bilal: 'Want to join us at the arcade this afternoon?' Tamer: 'Sorry, I have my final English test tomorrow morning, so I really need to hit the books tonight.'
ماذا يقصد تامر بعبارة hit the books؟
options: Return his books to the bookstore
Draw comic pictures inside his notebook
Knock his textbooks off the desk
Study hard for his upcoming test
ar.hint: اربط اعتذاره عن الملاهي بوجود اختبار إنجليزي نهائي صباح الغد.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: عبارة hit the books اصطلاح طلابي شهير يعني «المذاكرة بجد واجتهاد».

الخطوة 1: يربط السياق بين وجود اختبار غدًا وضرورة الدراسة الجادة الليلة (Study hard).

الخطوة 2: المعنى الحرفي لضرب الكتب أو الرسم خاطئ.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Study hard for his upcoming test.

correct_answer: Uncomfortable and out of place in an unfamiliar setting

en.question:
Read the sentence and identify the meaning of the bold simile.
Moving from a tiny desert school of thirty pupils into a huge city school with eight hundred students made Tariq feel like a fish out of water on his first morning.
How did Tariq feel on his first morning?
options: Thirsty after running around a large gymnasium
Uncomfortable and out of place in an unfamiliar setting
Excited to swim in the school's brand-new pool
Bored because he already knew every single student
en.hint: Imagine how a fish feels out of water—and compare that to entering an unfamiliar giant school.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'Like a fish out of water' describes feeling awkward or uncomfortable in unfamiliar surroundings.

Step 1: Going from 30 pupils to 800 strangers makes someone feel unfamiliar and out of place.

Step 2: It is a simile about social discomfort, not literal swimming or thirst.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Uncomfortable and out of place in an unfamiliar setting.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة التالية ثم حدّد معنى التشبيه المكتوب بخط عريض.
Moving from a tiny desert school of thirty pupils into a huge city school with eight hundred students made Tariq feel like a fish out of water on his first morning.
كيف شعر طارق في صباح يومه الأول؟
options: Thirsty after running around a large gymnasium
Uncomfortable and out of place in an unfamiliar setting
Excited to swim in the school's brand-new pool
Bored because he already knew every single student
ar.hint: تخيّل حال السمكة خارج الماء وقارنه بانتقال طالب من مدرسة صغيرة إلى مدرسة ضخمة جديدة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: التشبيه like a fish out of water يعبّر عن الشعور بالغربة وعدم الارتياح في بيئة جديدة غير مألوفة.

الخطوة 1: انتقل طارق من بيئة صغيرة مألوفة إلى مدرسة ضخمة، فشعر بعدم الارتياح وكأنه في غير مكانه المعتاد.

الخطوة 2: لا علاقة له بالسباحة أو العطش.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Uncomfortable and out of place in an unfamiliar setting.

en.question:
Read the story excerpt and determine the meaning of the bold idiom.
When Lina opened the letter announcing she had won first prize in the national essay contest, she jumped off the sofa and was on cloud nine all evening.
What does 'on cloud nine' mean about Lina?
options: Sound asleep on a soft pillow
en.hint: Look at her reaction: winning first prize and jumping off the sofa.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Winning a major prize produces extreme joy, matching 'on cloud nine'.

Step 1: Winning first prize and jumping happily show intense excitement and joy.

Step 2: Airplanes, storms, and sleeping do not match jumping off the sofa after winning.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Extremely happy and thrilled.

ar.question:
اقرأ المقطع القصصي التالي ثم حدّد معنى التعبير المجازي المكتوب بخط عريض.
When Lina opened the letter announcing she had won first prize in the national essay contest, she jumped off the sofa and was on cloud nine all evening.
ماذا يعني التعبير on cloud nine عن لينا؟
options: Sound asleep on a soft pillow
ar.hint: لاحظ سبب شعورها: الفوز بالمركز الأول في المسابقة الوطنية وقفزها فرحًا.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تعبير on cloud nine يعني «في قمة السعادة والفرح».

الخطوة 1: الفوز بالجائزة الأولى جعل لينا تطير فرحًا طوال المساء (Extremely happy).

الخطوة 2: لا يقصد السفر بالطائرة أو النوم.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Extremely happy and thrilled.

correct_answer: He took on too many hard tasks at once and feels overwhelmed

en.question:
Read the dialogue carefully and figure out the meaning of the bold idiom.
Coach: 'Why did you sign up to paint twenty posters, write the script, AND build the wooden stage all by yourself?' Mazen sighed: 'I know—I think I bit off more than I can chew.'
What does Mazen realize by saying 'I bit off more than I can chew'?
options: He finished all three projects effortlessly in ten minutes
He took on too many hard tasks at once and feels overwhelmed
He ate too quickly during the school lunch break
He wants even more difficult jobs added to his schedule
en.hint: Think about taking a huge bite of food that is too big to handle—now apply that to Mazen's three huge jobs.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'Bite off more than you can chew' means accepting a bigger responsibility than you can comfortably manage.

Step 1: Mazen sighed because painting 20 posters, writing a script, and building a stage alone is too much to handle.

Step 2: It has nothing to do with eating lunch or wanting even more work.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: He took on too many hard tasks at once and feels overwhelmed.

ar.question:
اقرأ الحوار التالي بعناية ثم حدّد معنى التعبير المجازي المكتوب بخط عريض.
Coach: 'Why did you sign up to paint twenty posters, write the script, AND build the wooden stage all by yourself?' Mazen sighed: 'I know—I think I bit off more than I can chew.'
ماذا يدرك مازن بقوله I bit off more than I can chew؟
options: He finished all three projects effortlessly in ten minutes
He took on too many hard tasks at once and feels overwhelmed
He ate too quickly during the school lunch break
He wants even more difficult jobs added to his schedule
ar.hint: تخيّل شخصًا يأخذ لقمة أكبر مما يستطيع مضغه، وطبّق ذلك على تولي ثلاث مهام شاقة دفعة واحدة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تعبير bite off more than you can chew يعني التعهّد بعمل يفوق الطاقة والوقت المتاح.

الخطوة 1: أدرك مازن وتنهّد لأنه حمّل نفسه فوق طاقتها بثلاثة مشاريع كبيرة دفعة واحدة.

الخطوة 2: لا يتعلق الأمر بتناول الغداء ولا بطلب مهام إضافية.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: He took on too many hard tasks at once and feels overwhelmed.

en.question:
Read the passage and infer the meaning of the bold idiom.
Normally, our family cooks dinner at home every night to save money for our summer trip. We only eat out at that fancy seafood restaurant once in a blue moon—maybe twice a whole year on special graduation nights.
What does 'once in a blue moon' mean?
options: Only when the moon turns bright blue
en.hint: Check the explanatory clue right after the dash: 'maybe twice a whole year'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Clue phrases after a dash ('—maybe twice a whole year') define the idiom directly.

Step 1: Twice a whole year (compared to cooking at home every night) clearly means 'very rarely'.

Step 2: Literal blue moons or every weekend contradict 'twice a whole year'.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Very rarely.

ar.question:
اقرأ الفقرة التالية واستنتج معنى التعبير المجازي المكتوب بخط عريض.
Normally, our family cooks dinner at home every night to save money for our summer trip. We only eat out at that fancy seafood restaurant once in a blue moon—maybe twice a whole year on special graduation nights.
ما معنى عبارة once in a blue moon في هذا السياق؟
options: Only when the moon turns bright blue
ar.hint: انظر إلى التفسير الذي يلي الشرطة مباشرة: ربما مرتين فقط في العام كله.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: عبارة once in a blue moon تعني «نادرًا جدًا»، وتؤكدها جملة التوضيح (مرتين في العام تقريبًا).

الخطوة 1: الذهاب للمطعم الفاخر مرتين فقط في السنة دليل واضح على الندرة الشديدة (Very rarely).

الخطوة 2: لا يقصد لون القمر الفعلي ولا عطلة كل أسبوع.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Very rarely.

en.question:
Read the conversation and identify the meaning of the bold idiom.
Huda: 'Look at that tiny robotic telescope in the hobby shop window!' Mom checked the price tag and whistled: 'It looks amazing, Huda, but it costs an arm and a leg—more than our whole vacation budget!'
What does Mom mean by saying the telescope 'costs an arm and a leg'?
options: It weighs less than a child's arm
It is broken and missing two parts
Customers must trade sports gear to buy it
en.hint: Notice Mom whistled at the price tag and said it exceeds 'our whole vacation budget'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'Costs an arm and a leg' exaggerates how shockingly expensive an item is.

Step 1: Mom checks the price tag and notes it exceeds the entire vacation budget—proving it means 'extremely expensive'.

Step 2: Nothing is physically broken or traded.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: It is extremely expensive.

ar.question:
اقرأ الحوار التالي ثم حدّد معنى التعبير المجازي المكتوب بخط عريض.
Huda: 'Look at that tiny robotic telescope in the hobby shop window!' Mom checked the price tag and whistled: 'It looks amazing, Huda, but it costs an arm and a leg—more than our whole vacation budget!'
ماذا تقصد الأم بقولها إن التلسكوب costs an arm and a leg؟
options: It weighs less than a child's arm
It is broken and missing two parts
Customers must trade sports gear to buy it
ar.hint: لاحظ تصفير الأم عند رؤية السعر وقولها إنه يفوق ميزانية العطلة بأكملها.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: يُستخدم التعبير costs an arm and a leg للمبالغة في وصف ارتفاع السعر الشديد.

الخطوة 1: مقارنة السعر بميزانية العطلة كاملةً تثبت أن المقصود هو غلاء السعر الفاحش (extremely expensive).

الخطوة 2: لا يعني وجود أجزاء مكسورة ولا المقايضة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: It is extremely expensive.

correct_answer: To show that the students walked almost silently without making noise

en.question:
Read the story snippet and identify what the bold simile emphasizes.
When the museum guide unlocked the quiet fossil vault, the sixth graders tiptoed past glass cases as quiet as mice so they wouldn't disturb the researcher recording audio notes in the corner.
Why does the author use the simile 'as quiet as mice'?
options: To criticize the students for whispering too loudly near the guide
To suggest that hungry mice were hiding inside the glass fossil cases
To show that the students walked almost silently without making noise
To compare the museum vault to a crowded noisy subway station
en.hint: Look at the verb 'tiptoed' and the reason 'so they wouldn't disturb the researcher'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Authors use similes like 'as quiet as mice' to create a vivid image of a specific behavior (near-silence).

Step 1: The students tiptoed carefully not to disturb audio recording, so 'as quiet as mice' emphasizes their near-silence.

Step 2: No real mice are inside the fossils, and they were not noisy.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: To show that the students walked almost silently without making noise.

ar.question:
اقرأ المقطع التالي ثم حدّد الصفة التي يؤكدها التشبيه المكتوب بخط عريض.
When the museum guide unlocked the quiet fossil vault, the sixth graders tiptoed past glass cases as quiet as mice so they wouldn't disturb the researcher recording audio notes in the corner.
لماذا استخدم الكاتب التشبيه as quiet as mice؟
options: To criticize the students for whispering too loudly near the guide
To suggest that hungry mice were hiding inside the glass fossil cases
To show that the students walked almost silently without making noise
To compare the museum vault to a crowded noisy subway station
ar.hint: انظر إلى الفعل tiptoed (مشوا على أطراف أصابعهم) وإلى سبب عدم إزعاج الباحث.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: يبرز التشبيه هدوء الطلاب التام أثناء السير على أطراف الأصابع احترامًا لتسجيل الباحث.

الخطوة 1: مشى الطلاب بصمت شبه تام دون إزعاج، وهذا ما يصوّره تشبيههم بالفئران الساكنة.

الخطوة 2: لا توجد فئران حقيقية داخل الخزائن ولا ضوضاء.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: To show that the students walked almost silently without making noise.

correct_answer: Sharing the same understanding/plan — 'Before the trip starts, let's meet to get everyone on the same page about pickup times.'

en.question:
Read the passage carefully—and choose the context that does NOT fit the idiom.
During group rehearsal, Faisal noticed his partner forgot to check the final slide. Gently, Faisal said, 'Let's double-check slide five before the bell so we are all on the same page before presenting.'
First, what does 'on the same page' mean here—and which sentence uses it CORRECTLY in a new situation?
options: Feeling angry with teammates — 'After arguing all morning, the two teams were completely on the same page.'
Reading the identical printed book page — 'Because our novels look different, we are literally on the same page.'
Standing in one straight line — 'The runners stayed on the same page by sprinting in single file.'
Sharing the same understanding/plan — 'Before the trip starts, let's meet to get everyone on the same page about pickup times.'
en.hint: Think about why teammates check slides together: to agree on the plan and avoid confusion.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Understanding an idiom deeply means recognizing both its meaning (shared agreement/understanding) and natural usage.

Step 1: 'On the same page' means everyone shares the same plan or understanding.

Step 2: Meeting before a trip so everyone agrees on pickup times uses the idiom accurately; the other choices confuse literal pages, arguing, or lining up.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Sharing the same understanding/plan — 'Before the trip starts, let's meet to get everyone on the same page about pickup times.'

ar.question:
اقرأ الحوار التالي بعناية ثم اختر الموقف الذي يسيء استخدام التعبير المجازي.
During group rehearsal, Faisal noticed his partner forgot to check the final slide. Gently, Faisal said, 'Let's double-check slide five before the bell so we are all on the same page before presenting.'
ما معنى on the same page هنا، وأي جملة تستخدمه استخدامًا صحيحًا في موقف جديد؟
options: Feeling angry with teammates — 'After arguing all morning, the two teams were completely on the same page.'
Reading the identical printed book page — 'Because our novels look different, we are literally on the same page.'
Standing in one straight line — 'The runners stayed on the same page by sprinting in single file.'
Sharing the same understanding/plan — 'Before the trip starts, let's meet to get everyone on the same page about pickup times.'
ar.hint: فكّر في هدف مراجعة الشرائح معًا: توحيد الفهم والخطة لتجنب الارتباك أمام الجمهور.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: يعني تعبير on the same page اتفاق الجميع على فهم وخطة موحدة، لا القراءة من الصفحة الورقية نفسها.

الخطوة 1: توحيد موعد الالتقاء قبل الرحلة يطبّق التعبير تطبيقا صحيحًا لأنه يعني وضوح الخطة وتوافق الجميع.

الخطوة 2: بقية الخيارات تخلط بين المعنى الحرفي أو تناقضه بالجدال.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Sharing the same understanding/plan — 'Before the trip starts, let's meet to get everyone on the same page about pickup times.'

en.question:
Read the message and check the message header card, then identify its tone.
Dear Principal Al-Mansoor, Our Grade 6 class respectfully requests permission to host a book swap in the courtyard next Tuesday afternoon. Thank you for considering our proposal. Sincerely, Grade 6 Council
Which word best describes the tone of this message?
en.hint: Look at the greeting ('Dear Principal...'), 'respectfully requests', and 'Sincerely'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Respectful greetings, complete sentences, and formal closings ('Sincerely') signal formal tone.

Step 1: Phrases like 'Dear Principal', 'respectfully requests', and 'Sincerely' show polite respect toward a school leader.

Step 2: There is no slang, humor, or anger.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Polite and formal.

ar.question:
اقرأ الرسالة التالية وافحص بطاقة بياناتها، ثم حدّد أسلوبها (Tone).
Dear Principal Al-Mansoor, Our Grade 6 class respectfully requests permission to host a book swap in the courtyard next Tuesday afternoon. Thank you for considering our proposal. Sincerely, Grade 6 Council
أي وصف يعبّر بأفضل صورة عن نبرة (Tone) هذه الرسالة؟
ar.hint: انتبه لصيغة التحية الرسمية والعبارات المهذبة مثل respectfully requests و Sincerely.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: مخاطبة المدير بلقب رسمي واستخدام عبارات التقدير والخاتمة الرسمية علامات واضحة للأسلوب المهذب والرسمي.

الخطوة 1: استخدم الطلاب عبارات رسمية مهذبة مثل Dear Principal و respectfully requests و Sincerely.

الخطوة 2: تخلو الرسالة تمامًا من المزاح أو الغضب أو العامية.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Polite and formal.

en.question:
Read the short text message and inspect the header card.
Hey Omar!! Guess what? My cousin brought a cool telescope! Wanna come over at 7 and check out the moon? Bring snacks! :)
Who is the intended audience, and what is the tone?
options: A museum director; stiff and formal
City bus drivers; urgent and serious
A close friend; casual and enthusiastic
en.hint: Notice 'Hey', 'Guess what?', 'Wanna', exclamation marks, and ':)'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Slang contractions ('Wanna'), greetings like 'Hey', and friendly emojis mark a casual tone for a peer/friend.

Step 1: Informal words ('Hey', 'Wanna', 'cool') and excited punctuation suit a close friend.

Step 2: Nobody writes 'Wanna' or ':)' to a museum director or city driver.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: A close friend; casual and enthusiastic.

ar.question:
اقرأ الرسالة القصيرة التالية وافحص بطاقة بياناتها.
Hey Omar!! Guess what? My cousin brought a cool telescope! Wanna come over at 7 and check out the moon? Bring snacks! :)
من الجمهور المخاطَب في هذه الرسالة، وما أسلوبها؟
options: A museum director; stiff and formal
City bus drivers; urgent and serious
A close friend; casual and enthusiastic
ar.hint: انتبه للكلمات الودودة المختصرة مثل Hey و Wanna وعلامات التعجب.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: الكلمات المختصرة غير الرسمية مثل Hey و Wanna والرموز الودية تناسب حديثًا عفويًا متحمسًا مع صديق مقرب.

الخطوة 1: تُظهر البطاقة أن الرسالة مرسلة إلى صديق، كما يؤكد أسلوبها العامي المتحمس ذلك.

الخطوة 2: لا يصح هذا الأسلوب مع مدير متحف أو تحذير رسمي.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: A close friend; casual and enthusiastic.

correct_answer: Grade 6 students going on a field trip

en.question:
Read the passage and check the newsletter header card.
Attention, young explorers! Pack your reusable water bottle and comfy sneakers this Thursday because Grade 6 is heading to the Desert Wildlife Center. Keep your eyes peeled for hopping jerboas and golden eagles!
Who is the primary intended audience for this passage?
options: Grade 6 students going on a field trip
en.hint: Notice the greeting 'young explorers!' and 'Grade 6 is heading to...'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Direct address ('young explorers') and grade references identify the intended readers.

Step 1: The passage addresses 'young explorers' in Grade 6 preparing sneakers and water bottles for a wildlife trip.

Step 2: Pilots, chefs, and engineers do not match the trip details or youthful tone.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Grade 6 students going on a field trip.

ar.question:
اقرأ النص التالي وافحص بطاقة بيانات النشرة ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Attention, young explorers! Pack your reusable water bottle and comfy sneakers this Thursday because Grade 6 is heading to the Desert Wildlife Center. Keep your eyes peeled for hopping jerboas and golden eagles!
من الفئة المستهدفة الأساس في هذه الفقرة؟
options: Grade 6 students going on a field trip
ar.hint: انظر إلى النداء young explorers وذكر طلاب الصف السادس (Grade 6).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: النداء التوجيهي وذكر الصف السادس والاستعداد للرحلة تحدد الجمهور المستهدف بوضوح.

الخطوة 1: تخاطب النشرة طلاب الصف السادس (young explorers) قبيل رحلتهم إلى مركز الحياة الفطرية.

الخطوة 2: بقية الخيارات لا علاقة لها بالسياق أو البطاقة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Grade 6 students going on a field trip.

en.question:
Read the notice and check the header card, then identify the tone.
IMPORTANT NOTICE: Heavy maintenance trucks will enter the East Gate between 12:30 PM and 1:30 PM today. All students must stay inside the covered courtyard and keep the driveway completely clear.
What is the tone of this school announcement?
en.hint: Notice 'IMPORTANT NOTICE', 'must stay', and 'completely clear'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Safety alerts use strong modals ('must') and clear urgent phrasing without jokes or slang.

Step 1: Because heavy trucks pose a safety hazard, the notice uses a serious, urgent tone.

Step 2: Nothing in it is humorous, poetic, or chatty.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Serious and urgent.

en.question:
Read the card message and check the header card.
Dear Aunt Salma, Thank you so much for sending the colorful calligraphy set for my birthday! I already practiced writing my name twice today and cannot wait to show you on Friday. Love, Reem
Which description best matches the tone of Reem's note?
en.hint: Look at 'Thank you so much', 'cannot wait to show you', and 'Love, Reem'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Thank-you notes to close relatives use a warm, grateful, personal tone.

Step 1: Reem expresses genuine gratitude ('Thank you so much') and excitement to share her work with her aunt.

Step 2: She is neither annoyed nor technical.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Warm and grateful.

en.question:
Read the draft email to a science museum curator and check the header card.
Dear Dr. Al-Harbi, My name is Ziad, and I am a Grade 6 student at Al-Faisal School. [ ____ ] Would your museum be willing to let our class interview a fossil researcher over video chat for ten minutes next week?
Which sentence fits the blank [ ____ ] while matching the polite, formal tone?
options: Our class is currently studying ancient desert fossils and would be honored to learn from your team.
Yo, we're doing fossil stuff in class and you gotta let us talk to somebody soon!
Fossil museums are super boring unless someone talks to us on a screen right away.
Hey buddy, send a fossil expert onto our classroom laptop next Tuesday!
en.hint: Eliminate slang ('Yo', 'stuff', 'Hey buddy') and rude demands.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Maintaining consistent register means choosing polite vocabulary ('currently studying', 'would be honored') matching the opening.

Step 1: The opening addresses 'Dr. Al-Harbi' politely and ends with 'Would your museum be willing...'.

Step 2: Only the sentence mentioning 'currently studying' and 'would be honored' preserves that polite, formal register; the others use disrespectful slang.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Our class is currently studying ancient desert fossils and would be honored to learn from your team.

en.question:
Read the short museum leaflet and check the header card.
Welcome to the Red Sea Heritage Gallery. As you explore these hand-carved wooden fishing boats, please refrain from leaning on glass display rails and keep camera flashes switched off so delicate century-old wood stays protected for future visitors.
Who is the intended audience, and how would you describe the tone?
options: Sixth graders at lunch; loud and angry
Fishermen at sea; panicked and urgent
Boat carpenters; casual and full of jokes
Museum visitors; courteous yet respectful and instructional
en.hint: Notice 'Welcome', 'please refrain from', and the clear reason 'so delicate... wood stays protected'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'Please refrain from...' gives visitor guidelines politely ('courteous') while still protecting exhibits.

Step 1: The leaflet greets museum visitors and explains preservation rules calmly and courteously.

Step 2: It is neither joking, angry, nor panicked.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Museum visitors; courteous yet respectful and instructional.

Welcome to the Red Sea Heritage Gallery. As you explore these hand-carved wooden fishing boats, please refrain from leaning on glass display rails and keep camera flashes switched off so delicate century-old wood stays protected for future visitors.
من الجمهور المقصود هنا، وكيف تصف نبرة النص؟
options: Sixth graders at lunch; loud and angry
Fishermen at sea; panicked and urgent
Boat carpenters; casual and full of jokes
Museum visitors; courteous yet respectful and instructional
ar.hint: انتبه للعبارات المهذبة والارشادية مثل Welcome و please refrain from وذكر السبب الوقائي.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: صيغ مثل Welcome و please refrain from مع توضيح سبب الحفاظ على القطع تعكس أسلوبًا مهذبًا وإرشاديًا لزوار المتحف.

الخطوة 1: توجّه المطوية التعليمات لزوار المعرض بلباقة واحترام دون غضب أو فكاهة.

الخطوة 2: لذلك الإجابة الدقيقة هي زوار المتحف بأسلوب مهذب وإرشادي.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Museum visitors; courteous yet respectful and instructional.

Ever wondered why your shadow stretches longer than a giraffe at 5:00 PM yet shrinks under your shoes at noon? Grab a wooden ruler and step into the courtyard—you are about to discover how Earth's spin turns sunlight into a giant natural clock!
Who is this article written for, and what tone does it use?
options: University astronomers; dry and overly technical
Toddlers learning to count to three; sleepy
Curious school-age readers; energetic and inviting
en.hint: Look at the playful comparison ('longer than a giraffe') and inviting command ('Grab a wooden ruler').
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Vivid everyday imagery and hands-on prompts ('Grab a wooden ruler') engage upper-primary science readers energetically.

Step 1: Comparing a shadow to a giraffe and inviting readers outside with a ruler creates an energetic, kid-friendly tone.

Step 2: It avoids dry technical jargon and legal rules.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Curious school-age readers; energetic and inviting.

اقرأ مقتطف المجلة العلمية التالي وافحص البطاقة ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Ever wondered why your shadow stretches longer than a giraffe at 5:00 PM yet shrinks under your shoes at noon? Grab a wooden ruler and step into the courtyard—you are about to discover how Earth's spin turns sunlight into a giant natural clock!
لمن كُتب هذا المقال، وما النبرة التي يعتمدها الكاتب؟
options: University astronomers; dry and overly technical
Toddlers learning to count to three; sleepy
Curious school-age readers; energetic and inviting
ar.hint: لاحظ التشبيه الطريف (أطول من زرافة) والدعوة الحماسية للتجربة في الفناء.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: استخدام السؤال التشويقي والتشبيه القريب للأطفال والدعوة للتجربة البسيطة بالمسطرة يناسب طلاب المدارس الفضوليين بنبرة حماسية جذابة.

الخطوة 1: يخاطب الكاتب قراءً صغارًا محبين للاستطلاع بأسلوب نشط ومشجع على التجربة العملية.

الخطوة 2: لا يستخدم مصطلحات أكاديمية جافة ولا صيغًا قانونية.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Curious school-age readers; energetic and inviting.

en.question:
Read the casual sentence and choose the best FORMAL revision for a school report.
Casual Draft: 'Lots of kids totally loved the cool solar oven demo and thought it was super awesome!'
Which revision keeps the same meaning while switching to an appropriate formal tone for a school report?
options: Kids thought the solar oven was okay-ish, maybe sorta neat.
Nobody liked the solar oven demo because it looked terrible.
Many students responded enthusiastically to the solar oven demonstration.
Bunch of sixth graders went wild over that rad oven thing!
en.hint: Replace casual words ('Lots of kids', 'cool', 'super awesome') with clear academic wording.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Tone revision swaps slang ('kids', 'cool', 'super awesome') for precise formal words ('students', 'demonstration', 'enthusiastically') without changing facts.

Step 1: 'Many students responded enthusiastically...' accurately translates 'lots of kids loved the demo' into formal prose.

Step 2: The 'went wild / rad' and 'okay-ish / sorta' choices remain slangy, and 'Nobody liked' reverses the meaning.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Many students responded enthusiastically to the solar oven demonstration.

ar.question:
اقرأ الجملة العامية التالية ثم اختر الصياغة الرسمية الأنسب لتقرير مدرسي.
Casual Draft: 'Lots of kids totally loved the cool solar oven demo and thought it was super awesome!'
أي تعديل يحافظ على المعنى نفسه مع تحويل الأسلوب إلى صياغة رسمية تناسب التقرير المدرسي؟
options: Kids thought the solar oven was okay-ish, maybe sorta neat.
Nobody liked the solar oven demo because it looked terrible.
Many students responded enthusiastically to the solar oven demonstration.
Bunch of sixth graders went wild over that rad oven thing!
ar.hint: استبدل الألفاظ العامية مثل Lots of kids و cool و super awesome بمفردات مدرسية فصيحة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: عند التحويل من الأسلوب العامي إلى الرسمي، نستبدل الكلمات الدارجة بمفردات أكاديمية دقيقة مع بقاء المعنى كما هو.

الخطوة 1: حافظت الجملة الصحيحة على المعنى الإيجابي وحوّلت اللغة إلى أسلوب تقرير رسمي عبر كلمات مثل students و enthusiastically و demonstration.

الخطوة 2: الجمل العامية تبقى غير رسمية، وعبارة Nobody liked تقلب المعنى.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Many students responded enthusiastically to the solar oven demonstration.

Read the formal apology note and check the header card.
Dear Coach Sami, I apologize for missing yesterday's afternoon practice without notifying you earlier. My younger sister fell ill and I stayed home to assist my parents. I will arrive fifteen minutes early tomorrow to help set up the cones.
Which combination best describes the tone of this note?
en.hint: Notice 'I apologize', explaining the honest reason, and offering to arrive early to help.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Taking ownership ('I apologize'), giving context respectfully, and offering help create a sincere, responsible tone.

Step 1: The student politely apologizes, explains the family emergency, and offers extra help tomorrow.

Step 2: None of the negative adjectives (sarcastic, careless, loud, impatient) fit.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Sincere, respectful, and responsible.

Dear Coach Sami, I apologize for missing yesterday's afternoon practice without notifying you earlier. My younger sister fell ill and I stayed home to assist my parents. I will arrive fifteen minutes early tomorrow to help set up the cones.
أي وصف يعبّر بأدق صورة عن نبرة هذه الرسالة؟
ar.hint: لاحظ الاعتذار الصريح وتوضيح السبب العائلي ثم المبادرة بالحضور مبكرًا للمساعدة.
ar.explanation:

الخطوة 2: بقية الأوصاف سلبية أو عابثة لا تناسب المضمون.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Sincere, respectful, and responsible.

en.question:
Compare the two messages in the passage and check the header card.
Message 1: 'Pls send slides asap!! Need em b4 3!!' Message 2: 'Hello Ms. Nadia, Could you please share the science slides before 3:00 PM today so our group can review them? Thank you very much.'
Why is Message 2 better suited for the recipient shown on the header card?
options: Message 1 is actually better because teachers prefer 'asap' and 'b4'
It uses fewer words and exclamation marks so the teacher reads faster
Message 2 hides the deadline time so the teacher feels relaxed
It uses complete spelling, a polite request, and a respectful greeting suited to a teacher
en.hint: Compare abbreviations ('Pls', 'asap', 'b4') against polite full wording sent to Ms. Nadia (Science Teacher).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Audience determines register: abbreviated texting fits peers, while full polite sentences fit teachers.

Step 1: The recipient on the card is Ms. Nadia (Science Teacher). Message 2 greets her politely, spells every word fully, and says 'Could you please' + 'Thank you'.

Step 2: Message 1 uses rushed text slang ('Pls', 'em', 'b4') and double exclamation marks.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: It uses complete spelling, a polite request, and a respectful greeting suited to a teacher.

How does the author's tone strengthen this request to the neighborhood committee?
options: By using playful jokes about tripping in dark streets at night
By shouting insults at the bakery owner for opening a popular shop
By demanding money directly from neighbors without explaining why
By staying calm, polite, and focused on community safety instead of attacking anyone

What tone characterizes this text, and who is the likely audience?
options: Sarcastic and annoyed; repair technicians complaining about customers
Objective and matter-of-fact; someone setting up a kitchen scale for the first time
Dramatic and emotional; a chef competing on a loud television game show
Playful and rhyming; kindergarten children learning animal names
en.hint: Notice the neutral step-by-step instructions with zero emotional adjectives.

Step 1: Clear, unemotional imperatives ('place it', 'Press the ZERO button', 'wait two seconds') define an objective instructional tone.

Step 2: The audience is a user setting up the scale, matching the header card.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Objective and matter-of-fact; someone setting up a kitchen scale for the first time.

Which pair of words best describes the tone and audience of this passage?
options: Mocking and harsh; judges grading spelling mistakes

Honest and encouraging; fellow students facing a challenge
en.hint: Look at how the narrator admits nervousness ('sweaty palms') and ends with an encouraging lesson ('helps you grow stronger').
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Personal reflections sharing vulnerability and growth aim to encourage peers.

Step 1: Admitting sweaty palms is honest; concluding that facing fear 'helps you grow stronger' is encouraging for student readers.

Step 2: There is no mockery, dry statistics, or technical lighting manual.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Honest and encouraging; fellow students facing a challenge.

en.question:
Read the two versions of a library rule and inspect the header card.
Version A: 'Hey guys! Stop stuffing sticky candy wrappers inside library books—that ruins pages and attracts gross ants!' Version B: 'Please enjoy snacks outside the library so shared books stay clean and undamaged for every reader.'
How do Version A and Version B differ in tone for the same audience?
options: Version A sounds scolding and informal, whereas Version B sounds courteous and constructive
Both versions use identical friendly slang to welcome candy inside
Version B bans all students from borrowing shared books forever
Version A sounds formal and legal, whereas Version B sounds rude and angry
en.hint: Compare 'Stop stuffing... gross ants!' with 'Please enjoy snacks outside... so shared books stay clean'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Compare diction ('Stop stuffing', 'gross') vs polite framing ('Please enjoy...', 'shared books') for the same rule.

Step 1: Version A uses casual slang ('Hey guys', 'gross') and an angry command ('Stop stuffing').

Step 2: Version B states the exact same rule politely ('Please enjoy snacks outside') and gives a positive community reason.

✅ Quick Check: Correct answer: Version A sounds scolding and informal, whereas Version B sounds courteous and constructive.

ar.question:
اقرأ الصيغتين التاليتين لإحدى قواعد المكتبة وافحص البطاقة ثم أجب عن السؤال.
Version A: 'Hey guys! Stop stuffing sticky candy wrappers inside library books—that ruins pages and attracts gross ants!' Version B: 'Please enjoy snacks outside the library so shared books stay clean and undamaged for every reader.'
كيف تختلف الصيغة A عن الصيغة B في النبرة رغم توجيههما للجمهور نفسه؟
options: Version A sounds scolding and informal, whereas Version B sounds courteous and constructive
Both versions use identical friendly slang to welcome candy inside
Version B bans all students from borrowing shared books forever
Version A sounds formal and legal, whereas Version B sounds rude and angry
ar.hint: قارن بين اللوم الحاد والكلمات العامية في A وبين اللباقة والتفسير الإيجابي في B.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: يُظهر هذا السؤال كيف تنقل الصياغتان القاعدة نفسها، لكن الأولى حادة وعامية بينما الثانية مهذبة وبنّاءة.

الخطوة 1: توبخ الصيغة A الطلاب بعامية غاضبة، بينما تطلب الصيغة B بأدب تناول الطعام خارج المكتبة للحفاظ على الكتب للجميع.

الخطوة 2: بقية الخيارات تعكس الأوصاف أو تبالغ.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Version A sounds scolding and informal, whereas Version B sounds courteous and constructive.
