en.question:
Complete both blanks in the negative present perfect sentence.
Although the space exhibit opened last month, my younger brother ______ the planetarium dome ______.
Which pair of phrases fits both blanks accurately?
en.hint: Check subject-verb agreement ('my younger brother' = singular), the V3 form of 'see', and the end-of-sentence adverb.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Singular 'my younger brother' takes 'has not + seen (V3)', and negative present perfect closes with 'yet'.

Step 1: 'have not saw' mismatches singular 'brother' and uses V2 ('saw') instead of V3.

Step 2: 'did not seen' mixes 'did' with V3 and puts 'already' in a negative sentence.

Step 3: 'is not seeing' uses progressive tense and leaves 'since' without a time phrase.

✅ Quick Check: My younger brother has not seen the planetarium dome yet.
en.diagram: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 360 145" dir="ltr" role="img" aria-label="Negative Perfect" style="display:block;direction:ltr;max-width:100%;width:360px;max-height:280px;margin:14px auto;background:#ffffff;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1"><title>Negative Perfect</title><rect x="8" y="8" width="344" height="129" rx="12" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.3"/><text x="180" y="29" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#231942">Negative Perfect</text><line x1="36" y1="88" x2="324" y2="88" stroke="#231942" stroke-width="2.2"/><line x1="180" y1="74" x2="180" y2="102" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/><text x="52" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#64748b">Past</text><text x="180" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#0f766e">Now</text><text x="308" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#64748b">Future</text><line x1="122.4" y1="76" x2="180.0" y2="76" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="4"/><text x="151.2" y="62" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#2563eb">hasn't seen yet</text></svg>

ar.question:
أكمل الفراغين في جملة المضارع التام المنفية.
Although the space exhibit opened last month, my younger brother ______ the planetarium dome ______.
أي زوج من العبارات يملأ الفراغين بدقة؟
ar.hint: تحقق من مطابقة المفرد، والتصريف الثالث للفعل see، والظرف المناسب في نهاية النفي.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: الفاعل المفرد يأخذ has not + التصريف الثالث seen، وتُختم الجملة المنفية بـ yet.

الخطوة 1: أما have not saw فتخالف المفرد والتصريف الثالث، وdid لا تجتمع مع seen، وsince تحتاج إلى وقت بعدها.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: has not seen ... yet.

en.question:
Identify the sentence that pairs the present perfect with a duration phrase correctly.
Four students wrote a note about how long Kareem has belonged to the school chess club.
Which student's sentence is completely correct?
options: Kareem was in the chess club for 2024.
Kareem has been in the chess club for two years.
Kareem is in the chess club since two years.
Kareem has been in the chess club since two years.
en.hint: Check both the verb tense for an ongoing state and whether 'two years' is a duration or a start date.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'has been' expresses a state starting in the past and continuing now, and 'for' matches the duration 'two years'.

Step 1: 'is ... since two years' uses simple present and wrongly pairs 'since' with a duration.

Step 2: 'has been ... since two years' wrongly uses 'since' before a count of years.

Step 3: 'was ... for 2024' puts simple past with 'for' before a single calendar year.

✅ Quick Check: Kareem has been in the chess club for two years.

ar.question:
حدّد الجملة التي تستخدم المضارع التام مع تعبير المدة الزمنية استخداماً صحيحاً.
Four students wrote a note about how long Kareem has belonged to the school chess club.
أي جملة كتبها الطلاب هي الصحيحة نحوياً بالكامل؟
options: Kareem was in the chess club for 2024.
Kareem has been in the chess club for two years.
Kareem is in the chess club since two years.
Kareem has been in the chess club since two years.
ar.hint: راجع زمن الفعل لحالة مستمرة حتى الآن، وهل 'سنتان' مدة أم نقطة بداية.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تجتمع صيغة المضارع التام has been مع حرف الجر for قبل المدة الزمنية two years.

الخطوة 1: الجمل الأخرى أخطأت باستعمال المضارع البسيط مع since أو وضع since قبل مدة زمنية أو for قبل سنة مفردة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Kareem has been in the chess club for two years.

en.question:
Pick the sentence that uses 'already' and 'yet' accurately.
Rana is making a science poster for tomorrow's fair. Read four descriptions of her progress.
Which sentence has zero grammar mistakes?
options: Rana has yet glued the photos, so she hasn't added the title already.
Rana has already glued the photos, so she hasn't added the title yet.
Rana have already glued the photos, so she hasn't add the title yet.
Rana already glue the photos, so she doesn't added the title yet.
en.hint: Remember: 'already' fits positive 'has + V3', while 'yet' goes at the end of 'hasn't + V3'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'has already glued' uses singular 'has', mid-position 'already', and V3 'glued'; 'hasn't added ... yet' pairs negative V3 with end-position 'yet'.

Step 1: 'has yet glued ... added ... already' swaps 'already' and 'yet'.

Step 2: 'have already glued ... add' wrongly uses plural 'have' for 'Rana' and base 'add' after 'hasn't'.

Step 3: 'already glue ... doesn't added' omits 'has' and mixes 'doesn't' with 'added'.

✅ Quick Check: Rana has already glued the photos, so she hasn't added the title yet.

ar.question:
اختر الجملة التي تستعمل already وyet استعمالاً صحيحاً.
Rana is making a science poster for tomorrow's fair. Read four descriptions of her progress.
أي جملة تخلو تماماً من الأخطاء النحوية؟
options: Rana has yet glued the photos, so she hasn't added the title already.
Rana has already glued the photos, so she hasn't added the title yet.
Rana have already glued the photos, so she hasn't add the title yet.
Rana already glue the photos, so she doesn't added the title yet.
ar.hint: تذكّر: تأتي already في الجملة المثبتة مع has + V3، وتأتي yet آخر النفي مع hasn't + V3.
ar.explanation:

الخطوة 1: الخيارات الأخرى بدّلت موضع الظرفين أو أخطأت في have مع المفرد أو في التصريف بعد النفي.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Rana has already glued the photos, so she hasn't added the title yet.

en.question:
Choose the reply that uses the correct structure for a pre-arranged future plan.
Lina: Why did you bring two brushes and green paint to school?
Reem: Because we ______!
Which sentence completes Reem's explanation grammatically and meaningfully?
options: will to decorate the reading corner this afternoon
are going to decorate the reading corner this afternoon
have decorated the reading corner tomorrow morning
going to decorate the reading corner this afternoon
en.hint: Buying paint and brushes shows an existing plan; check every word of the verb phrase and time marker.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'are going to decorate' properly combines 'are + going to + base verb' for an arranged plan matching 'this afternoon'.

Step 1: 'going to decorate' misses the helping verb 'are'.

Step 2: 'will to decorate' inserts an illegal 'to' after 'will'.

Step 3: 'have decorated' clashes with future 'tomorrow morning'.

✅ Quick Check: Because we are going to decorate the reading corner this afternoon!

Reem: Because we ______!

الخطوة 1: تنقص الأولى الفعل are، وتخطئ الثالثة بإضافة to بعد will، وتتناقض الرابعة بين الماضي التام وكلمة tomorrow.

en.question:
Compare the heights shown on the garden chart and fill in the blank.
According to the garden chart, the palm tree is ______ than the olive tree.
Which comparative adjective fits the blank?
en.hint: Notice the word 'than' comparing two trees, and 'tall' is a short one-syllable adjective.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: One-syllable adjectives like 'tall' form the comparative with '-er' before 'than' -> 'taller than'.

Step 1: 'tallest' is a superlative for three or more items and does not go with 'than'.

Step 2: 'more tall' wrongly adds 'more' to a short adjective.

Step 3: 'tall' is the base adjective without a comparative ending.

✅ Quick Check: The palm tree is taller than the olive tree (14 m > 8 m).

According to the garden chart, the palm tree is ______ than the olive tree.
أي صفة مقارنة تناسب الفراغ؟

en.question:
Use the weight card to choose the correct superlative adjective.
Among all three school bags, the green backpack is the ______ one to carry.
Which superlative form belongs in the blank?
en.hint: We are comparing three bags and 'the' appears right before the blank; 'light' has one syllable.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Comparing three or more items with a short adjective uses 'the + adjective-est' -> 'the lightest' (2 kg).

Step 1: 'lighter' compares only two items.

Step 2: 'more light' and 'most lightest' wrongly combine 'more/most' with a short adjective.

✅ Quick Check: The green backpack is the lightest one (2 kg).

ar.question:
استعن ببطاقة الأوزان لاختيار صيغة التفضيل العليا الصحيحة.
Among all three school bags, the green backpack is the ______ one to carry.
أي صيغة تفضيل عليا تناسب الفراغ؟
ar.hint: المقارنة هنا بين ثلاث حقائب مسبوقة بأداة التعريف the، والصفة light قصيرة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: عند التفضيل بين ثلاثة أشياء بصفة قصيرة نضيف -est بعد the فتصبح lightest.

الخطوة 1: أما lighter فللمقارنة بين اثنين، ولا يجوز الجمع بين more أو most وصفة قصيرة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: lightest.

en.question:
Compare the trip prices on the notice card and complete the sentence.
Look at the activity fees: the Desert Camp is ______ than the Pottery Class.
Which comparative phrase fits the multi-syllable adjective 'expensive'?
en.hint: 'Expensive' has three syllables (ex-pen-sive) and is followed by 'than'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Long adjectives of two or more syllables (not ending in -y) take 'more + adjective' before 'than' -> 'more expensive'.

Step 1: 'expensiver' adds '-er' illegally to a three-syllable word.

Step 2: 'most expensive' is a superlative and lacks 'the'.

Step 3: 'as expensive' needs a second 'as', not 'than' (and 65 SAR != 35 SAR).

✅ Quick Check: The Desert Camp (65 SAR) is more expensive than the Pottery Class (35 SAR).

en.question:
Read the spelling quiz scores and complete the irregular comparison.
Mona practiced hard all week, so her score on Quiz 2 was ______ than her score on Quiz 1.
Which irregular comparative fits the blank?
en.hint: Remember the irregular pattern for 'good' when comparing two results with 'than'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: The adjective 'good' is irregular: comparative 'better' (91% > 72%) and superlative 'best'.

Step 1: 'gooder' and 'more good' are non-existent forms in English.

Step 2: 'best' is a superlative for three or more items, not paired with 'than'.

en.question:
Check the lengths of the three bridges and choose the equal-comparison structure.

en.hint: North Bridge is 420 m and South Bridge is also 420 m—their lengths are equal.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'as + base adjective + as' when two things share the exact same degree -> 'as long as'.

Step 1: 'longer than' and 'shorter than' contradict 420 m = 420 m.

Step 2: 'the longest' does not fit grammatically right before 'the South Bridge'.

en.question:
Use the book rating card to complete the superlative sentence.
With an average score of 4.9 out of 5, Star Atlas is ______ science book in the library.
Which superlative phrase correctly completes the sentence?
en.hint: 'Popular' is a three-syllable adjective and the sentence singles out #1 among all three books.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Multi-syllable adjectives form the superlative with 'the most + adjective' -> 'the most popular'.

Step 1: 'more popular' is for comparing two books, not picking the #1 book.

Step 2: 'the popularest' illegally adds '-est' to a long adjective.

Step 3: 'most popular than' mixes superlative 'most' with comparative 'than'.

Which superlative fits the blank?
en.hint: The Eagles ranked #1 out of all three teams; use the irregular superlative of 'good'.
en.explanation:

ar.question:
انظر إلى جدول نقاط البطولة واختر صيغة التفضيل الشاذة المناسبة.
Scoring 64 points across five matches, the Eagles have ______ total in the entire league.
أي صيغة تفضيل تناسب الفراغ؟
ar.hint: حقق فريق Eagles المركز الأول بين الفرق الثلاثة؛ استعمل صيغة التفضيل الشاذة من good.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: صيغة التفضيل العليا الشاذة من good هي the best.

الخطوة 1: لا توجد كلمتا goodest أو more best، وتُستخدم better للمقارنة بين اثنين فقط.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: the best.

en.question:
Read the bus wait times and fill in the irregular comparative for 'bad'.
At 18 minutes, Tuesday's bus wait was ______ than Wednesday's 9-minute wait.
Which comparative word fills the blank?
en.hint: Two days are compared using 'than', and 'bad' has an irregular comparative form.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: The irregular forms of 'bad' are comparative 'worse' (18 min > 9 min) and superlative 'worst'.

Step 1: 'badder' and 'more bad' are incorrect English forms.

Step 2: 'worst' is the superlative for three or more days, not for 'than'.

✅ Quick Check: Tuesday's bus wait was worse than Wednesday's.

en.question:
Apply the '-y' comparative spelling rule using the library visitor data.
With 920 guests, the reading room is much ______ on Friday than on Monday.
Which correctly spelled comparative of 'busy' completes the sentence?
en.hint: When a two-syllable adjective ends in consonant + '-y' (busy), change 'y' to 'i' before adding '-er'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Two-syllable adjectives ending in '-y' change '-y' to '-ier' -> 'busier' (920 > 340).

Step 1: 'busyer' forgets to change 'y' into 'i'.

Step 2: Standard school grammar uses 'busier', not 'more busy'.

Step 3: 'busiest' is a superlative and cannot go before 'than'.

✅ Quick Check: The reading room is much busier on Friday than on Monday.

en.question:
Compare the mountain heights and choose the negative equality expression.
Looking at the elevation card, Jabal Tuwaiq is ______ Jabal Sawda.
Which option states the fact in the table accurately?
en.hint: Jabal Tuwaiq is 1,100 m while Jabal Sawda is 3,000 m, so Tuwaiq reaches a lower height.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Since 1,100 m < 3,000 m, 'not as + adjective + as' -> 'not as high as' means lower than.

Step 1: 'higher than' and 'as high as' are factually false (1,100 < 3,000).

Step 2: 'the highest' does not fit grammatically right before 'Jabal Sawda'.

✅ Quick Check: Jabal Tuwaiq (1,100 m) is not as high as Jabal Sawda (3,000 m).

Three Grade 6 teams tested their model solar cars on a sunny playground track.
Which sentence matches the speed card AND uses correct grammar?
options: Car B is the fastest of the three solar cars.
Car B is more faster than Car C on the track.
Car C is fast than Car A in the speed trial.
Car A is the most slow car in the competition.
en.hint: Avoid double comparatives like 'more faster', avoid 'most' with short adjectives, and check '-er' before 'than'.

Step 2: 'the most slow' should be 'the slowest'.

Step 3: 'fast than' omits the required '-er' ending ('faster than').

افحص جدول أخطاء الروبوتات واختر صيغة التفضيل العليا الشاذة المناسبة.
In the maze test, more missed turns mean a poorer run. Trial B had the ______ result of all three trials.
أي صيغة تفضيل شاذة تناسب الفراغ؟
ar.hint: سجّلت التجربة B أكبر عدد من الأخطاء (9) بين التجارب الثلاث، والفراغ مسبوق بـ the.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: التفضيل الأعلى من bad بين ثلاثة أشياء أو أكثر هو the worst.

الخطوة 1: أما worse فللمقارنة بين اثنين فقط، ولا تصح baddest أو more worse.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: worst.

en.question:
Apply the final-consonant doubling rule using the noon weather table.
At noon today, Dammam was ______ than Taif, while Abha stayed the coolest.
Which spelling of the comparative of 'hot' is correct?
en.hint: 'Hot' is a short consonant-vowel-consonant (C-V-C) word; double the 't' before adding '-er'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Short C-V-C adjectives double the final consonant before '-er', giving 'hotter' (41°C > 29°C).

Step 1: 'hoter' forgets to double the 't'.

Step 2: 'more hot' wrongly uses 'more' with a one-syllable word.

Step 3: 'hottest' is a superlative and cannot precede 'than'.

✅ Quick Check: Dammam (41°C) was hotter than Taif (29°C).

ar.question:
طبّق قاعدة تضعيف الحرف الساكن الأخير مستعيناً بجدول درجات الحرارة.
At noon today, Dammam was ______ than Taif, while Abha stayed the coolest.
أي تهجئة صحيحة للمقارنة من كلمة hot؟
ar.hint: الكلمة hot تتكون من ساكن فمتحرك فساكن (C-V-C)، لذا نضاعف الحرف الأخير t قبل إضافة -er.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نضاعف الحرف الأخير في hot قبل -er لتصبح hotter.

الخطوة 1: الكلمة hoter ناقصة التضعيف، وmore لا تسبق صفة قصيرة، وhottest للتفضيل.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: hotter.

en.question:
Use the trail guide card to complete the downward comparative.
Because Trail A is short and flat, walking Trail A is ______ than climbing rocky Trail B.
Which comparative phrase completes the sentence correctly?
en.hint: To compare downward (the opposite of 'more tiring'), use 'less + adjective + than'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: With a 15-minute flat path vs a 45-minute steep climb, Trail A is 'less tiring than' Trail B.

Step 1: 'more tiring' reverses the meaning of the trail card.

Step 2: 'lesser tiring' misuses 'lesser', which does not replace 'less' before adjectives.

Step 3: 'least tiring' is a superlative and does not fit before 'than'.

✅ Quick Check: Walking Trail A is less tiring than climbing rocky Trail B.

ar.question:
استعن ببطاقة المسارات لإكمال صيغة المقارنة التنازلية (أقل من).
Because Trail A is short and flat, walking Trail A is ______ than climbing rocky Trail B.
أي عبارة مقارنة تُكمِل الجملة بدقة؟
ar.hint: للمقارنة بالدرجة الأقل (عكس more tiring) نستخدم less + الصفة + than.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: المسار السهل يستغرق جهداً أقل، فنستخدم الصيغة النحوية less tiring than.

الخطوة 1: تختلف more tiring في المعنى، ولا تُستخدم lesser أو least مع than هنا.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: less tiring.

en.question:
Compare all three cities' sunshine data and pick the statement that is both accurate and grammatical.
A science class recorded average winter sunshine hours across three cities on one Friday.
Which statement matches the sunshine card and follows comparison rules?
options: Tabuk is as sunny as Riyadh, and Jeddah is the least sunny.
Riyadh is the sunniest city, even sunnier than Tabuk.
Jeddah is sunnier than Tabuk and more sunny than Riyadh.
Tabuk is not as sunny as Jeddah on this Friday.
en.hint: Notice Tabuk and Riyadh both have 10 hours (equal!), while Jeddah has 8 hours (lowest).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Equal values (10 hrs = 10 hrs) take 'as sunny as', and the lowest of three (8 hrs) correctly takes 'the least sunny'.

Step 1: Claiming Jeddah is sunnier or Tabuk is less sunny reverses the numbers because 8 hrs < 10 hrs.

Step 2: Claiming Riyadh is even sunnier than Tabuk contradicts 10 hrs = 10 hrs.

✅ Quick Check: Tabuk is as sunny as Riyadh (10 hrs), and Jeddah is the least sunny (8 hrs).

قارن ساعات السطوع في المدن الثلاث واختر الجملة الصحيحة نحوياً والمطابقة للبيانات.
A science class recorded average winter sunshine hours across three cities on one Friday.
أي عبارة تتفق مع جدول السطوع وقواعد المقارنة؟
options: Tabuk is as sunny as Riyadh, and Jeddah is the least sunny.
Riyadh is the sunniest city, even sunnier than Tabuk.
Jeddah is sunnier than Tabuk and more sunny than Riyadh.
Tabuk is not as sunny as Jeddah on this Friday.
ar.hint: لاحظ تساوي تبوك والرياض في 10 ساعات سطوع، بينما جدة 8 ساعات فقط.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: لتساوي الساعات في تبوك والرياض نستخدم as sunny as، ولجدة الأقل ساعات نستخدم the least sunny.

الخطوة 1: بقية الجمل تخالف الأرقام في الجدول لأن جدة هي الأقل لا الأكثر.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Tabuk is as sunny as Riyadh, and Jeddah is the least sunny.

en.question:
Look at the recipe card and choose the right quantifier for an uncountable liquid.
How ______ fresh milk should we pour into the pancake mixing bowl?
Which quantifier belongs in the question?
en.hint: Milk is an uncountable liquid (measured in mL), not something you count as '1 milk, 2 milks'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: In questions about amount, uncountable nouns like 'milk' take 'How much', not 'How many'.

Step 1: 'many', 'a few', and 'several' only work with plural countable nouns.

✅ Quick Check: How much fresh milk should we pour?

انظر إلى بطاقة الوصفة واختر أداة الكمية المناسبة للاسم غير المعدود.
How ______ fresh milk should we pour into the pancake mixing bowl?
أي أداة كمية تناسب هذا السؤال؟
ar.hint: كلمة milk غير معدودة (تُقاس بالمليلتر)، ولا تُعدّ كأفراد مفردة وجمع.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: much.

en.question:
Check the picnic basket card and ask about the plural countable fruit.
How ______ red apples did Mom pack in the picnic cooler?
Which quantifier completes the question?
en.hint: 'Red apples' is a plural countable noun ending in '-s'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'How many' when asking for the number of countable plural items like apples.

Step 1: 'much', 'a little', and 'less' pair with uncountable nouns, not plural 'apples'.

✅ Quick Check: How many red apples did Mom pack?

en.question:

Check the kitchen jar card and complete the positive statement about rice.
We do not need to visit the grocery store yet because there is still ______ rice in the glass jar.

en.question:
Compare the recipe limit with what was added to the soup pot.
No wonder the vegetable soup tastes overly sharp—the cook poured too ______ salt into the pot!
Which quantifier follows 'too' before the uncountable noun 'salt'?
en.hint: 'Salt' is uncountable (measured in grams or teaspoons, never 'salts').
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'too much' expresses an excessive amount of an uncountable substance like salt, noise, or sugar.

Step 1: 'many', 'a few', and 'several' cannot follow 'too' or modify uncountable 'salt'.

✅ Quick Check: The cook poured too much salt into the pot (4 tsp vs 1 tsp).

en.question:

After the match, there were too ______ plastic bottles piled beside the small bin, so students carried extra bags.
Which word goes after 'too' before 'plastic bottles'?
en.hint: 'Plastic bottles' is plural and countable (18 bottles when the bin holds 10).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Pair 'too many' with plural countable nouns when the quantity exceeds the limit.

Step 1: 'much' and 'a little' fit uncountable nouns.

Step 2: 'any' never follows 'too' in a positive statement.

en.question:
Choose the quantifier that matches the tricky uncountable noun 'homework'.
Salma finished early and read her storybook because she did not have ______ homework on Thursday.
Which quantifier is grammatical before 'homework'?
en.hint: In English, 'homework' is always uncountable (never 'homeworks' or 'two homeworks').
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Because 'homework' is uncountable and the verb is negative ('did not have'), use 'much'.

Step 1: 'many', 'a few', and 'several' only work with plural countable nouns.

✅ Quick Check: She did not have much homework on Thursday.

The short travel leaflet gives only ______ information about the ancient stone wells.

en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: A small amount of uncountable 'information' takes 'a little' ('a little information').

✅ Quick Check: The leaflet gives only a little information about the stone wells.

en.question:
Fill in both blanks by distinguishing uncountable 'luggage' from countable 'backpacks'.
For the weekend train ride, our family packed only ______ luggage in the rack and kept ______ small backpacks beside our seats.
Which pair fits the two nouns accurately?
en.hint: 'Luggage' is uncountable (never 'luggages'), while 'backpacks' is plural countable.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Uncountable 'luggage' pairs with 'a little', and plural countable 'backpacks' pairs with 'a few'.

Step 1: Reversing them ('a few luggage') puts a count phrase before an uncountable noun.

Step 2: 'many' and 'several' also clash with uncountable 'luggage'.

✅ Quick Check: We packed a little luggage and kept a few small backpacks.

en.question:
Choose the right quantifier for an invitation offering uncountable bread.
Host: We baked extra loaves this morning—please take ______ warm bread home with you!
Which quantifier sounds natural and grammatical in this invitation?
en.hint: This is an affirmative offer ('please take ...'), and 'bread' is uncountable.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'some' in affirmative invitations and before uncountable nouns like 'bread'.

Step 1: 'any' does not fit an affirmative offer like 'please take ...'.

Step 2: 'many' and 'a few' require plural countable nouns, not uncountable 'bread'.

✅ Quick Check: Please take some warm bread home with you!

en.question:
Spot the grammar rule for the uncountable noun 'advice'.
Before the science contest, Coach Rami gave our team ______ practical advice on speaking clearly.
Which word correctly precedes 'practical advice'?
en.hint: Careful! Unlike in some languages, 'advice' is strictly uncountable in English (you cannot say 'an advice' or 'advices').
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Since 'advice' is uncountable in an affirmative sentence, pair it with 'some' (never 'a/an', 'many', or 'a few').

Step 1: 'an' can only precede singular countable nouns.

Step 2: 'many' and 'a few' require plural countable nouns.

✅ Quick Check: Coach Rami gave our team some practical advice.

en.question:
Identify the one sentence that matches every noun with the right quantifier.
Nasser emptied his travel pouch on the table to check coins and paper cash.
Which sentence has zero countable/uncountable errors?
options: Nasser kept a little silver coins and a few paper money in his pouch.
Nasser kept a few silver coins and a little paper money in his pouch.
Nasser kept a few silver coins and many paper moneys in his pouch.
Nasser kept much silver coins and many paper money in his pouch.
en.hint: 'Coins' is plural countable; 'money' is always uncountable (never 'moneys').
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Countable plural 'coins' takes 'a few', and uncountable 'money' takes 'a little'.

Step 1: 'a little silver coins ... a few paper money' reverses 'a little' and 'a few'.

Step 2: 'much silver coins ... many paper money' pairs 'much' with plural 'coins' and 'many' with uncountable 'money'.

Step 3: 'many paper moneys' wrongly pluralizes 'money' as 'moneys'.

✅ Quick Check: Nasser kept a few silver coins and a little paper money in his pouch.

أي جملة تخلو من أي خطأ في المعدود وغير المعدود؟
options: Nasser kept a little silver coins and a few paper money in his pouch.
Nasser kept a few silver coins and a little paper money in his pouch.
Nasser kept a few silver coins and many paper moneys in his pouch.
Nasser kept much silver coins and many paper money in his pouch.
ar.hint: كلمة coins جمع معدود، بينما كلمة money غير معدودة دائماً ولا تُجمع إلى moneys.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تأخذ coins المعدودة أداة a few، وتأخذ money غير المعدودة أداة a little.

الخطوة 1: بقية الجمل تعكس الأداتين أو تسيء استخدام much/many أو تجمع كلمة money.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Nasser kept a few silver coins and a little paper money in his pouch.

en.question:
Compare the picnic inventory card against four statements to find the one that is both true and grammatical.
Check what remains inside the class picnic box before heading back to the bus.
Which statement matches the card facts AND quantifier rules?
options: There isn't some apple juice left, but there are much dates in the box.
There isn't any apple juice left, but there are a few dates in the box.
There aren't any apple juice left, and there are a little dates in the box.
There is many apple juice left, and there aren't any dates in the box.
en.hint: Look at the numbers: Apple Juice = 0 mL (singular negative 'isn't any'), Dates = 4 pieces (plural positive 'are a few').
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Uncountable 'apple juice' takes singular 'isn't any' (0 mL), and plural 'dates' takes 'are a few' (4 pieces).

Step 1: 'There aren't any apple juice ... a little dates' pairs plural 'aren't' with uncountable 'juice' and 'a little' with 'dates'.

Step 2: 'isn't some ... much dates' misuses 'some' in negative and 'much' with plural 'dates'.

Step 3: 'is many apple juice ... aren't any dates' contradicts the inventory card completely.

✅ Quick Check: There isn't any apple juice left, but there are a few dates in the box.

ar.question:
قارن بطاقة الجرد بأربع جمل لاختيار الجملة الصحيحة نحوياً والمطابقة للحقائق.
Check what remains inside the class picnic box before heading back to the bus.
أي عبارة تطابق البطاقة وتلتزم بقواعد الكمية بدقة؟
options: There isn't some apple juice left, but there are much dates in the box.
There isn't any apple juice left, but there are a few dates in the box.
There aren't any apple juice left, and there are a little dates in the box.
There is many apple juice left, and there aren't any dates in the box.
ar.hint: انتبه للأرقام: العصير 0 مل (مفرد منفي isn't any)، والتمور 4 حبات (جمع مثبت are a few).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: العصير غير المعدود يأخذ isn't any عند نفاده، والتمور المعدودة القليلة تأخذ are a few.

الخطوة 1: الجمل الثلاث الأخرى تحتوي على أخطاء نحوية أو تعاكس الأرقام الموجودة في البطاقة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: There isn't any apple juice left, but there are a few dates in the box.

en.question:
Read the science lab card and choose the modal of strict obligation.
Before pouring any liquids in the chemistry corner, every student ______ put on safety goggles.
Which modal verb expresses a mandatory safety rule?
en.hint: The safety sign lists 'Goggles: Required'—not optional and not forbidden.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'must' for strong rules and safety obligations required of everyone.

Step 1: 'mustn't' forbids wearing goggles.

Step 2: 'don't have to' makes goggles optional, and 'shouldn't' advises against them.

✅ Quick Check: Every student must put on safety goggles.

ar.question:
اقرأ بطاقة مختبر العلوم واختر فعل الإلزام المناسب.
Before pouring any liquids in the chemistry corner, every student ______ put on safety goggles.
أي فعل ناقص يعبّر عن قاعدة سلامة إلزامية؟
ar.hint: تشير البطاقة إلى أن النظارات الواقية إلزامية وليست اختيارية.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نستخدم must للتعبير عن القواعد والالتزامات الإلزامية القوية.

الخطوة 1: أما mustn't فتمنع الفعل، وdon't have to تجعله اختيارياً، وshouldn't تنصح بتركه.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: must.

en.question:
Check the museum sign and choose the modal of prohibition.
According to the museum sign, visitors ______ touch the fragile glass jars on display.
Which modal verb forbids touching the jars?
en.hint: 'Forbidden' means it is strictly against the rules.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'mustn't' (must not) to express strict prohibition—something people are not allowed to do.

Step 1: 'must' tells visitors to touch them.

Step 2: 'don't have to' wrongly suggests touching them is merely optional.

Step 3: 'could' expresses ability or suggestion, not prohibition.

✅ Quick Check: Visitors mustn't touch the fragile glass jars.

ar.question:
تفحص لوحة المتحف واختر فعل المنع الصحيح.
According to the museum sign, visitors ______ touch the fragile glass jars on display.
أي فعل ناقص يدل على المنع التام من لمس القطع؟
ar.hint: كلمة Forbidden تعني ممنوع منعاً باتاً.
ar.explanation:

الخطوة 1: أما don't have to فتعني عدم الضرورة لا المنع، وmust تفيد الإيجاب.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: mustn't.

en.question:

The desert park guide gives smart advice: you ______ wear a wide sun hat on midday walks.
Which modal gives friendly positive advice?
en.hint: The card says 'Sun Hat: Good advice', meaning it is wise to wear one.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'should + base verb' to give helpful recommendations and good advice.

Step 1: 'mustn't' and 'shouldn't' warn against wearing a sun hat.

Step 2: 'couldn't' indicates past inability.

اقرأ بطاقة نصائح المسار واختر فعل النصيحة المناسب.
The desert park guide gives smart advice: you ______ wear a wide sun hat on midday walks.
أي فعل ناقص يعبّر عن نصيحة مفيدة وإيجابية؟

en.question:
Look at the sleep health tips and select the modal for negative advice.
For deeper rest on school nights, students ______ look at bright phone screens right before bedtime.
Which modal advises against looking at screens late at night?
en.hint: The card labels late screens as 'Avoid 1 hr prior'—it is poor practice, so advise against it.
en.explanation:

Step 1: 'should', 'must', and 'could' encourage or allow screen use before bed.

✅ Quick Check: Students shouldn't look at bright phone screens right before bedtime.

اطلع على بطاقة نصائح النوم واختر الفعل المناسب للنصح بتجنب فعل غير مفيد.
For deeper rest on school nights, students ______ look at bright phone screens right before bedtime.
أي فعل ناقص ينصح بعدم النظر إلى الشاشات قبل النوم؟

en.question:
Check Kareem's childhood milestone card and complete the past ability sentence.
Look at the timeline: when Kareem was six years old, he ______ already swim 25 meters across the pool.
Which modal expresses ability in the past?
en.hint: The table shows 'Swim 25 m: Yes' at age six.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'could' (past of 'can') to describe what someone was able to do in the past.

Step 1: 'couldn't' reverses the 'Yes' on the card.

Step 2: 'must' and 'mustn't' express present rules, not past physical ability.

✅ Quick Check: When Kareem was six, he could already swim 25 meters.

ar.question:
انظر إلى بطاقة مهارات كريم في الصغر وأكمل الجملة الدالة على القدرة في الماضي.
Look at the timeline: when Kareem was six years old, he ______ already swim 25 meters across the pool.
أي فعل ناقص يعبّر عن القدرة في الزمن الماضي؟
ar.hint: يوضح الجدول نعم للسباحة في سن السادسة، فالمعنى إيجابي وفي الماضي.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نستخدم could للتعبير عن الاستطاعة والقدرة في الزمن الماضي.

الخطوة 1: تتناقض couldn't مع كلمة Yes، بينما تفيد must وmustn't الإلزام والمنع لا القدرة الماضية.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: could.

en.question:
Distinguish 'optional / not necessary' from 'forbidden' on the art day notice.
The school supplies free paintbrushes for every table, so students ______ buy new brushes at the store.
Which modal means 'it is not necessary'?
en.hint: Students are allowed to bring their own if they wish, it is simply optional because brushes are free.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'don't have to' when something is unnecessary or optional; unlike 'mustn't', it is not banned.

Step 1: 'mustn't' wrongly says buying brushes is forbidden.

Step 2: 'must' forces them to buy brushes, and 'shouldn't' gives negative advice.

✅ Quick Check: Students don't have to buy new brushes at the store.

ar.question:
ميّز بين غير الضروري والممنوع من خلال بطاقة يوم الفنون.
The school supplies free paintbrushes for every table, so students ______ buy new brushes at the store.
أي عبارة تعني أنه ليس من الضروري فعل ذلك؟
ar.hint: الفُرش مجانية في المدرسة، لذا لا يلزم الشراء لكنه ليس ممنوعاً؛ أي عبارة تعني عدم الضرورة؟
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تُستخدم don't have to لبيان أن الأمر اختياري أو غير ضروري، على عكس mustn't التي تعني المنع.

الخطوة 1: لا يجوز استخدام mustn't هنا لأن الشراء ليس محظوراً بل غير لازم فقط.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: don't have to.

en.question:
Apply the pool safety sign to choose between prohibition and optional rules.
Because wet tiles are slippery, swimmers ______ run anywhere along the pool edge.
Which modal strictly forbids running by the pool?
en.hint: Running near wet tiles can cause falls, so the pool card marks it 'Prohibited'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Strict safety prohibitions require 'mustn't', never 'don't have to'.

Step 1: 'don't have to' wrongly implies running is an optional choice.

Step 2: 'should' and 'could' encourage or allow running.

✅ Quick Check: Swimmers mustn't run anywhere along the pool edge.

en.question:
Use the library desk card to pick the polite modal for a request.
Excuse me, Ms. Amal—______ you please pass me the astronomy atlas from that top shelf?
Which modal begins a polite request here?
en.hint: A student is politely asking the librarian to reach a high book.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'Could you please + base verb?' is a standard polite way to make a request.

Step 1: 'Mustn't' and 'Shouldn't' turn the polite request into an odd negative question.

Step 2: 'Have' does not work with 'you please pass'.

✅ Quick Check: Could you please pass me the astronomy atlas?

en.question:
Check Tariq's vision timeline and choose the negative past-ability modal.
Before Tariq got his new eyeglasses last month, he ______ read small street signs from across the road.
Which modal completes this past inability statement?
en.hint: Look at 'Before Glasses: Not able' on the timeline card.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'couldn't' (could not) for something a person was unable to do in the past.

Step 1: 'could' means he was able to read small signs before glasses.

Step 2: 'must' and 'should' state obligation or advice, not past ability.

✅ Quick Check: He couldn't read small street signs from across the road.

Before Tariq got his new eyeglasses last month, he ______ read small street signs from across the road.
أي فعل ناقص يعبّر عن عدم الاستطاعة في الماضي؟

en.question:
Check the picnic announcement for third-person singular lack of necessity.
Because the school cafeteria packs free sandwiches for the bus trip, Fatima ______ pay for lunch today.
Which option agrees with singular 'Fatima' and means 'not required'?
en.hint: Lunch money is unnecessary (not forbidden), and 'Fatima' is singular (she).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Third-person singular subjects ('Fatima', 'he', 'it') use 'doesn't have to' to show lack of necessity.

Step 1: 'don't have to' mismatches singular 'Fatima'.

Step 2: 'mustn't' means forbidden rather than unnecessary.

Step 3: 'must' says paying is required.

✅ Quick Check: Fatima doesn't have to pay for lunch today.

أي خيار يطابق المفرد Fatima ويعني عدم اللزوم؟

en.question:
Compare the Science Fair rules card with four summaries.
Teams are preparing exhibits for Thursday's Science Fair according to the official rules card.
Which summary correctly separates optional items from forbidden ones?
options: Teams must bring open flames, and they shouldn't print a poster.
Teams mustn't use color ink, and they don't have to bring any poster.
Teams don't have to use color ink, but they mustn't bring open flames.
Teams don't have to follow safety rules if they print in black ink.
en.hint: Check all three rows: Printed Poster = Required, Color Ink = Optional, Open Flames = Banned.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Optional color ink -> 'don't have to'; banned open flames -> 'mustn't'.

Step 1: Saying teams 'mustn't use color ink' and 'don't have to bring any poster' swaps 'mustn't' and 'don't have to' and omits the required poster.

Step 2: The remaining choices violate both the flame ban and poster rule.

✅ Quick Check: Teams don't have to use color ink, but they mustn't bring open flames.

Teams are preparing exhibits for Thursday's Science Fair according to the official rules card.
أي ملخص يفرّق بدقة بين الاختياري والممنوع وفق البطاقة؟
options: Teams must bring open flames, and they shouldn't print a poster.
Teams mustn't use color ink, and they don't have to bring any poster.
Teams don't have to use color ink, but they mustn't bring open flames.
Teams don't have to follow safety rules if they print in black ink.
ar.hint: لاحظ الصفوف الثلاثة: الملصق المطبوع مطلوب، الحبر الملون اختياري، واللهب المكشوف ممنوع.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: الحبر الملون الاختياري يأخذ don't have to، واللهب الممنوع يأخذ mustn't.

en.question:
Inspect the bus safety card and find the sentence with accurate modal grammar.
Four Grade 6 students wrote safety reminders based on the school bus poster.
Which sentence follows modal verb grammar rules without errors?
options: Every passenger must to fasten a seatbelt before the bus moves.
Every passenger mustn't standing while the bus is moving.
Every passenger shoulds keep backpacks off the center aisle.
Every passenger must fasten a seatbelt before the bus moves.
en.hint: After any modal ('must', 'should', 'could'), use the pure base verb without 'to', '-s', or '-ing'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'must fasten' correctly places the bare base verb right after the modal 'must'.

Step 1: 'must to fasten' illegally puts 'to' after 'must'.

Step 2: 'shoulds' wrongly adds '-s' to a modal verb.

Step 3: 'mustn't standing' uses '-ing' instead of base 'stand'.

✅ Quick Check: Every passenger must fasten a seatbelt before the bus moves.

تفحص بطاقة سلامة الحافلة واختر الجملة التي تطبق قواعد الفعل الناقص تطبيقاً صحيحاً.
Four Grade 6 students wrote safety reminders based on the school bus poster.
أي جملة تلتزم بقواعد الأفعال الناقصة دون أخطاء؟
options: Every passenger must to fasten a seatbelt before the bus moves.
Every passenger mustn't standing while the bus is moving.
Every passenger shoulds keep backpacks off the center aisle.
Every passenger must fasten a seatbelt before the bus moves.
ar.hint: بعد الأفعال الناقصة مثل must وshould يأتي الفعل مصدراً مجرداً دون to أو s أو ing.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: الصيغة الصحيحة هي must fasten لأن الفعل بعد الناقص يكون مجرداً تماماً.

الخطوة 1: الجمل الأخرى أخطأت بوضع to بعد must أو إضافة s إلى should أو ing بعد mustn't.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Every passenger must fasten a seatbelt before the bus moves.

en.question:
Use the cold-weather hike card to select the soundest advice.
The mountain weather board warns of chilly dawn air before the sunrise trail walk.
Which sentence gives the best advice matching the card?
options: Hikers shouldn't wear a warm coat because 4 C is very hot.
Hikers mustn't check the morning forecast before setting out.
Hikers don't have to wear any coat if they start at dawn.
Hikers should wear a warm coat and shouldn't hike in only a thin T-shirt.
en.hint: Check the card: 4 C temperature -> warm coat is smart ('should'), thin T-shirt is a bad idea ('shouldn't').
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Positive recommendation ('should wear a warm coat') paired with negative advice ('shouldn't hike in only a thin T-shirt') matches 4 C weather.

Step 1: Saying hikers 'shouldn't wear a warm coat' falsely claims 4 C is hot.

Step 2: Banning weather checks or skipping coats at dawn gives dangerous, backwards guidance.

✅ Quick Check: Hikers should wear a warm coat and shouldn't hike in only a thin T-shirt.

The mountain weather board warns of chilly dawn air before the sunrise trail walk.
أي جملة تعطي أفضل نصيحة تتفق مع البطاقة؟
options: Hikers shouldn't wear a warm coat because 4 C is very hot.
Hikers mustn't check the morning forecast before setting out.
Hikers don't have to wear any coat if they start at dawn.
Hikers should wear a warm coat and shouldn't hike in only a thin T-shirt.
ar.hint: درجة الحرارة 4 مئوية؛ لذا ارتداء المعطف الدافئ واجب بالنصح (should)، والاكتفاء بقميص خفيف مرفوض نصحاً (shouldn't).

الخطوة 1: الخيارات الثلاثة الأخرى تناقض التحذير الجوي.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Hikers should wear a warm coat and shouldn't hike in only a thin T-shirt.

en.question:
Fill both blanks using the robotics timeline card (past ability vs contest rule).
Last spring our first robot ______ only beep at walls, but in this year's contest every robot ______ turn around walls on its own.
Which pair of modals fits past ability first and present rule second?
en.hint: 'Last spring' cues past ability ('could'); 'Required' rule in this year's contest cues 'must'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'could' expresses past ability last spring, while 'must' states the mandatory self-steering rule this year.

Step 1: 'must ... could' swaps past and present obligation/ability.

Step 2: Negative pairs contradict the timeline card facts.

✅ Quick Check: Our first robot could only beep, but every robot must turn on its own.

Last spring our first robot ______ only beep at walls, but in this year's contest every robot ______ turn around walls on its own.
أي زوج يناسب القدرة في الماضي أولاً ثم الإلزام الحاضر ثانياً؟

en.question:
Match all three camp notice lines accurately using the right modals.
Read the camp schedule card before packing your overnight bag for Thursday night.
Which sentence matches every single rule on the camp card?
options: Campers must bring matches, shouldn't turn lights off, and couldn't pack a flashlight.
Campers don't have to pack a flashlight, must turn lights off at 10 PM, and mustn't bring matches.
Campers don't have to follow the 10 PM rule if they carry a flashlight.
Campers mustn't pack a flashlight, don't have to turn lights off at 10 PM, and should bring matches.
en.hint: Optional -> 'don't have to'; Required rule -> 'must'; Strictly banned -> 'mustn't'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Only the statement matching Optional -> 'don't have to', Rule -> 'must', and Banned -> 'mustn't' fits every row.

Step 1: The distractors reverse bans, obligations, and optional items.

✅ Quick Check: Campers don't have to pack a flashlight, must turn lights off at 10 PM, and mustn't bring matches.

Read the camp schedule card before packing your overnight bag for Thursday night.
أي جملة تعبّر عن جميع بنود المخيم تعبيراً دقيقاً؟
options: Campers must bring matches, shouldn't turn lights off, and couldn't pack a flashlight.
Campers don't have to pack a flashlight, must turn lights off at 10 PM, and mustn't bring matches.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Campers don't have to pack a flashlight, must turn lights off at 10 PM, and mustn't bring matches.

en.question:
Choose the subordinating conjunction that introduces the reason.
Salma packed her folding umbrella ______ thick rain clouds gathered over the coast.
Which conjunction explains WHY Salma packed her umbrella?
en.hint: Dark rain clouds are the reason; packing the umbrella is the action taken.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use 'because' right before the cause or reason clause ('because thick rain clouds gathered').

Step 1: 'so' introduces a result, which would reverse the logic.

Step 2: 'although' signals an unexpected contrast, and 'unless' means 'if not'.

✅ Quick Check: Salma packed her umbrella because thick rain clouds gathered.

ar.question:
اختر أداة الربط التي تقدّم السبب في الجملة التالية.
Salma packed her folding umbrella ______ thick rain clouds gathered over the coast.
أي أداة ربط توضح سبب حمل سلمى للمظلة؟
ar.hint: تجمّع غيوم المطر هو السبب، وحمل المظلة هو النتيجة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تسبق أداة الربط because جملة السبب مباشرة.

الخطوة 1: تُستعمل so قبل النتيجة لا السبب، وalthough للتناقض، وunless للشرط المنفي.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: because.

en.question:
Choose the coordinating conjunction that introduces the result.
The school printer ran out of black ink, ______ Mr. Tariq walked down to the supply room.
Which conjunction connects the problem to the action taken next?
en.hint: Running out of ink happened first (cause); walking to the supply room was the result.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use ', so' before the result clause showing what happened because of the first clause.

Step 1: 'because' would wrongly say Mr. Tariq's walk caused the printer to lose ink.

Step 2: 'although' and 'unless' do not express cause-to-result flow.

✅ Quick Check: The printer ran out of ink, so Mr. Tariq walked to the supply room.

ar.question:
اختر أداة الربط التي تقدّم النتيجة المترتبة على السبب.
The school printer ran out of black ink, ______ Mr. Tariq walked down to the supply room.
أي أداة تربط المشكلة بالنتيجة التي ترتبت عليها؟
ar.hint: نفاد الحبر هو السبب أولاً، والذهاب إلى غرفة المستلزمات هو النتيجة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نستخدم so بعد الفاصلة لتقديم النتيجة المترتبة على الجملة الأولى.

الخطوة 1: استعمال because يقلب السبب بالنتيجة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: so.

en.question:
Select the adverb form that tells HOW Layla painted.
Layla painted tiny gold stars on the clay lantern ______ so none of the paint smudged.
Which word modifies the verb 'painted'?
en.hint: Ask 'How did Layla paint?' Words describing action verbs usually end in '-ly'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: An adverb of manner ('carefully') is needed to modify the action verb 'painted'.

Step 1: 'careful' and 'careless' are adjectives that describe nouns, not action verbs.

Step 2: 'care' is a noun or verb, not an adverb.

✅ Quick Check: Layla painted tiny gold stars carefully.

ar.question:
اختر صيغة الحال (الظرف) التي تصف كيفية تنفيذ الفعل.
Layla painted tiny gold stars on the clay lantern ______ so none of the paint smudged.
أي كلمة تصف الفعل painted بشكل صحيح؟
ar.hint: اسأل: كيف رسمت ليلى؟ الكلمة التي تصف الفعل تنتهي غالباً بـ -ly.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نحتاج الظرف carefully ليصف طريقة أداء الفعل painted.

الخطوة 1: أما careful وcareless فصفتان للأسماء لا للأفعال، وcare اسم أو فعل.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: carefully.

en.question:
Choose the adjective after the linking verb 'felt'.
At dawn, the desert canyon felt cool and ______ before hikers arrived.
Which word fits properly after the linking verb 'felt'?
en.hint: Notice 'cool and ______' describes the noun 'canyon' after the linking verb 'felt'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Linking verbs ('be', 'feel', 'look', 'seem', 'sound') describe the subject using adjectives -> 'quiet'.

Step 1: 'quietly' is an adverb for action verbs.

Step 2: 'quietness' is a noun, and 'quieterly' is not a real English word.

✅ Quick Check: The desert canyon felt cool and quiet.

ar.question:
اختر الصفة المناسبة بعد فعل الربط الحسي felt.
At dawn, the desert canyon felt cool and ______ before hikers arrived.
أي كلمة تناسب موقعها بعد فعل الربط felt؟
ar.hint: لاحظ العطف cool and ______ الذي يصف الاسم canyon بعد الفعل felt.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تأتي الصفة (quiet) بعد أفعال الربط الحسية مثل felt لوصف الفاعل.

الخطوة 1: لا يصح الظرف quietly أو الاسم quietness هنا.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: quiet.

en.question:
Choose the conjunction that expresses unexpected contrast.
______ the hike up the rocky hillside was steep, every Grade 6 student reached the summit.
Which conjunction begins this contrasting sentence?
en.hint: A steep climb would normally stop someone, yet all students succeeded.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'Although' introduces a surprising contrast between a challenge (steep trail) and the positive outcome.

Step 1: 'Because' wrongly claims steepness caused everyone to succeed.

Step 2: 'So' cannot begin a sentence linking two full contrasting clauses like this.

Step 3: 'Unless' means 'except if' and changes the time/fact.

✅ Quick Check: Although the hike was steep, every Grade 6 student reached the summit.

ar.question:
اختر أداة الربط التي تعبّر عن التناقض أو المفاجأة بين الجملتين.
______ the hike up the rocky hillside was steep, every Grade 6 student reached the summit.
أي أداة ربط تبدأ هذه الجملة المتضمنة تبايناً؟
ar.hint: الانحدار الشديد قد يصعّب الصعود، ومع ذلك وصل جميع الطلاب؛ نحتاج أداة التضاد (على الرغم من).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تُستعمل Although بمعنى (رغم أن) للربط بين عائق ونتيجة مخالفة للمتوقع.

الخطوة 1: أدوات السبب والنتيجة والشرط لا تؤدي معنى التضاد.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Although.

en.question:
Choose the conditional conjunction meaning 'if ... not'.
Our class will miss the early ferry ______ we reach the harbor gate before 7:15 AM.
Which conjunction completes the condition?
en.hint: Test the meaning: 'We will miss the ferry IF WE DO NOT reach the gate before 7:15 AM.'
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'unless' means 'if ... not', so 'unless we reach' = 'if we do not reach'.

Step 1: 'because' would falsely claim arriving early makes us miss the ferry.

Step 2: 'so' and 'although' fail the conditional meaning.

✅ Quick Check: Our class will miss the early ferry unless we reach the gate before 7:15 AM.

ar.question:
اختر أداة الربط الشرطية التي تعني (ما لم / إذا لم).
Our class will miss the early ferry ______ we reach the harbor gate before 7:15 AM.
أي أداة ربط تُكمِل الشرط بشكل صحيح؟
ar.hint: جرّب المعنى: سنفوت العبارة (إذا لم) نصل قبل الساعة 7:15.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تؤدي الأداة unless معنى النفي الشرطي (ما لم / إذا لم).

الخطوة 1: استعمال because أو so أو although يفسد معنى الشرط.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: unless.

en.question:
Distinguish the irregular adverb 'well' from the adjective 'good'.
Nasser practiced his speech for three evenings, so he spoke ______ in front of the whole school.
Which word accurately modifies the verb 'spoke'?
en.hint: We need an adverb modifying 'spoke', and 'good' does NOT add '-ly'!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: The adverb corresponding to the adjective 'good' is 'well' -> 'he spoke well'.

Step 1: 'good' is an adjective for nouns ('a good speech'), not an adverb for 'spoke'.

Step 2: 'goodly' and 'betterly' do not fit modern standard English usage here.

✅ Quick Check: He spoke well in front of the whole school.

ar.question:
ميّز بين الظرف الشاذ well والصفة good عند وصف الفعل.
Nasser practiced his speech for three evenings, so he spoke ______ in front of the whole school.
أي كلمة تصف الفعل spoke بشكل نحوي صحيح؟
ar.hint: نصف هنا الفعل spoke، والصفة good لا يُضاف لها -ly بل ظرفها شاذ.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: الظرف من الصفة good هو well، لذا نقول spoke well.

الخطوة 1: تصف كلمة good الأسماء فقط، ولا توجد صيغة betterly.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: well.

en.question:
Select the adjective modifying the noun 'planet'.
Through the observatory telescope, Jupiter looked like a ______ disc beside its four moons.
Which form modifies the noun 'disc'?
en.hint: The blank sits right between the article 'a' and the noun 'disc'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Nouns ('disc') are modified by adjectives ('bright'), not by '-ly' adverbs ('brightly') or abstract nouns ('brightness').

Step 1: 'brightly' modifies verbs ('shone brightly'), not a noun after 'a'.

Step 2: 'brightness' is a noun, and 'brightestest' is invalid.

✅ Quick Check: Jupiter looked like a bright disc.

ar.question:
اختر الصفة الصحيحة التي تسبق الاسم planet.
Through the observatory telescope, Jupiter looked like a ______ disc beside its four moons.
أي صيغة تصف الاسم disc وصفاً سليماً؟
ar.hint: يقع الفراغ بين أداة النكرة a والاسم disc، وهذا موضع الصفة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تُسبق الأسماء بالصفات مثل bright، لا بالظروف المنتهية بـ -ly.

الخطوة 1: أما brightly فتصف الفعل وbrightness اسم.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: bright.

en.question:
Select the cause conjunction in a science experiment report.
We moved the paper rocket test indoors ______ strong afternoon gusts kept blowing the launcher sideways.
Which conjunction introduces the reason the test moved indoors?
en.hint: Strong gusts caused the move indoors.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'because' introduces the physical cause ('strong afternoon gusts') for the main clause action.

Step 1: 'although', 'so', and 'unless' break the cause-effect relationship.

✅ Quick Check: We moved the test indoors because strong gusts blew the launcher.

ar.question:
اختر أداة السبب المناسبة في تقرير تجربة علمية.
We moved the paper rocket test indoors ______ strong afternoon gusts kept blowing the launcher sideways.
أي أداة تقدّم سبب نقل التجربة إلى الداخل؟
ar.hint: الهبات الهوائية القوية هي السبب الذي دفعهم لنقل التجربة للداخل.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تُقدّم because السبب الحقيقي وراء نقل التجربة للداخل.

الخطوة 1: بقية الأدوات تعبّر عن التضاد أو النتيجة أو الشرط المنفي.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: because.

en.question:
Pick the contrast word at the start of a robotics summary.
______ our small robot's left wheel squeaked near turn three, it completed the entire maze in twelve seconds.
Which conjunction begins the sentence logically?
en.hint: Squeaking could be a problem, yet the robot still finished fast.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'Although' contrasts the minor wheel issue with the robot's fast completion.

Step 1: 'Because' wrongly suggests squeaking helped it finish fast.

Step 2: 'So' and 'Unless' do not fit this factual concession clause.

✅ Quick Check: Although the left wheel squeaked, it completed the entire maze.

ar.question:
اختر أداة التناقض المناسبة في بداية جملة تلخص تجربة الروبوت.
______ our small robot's left wheel squeaked near turn three, it completed the entire maze in twelve seconds.
أي أداة ربط تبدأ الجملة بمعنى منطقي سليم؟
ar.hint: رغم صرير العجلة، أكمل الروبوت المتاهة بنجاح في 12 ثانية.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تأتي Although بمعنى (على الرغم من) للربط بين العائق والنتيجة الجيدة.

الخطوة 1: أدوات السبب والنتيجة لا تصلح لبداية هذه الجملة المتناقضة الطرفين.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Although.

correct_answer: The bean seeds will not sprout unless you give them water and light.

en.question:
Avoid double negatives when writing with 'unless'.
Four students wrote rules about sprouting bean seeds in science class.
Which sentence uses 'unless' clearly and without a double-negative trap?
options: The bean seeds will not sprout unless you give them water and light.
The bean seeds will not sprout unless you do not give them water and light.
Unless the bean seeds do not drink water, they will die of dryness.
The bean seeds will not sprout unless you gave them water next month.
en.hint: Remember: 'unless' ALREADY contains 'not' ('unless = if not'), so do not add 'do not' inside the 'unless' clause!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'will not sprout unless you give them water' cleanly expresses 'will not sprout if you do not give them water'.

Step 1: Using 'unless ... do not' creates a confusing double negative.

Step 2: 'gave ... next month' mixes past 'gave' with future 'next month'.

✅ Quick Check: The bean seeds will not sprout unless you give them water and light.

ar.question:
تجنّب النفي المزدوج عند استخدام أداة الشرط unless.
Four students wrote rules about sprouting bean seeds in science class.
أي جملة تستخدم unless بوضوح ومن دون خطأ النفي المزدوج؟
options: The bean seeds will not sprout unless you give them water and light.
The bean seeds will not sprout unless you do not give them water and light.
Unless the bean seeds do not drink water, they will die of dryness.
The bean seeds will not sprout unless you gave them water next month.
ar.hint: تذكّر أن unless تتضمن النفي في معناها (إذا لم)، فلا نكرر معها النفي do not في العبارة نفسها.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: الجملة الأولى تعبّر بدقة عن الشرط: لن تنبت البذور ما لم تمنحها الماء والضوء، دون نفي مكرر.

الخطوة 1: الجمل الأخرى تقع في خطأ النفي المزدوج مع unless أو تناقض الأزمنة.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: The bean seeds will not sprout unless you give them water and light.

en.question:
Distinguish sensory linking verbs from action verbs in the same sentence.
The fresh cinnamon bread smelled ______ from the oven, so Grandma smiled ______ when we cheered.
Which adjective + adverb pair fits the two blanks?
en.hint: 'Smelled' links the subject 'bread' to an adjective (how the bread was), while 'smiled' is an action verb telling HOW Grandma smiled.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Sensory linking verb 'smelled' takes adjective 'delicious'; action verb 'smiled' takes adverb 'warmly'.

Step 1: Putting 'deliciously' after 'smelled' wrongly uses an adverb for the bread's quality.

Step 2: Putting 'warm' after 'smiled' uses an adjective to modify an action verb.

✅ Quick Check: The bread smelled delicious, so Grandma smiled warmly.

ar.question:
فرّق بين فعل الربط الحسي والفعل الحركي في الجملة نفسها.
The fresh cinnamon bread smelled ______ from the oven, so Grandma smiled ______ when we cheered.
أي زوج من الصفة والظرف يملأ الفراغين بدقة؟
ar.hint: الفعل smelled هنا يصف حالة الخبز (صفة)، أما smiled فهو فعل حركي يحتاج ظرفاً (كيف ابتسمت).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: فعل الربط الحسي smelled يأخذ الصفة delicious، والفعل الحركي smiled يأخذ الظرف warmly.

الخطوة 1: الخلط بين الصفة والظرف في الموضعين يؤدي إلى خطأ نحوي.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: delicious ... warmly.

correct_answer: Because heavy winter rain flooded the canyon path, park rangers closed the trail gate.

en.question:
Combine the cause and effect in the right direction using 'because' or 'so'.
Event 1: Heavy winter rain flooded the canyon path.
Event 2: Park rangers closed the trail gate for safety.
Which sentence accurately joins Event 1 and Event 2?
options: Because heavy winter rain flooded the canyon path, park rangers closed the trail gate.
So heavy winter rain flooded the canyon path, park rangers closed the trail gate.
Although heavy winter rain flooded the canyon path, park rangers closed the trail gate.
Heavy winter rain flooded the canyon path because park rangers closed the trail gate.
en.hint: Event 1 (flooded path) is the CAUSE; Event 2 (closing the gate) is the RESULT.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Placing 'Because' before the cause ('Because heavy winter rain flooded...') accurately shows why the gate was closed.

Step 1: 'So' cannot open a two-clause sentence this way.

Step 2: 'Heavy winter rain flooded ... because park rangers closed...' reverses cause and effect (closing the gate didn't cause rain!).

Step 3: Starting with 'Although' misuses contrast where cause-and-effect is expected.

✅ Quick Check: Because heavy winter rain flooded the canyon path, park rangers closed the trail gate.

ar.question:
اربط بين السبب والنتيجة في الاتجاه الصحيح باستخدام because أو so.
Event 1: Heavy winter rain flooded the canyon path.
Event 2: Park rangers closed the trail gate for safety.
أي جملة تربط الحدثين ربطاً سببياً منطقياً ونحوياً سليماً؟
options: Because heavy winter rain flooded the canyon path, park rangers closed the trail gate.
So heavy winter rain flooded the canyon path, park rangers closed the trail gate.
Although heavy winter rain flooded the canyon path, park rangers closed the trail gate.
Heavy winter rain flooded the canyon path because park rangers closed the trail gate.
ar.hint: الحدث الأول (فيضان الممر) هو السبب، والحدث الثاني (إغلاق البوابة) هو النتيجة.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: تسبق because جملة السبب الحقيقي (فيضان الممر) فتوضّح سبب إغلاق البوابة.

الخطوة 1: الجمل الأخرى تبدأ بـ so خطأً أو تعكس السبب بالنتيجة أو تستخدم أداة تضاد.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Because heavy winter rain flooded the canyon path, park rangers closed the trail gate.

en.question:
Watch out for the tricky '-ly' false friend 'hardly' vs 'hard' and the '-y' -> '-ily' spelling rule.
Even though the riddle looked ______, Majid solved every clue ______ in less than five minutes.
Which adjective + adverb pair completes the contrast?
en.hint: 'Looked' takes an adjective ('hard' = difficult, NOT 'hardly' which means 'almost not!'); 'easy' changes 'y' to 'i' + '-ly' after 'solved'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: 'looked hard' uses the adjective meaning difficult, and 'solved ... easily' uses the correctly spelled adverb ('easy' -> 'easily').

Step 1: 'hardly' means 'almost never / barely', which destroys the meaning.

Step 2: 'easyly' misspells 'easily', and 'easy' is an adjective that cannot modify 'solved'.

✅ Quick Check: Even though the riddle looked hard, Majid solved every clue easily.

ar.question:
انتبه للفارق بين hard وhardly، وطبّق قاعدة كتابة الظرف المنتهي بـ y.
Even though the riddle looked ______, Majid solved every clue ______ in less than five minutes.
أي زوج من الصفة والظرف يُكمِل المعنى والهجاء الصحيح؟
ar.hint: تأتي hard بعد looked بمعنى (صعب)، أما hardly فتعني (بالكاد)! وتُقلب y في easy إلى i قبل -ly.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: الصفة هي hard (صعب)، والظرف الصحيح إملائياً من easy هو easily.

الخطوة 1: تختلف hardly تماماً في المعنى، وتخطئ easyly في الإملاء، كما لا تصف الصفة easy الفعل solved.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: hard ... easily.

correct_answer: Although the gravel road was bumpy, the calm driver steered smoothly around each bend.

en.question:
Choose the sentence that masters conjunction logic, linking adjectives, and action adverbs together.
Read four descriptions of a family's evening drive across a gravel valley road.
Which sentence has zero conjunction, adjective, or adverb errors?
options: Unless the gravel road was bumpy, the driver steered smoothly around each bend yesterday.
Although the gravel road was bumpily, the calm driver steered smooth around each bend.
Because the gravel road was bumpy, although the driver steered smoothly around each bend.
Although the gravel road was bumpy, the calm driver steered smoothly around each bend.
en.hint: Check three things: only ONE conjunction linking two clauses, an adjective after 'was', and an '-ly' adverb modifying 'steered'.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: The correct sentence pairs 'Although' cleanly with adjective 'bumpy' after 'was' and adverb 'smoothly' after 'steered'.

Step 1: 'was bumpily / steered smooth' swaps the adjective and adverb.

Step 2: 'Because ... although ...' illegally combines two conflicting conjunctions in one sentence.

Step 3: 'Unless ... yesterday' misuses 'Unless' with a past event ('yesterday').

✅ Quick Check: Although the gravel road was bumpy, the calm driver steered smoothly around each bend.

ar.question:
اختر الجملة التي تتقن استخدام أداة الربط والصفة بعد فعل الربط والظرف مع الفعل الحركي.
Read four descriptions of a family's evening drive across a gravel valley road.
أي جملة تخلو تماماً من أخطاء الربط والصفات والظروف؟
options: Unless the gravel road was bumpy, the driver steered smoothly around each bend yesterday.
Although the gravel road was bumpily, the calm driver steered smooth around each bend.
Because the gravel road was bumpy, although the driver steered smoothly around each bend.
Although the gravel road was bumpy, the calm driver steered smoothly around each bend.
ar.hint: تحقق من ثلاثة أمور: أداة ربط واحدة فقط، صفة بعد was، وظرف ينتهي بـ -ly يصف الفعل steered.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: الجملة الأولى فقط استخدمت أداة ربط واحدة (Although)، وصفة صحيحة بعد was (bumpy)، وظرفاً صحيحاً للفعل steered (smoothly).

الخطوة 1: بقية الجمل بدّلت الصفة بالظرف أو جمعت بين أداتين متعارضتين أو أساءت استعمال unless في الماضي.

✅ التحقق من الحل: الإجابة الصحيحة: Although the gravel road was bumpy, the calm driver steered smoothly around each bend.

correct_answer: Because they cut fuel transport costs and provide reliable off-grid electricity.

en.question:
Read the excerpt below and answer the question.
Recent trials around the AlUla Solar Microgrid show that clean microgrids can support remote desert farms, achieving reducing diesel transport costs by 62%.
What does the report suggest is the primary benefit of the AlUla Solar Microgrid?
options: Because they cut fuel transport costs and provide reliable off-grid electricity.
Because solar panels work only during winter storms.
Because diesel engines run faster at high altitude.
Because farmers prefer importing coal from Europe.
en.hint: Combine both clauses in the sentence: the method used and the measurable outcome.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Synthesizing the subject and quantitative clause gives the core advantage.

Step 1: Subject: AlUla Solar Microgrid using clean microgrids.

Step 2: Measurable effect: reducing diesel transport costs by 62%.
